title: Ux Designer med erfarenhet av Ios och Android och gillar AI
description:
**Vi söker en senior UX designer och som trivs med att arbeta självständigt i stora projekt.**

  

Hos oss på Rebel and Bird arbetar vi med strategisk UX-design på hög nivå, där vi skapar digitala produkter som driver engagemang, lojalitet och tillväxt. Nu söker vi en UX Lead som både kan leda och facilitera UX-arbetet men också själv skapa både UX och UI-design – en roll där du ofta är ensam designer i våra kundprojekt.

 **Om oss**


Rebel and Bird är en agentic first digital produktutvecklingsbyrå som grundades 2012. Vi är experter på att skapa digitala upplevelser i världsklass och har vunnit flera prestigefyllda priser som IDG topp-100 och ett flertal pallplatser i Svenska Designpriset.


Vi arbetar i små, tvärfunktionella team, ofta i nära samarbete med kunden men ibland jobbar vi helt i kundens team. Vi bygger allt från koncept och strategier till färdiga digitala produkter.

**Som UX designer på Rebel and Bird kommer du att:**

* Behöva behärska svenska i tal och skrift.
* Arbeta med AI-förstärkta verktyg som Figma Make, Claude Design, Claude, MCP, ja du fattar. Du bör ha labbat väldigt mycket med dessa för att passa in hos oss.
* Arbeta självständigt som UX-designer i större projekt, ofta som den enda designresursen.
* Leda och facilitera UX-processer, från research och strategi till prototyp och testning.
* Skapa både UX- och UI-design, inklusive wireframes, prototyper och färdiga UI-komponenter.
* Omvandla kundens behov till konkreta digitala lösningar som skapar värde för både användare och affär.
* Arbeta nära utvecklare, strateger och produktägare för att säkerställa en sömlös upplevelse genom hela produktutvecklingsprocessen.
* Presentera och argumentera för designbeslut på ett övertygande sätt, både för kund och internt.
* Leda och coacha andra designers vid behov, även om du ofta arbetar självständigt i dina projekt.

 **För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har:**

* Minst 10 års erfarenhet av UX-design, där du har arbetat med välkända digitala produkter eller tjänster.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att både leda designprocesser och göra hands-on UI-design.
* Vana att arbeta självständigt i större projekt, där du är ensam UX-designer men samarbetar med utvecklare, strateger och produktägare.
* Förmåga att kombinera användarcentrerad design med affärsstrategi.
* Stark förståelse för UI-design, interaktionsdesign och digitala designsystem.
* Förmåga att facilitera workshops och presentera för beslutsfattare.
* Stark kommunikationsförmåga, både muntligt och skriftligt.

**Meriterande**

* En stark portfolio som visar din erfarenhet och process.
* Erfarenhet av konverteringsoptimering, datadriven design och experimentering.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med komplexa digitala ekosystem och plattformar.
* Erfarenhet av Service Design.
* Kompetens inom WCAG

**Varför Rebel and Bird?**


Vi är en platt organisation där humor, glädje och kreativitet är viktiga drivkrafter. Hos oss får du arbeta med spännande kunder och göra skillnad i stora digitala satsningar.


Låter det här som en roll för dig? Skicka in din ansökan och låt oss prata vidare!

title: Lead UX Designer, AI Product Transformation
description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL**
* You? A designer who's restless about what comes next — not just the next iteration, but genuinely new product experiences where AI acts on behalf of users, not just alongside them.
* Role? As our UX Lead for AI Product Transformation, you'll define what agentic experiences actually look and feel like — designing entirely new interaction paradigms where autonomous systems monitor, decide, and act for car dealers, home buyers, recruiters, and second-hand sellers.
* Tech stack? Modern design & prototyping ecosystems (e.g., Figma) partnered closely with Machine Learning frameworks, data science models, and complex technical architectures.
* Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need — whether it's a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.
* Location? Join us in our Oslo, Stockholm, Helsinki or Copenhagen office with the flexibility to work remotely 3 days per week
* Why us? This isn't about adding AI features to existing flows. It's about designing entirely new experiences at massive Nordic scale — and we measure success by whether users and customers genuinely adopt what we build, not by how impressive the AI looks on a demo slide. You'll work in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment where your design choices directly shape how millions of people delegate tasks to autonomous systems.


 Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
   

  

**WHO ARE YOU?**
**Skills**
 We're looking for someone with deep design expertise and the confidence to work in territory where the patterns haven't been written yet. We value diverse perspectives and non-traditional backgrounds, though we anticipate the following skills will help you succeed:
   

  

* Deep product design expertise: You bring a portfolio demonstrating strong end-to-end product thinking, typically built over 8+ years of UX experience (or equivalent depth).
* Comfort with technical complexity: You have proven experience designing complex, data-rich, or technically sophisticated products and feel comfortable working close to the underlying technology.
* Thriving in ambiguity: You possess the structure and independence to organise your own work, carve out paths in fast-moving environments, and adapt to evolving product needs.
* Commercial instinct: You understand that great design needs to be viable. You naturally think about whether what you're designing will actually create value for the business and the customer — not just look good in a prototype.
* Dual mastery of discovery and delivery: You can seamlessly shift from user research, prototyping, and concept validation to detailed interaction design and technical specifications.
* Cross-functional co-creation: You value deep collaboration with engineering and machine learning teams, viewing product creation as a team sport rather than a solitary hand-off.
* Inclusive communication in English: Fluency in spoken and written English is required. This role requires articulating complex AI behaviours into clear, trustworthy human experiences and aligning design rationales across diverse, cross-border Nordic teams.


**Nice to have:** 
 Experience with AI/ML or automation-driven products, marketplace or platform business models, agent-based or conversational UX patterns, or working across multiple product verticals simultaneously.
   

  

**WHAT'S THE JOB LIKE?**
**The Goal and Mission**
 Your overall mission is to define the interaction paradigms for agentic products. You will answer the core questions of how users delegate tasks to, monitor, and safely override autonomous AI systems across Vend's entire ecosystem — while balancing product conviction with market desirability.
   

  

**Your Typical Week**
* Lead Discovery & Concept Work: Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and data scientists to map out what's technically possible and user-centric.
* Drive User Research: Validate entirely new interaction patterns. Since much of what we are building has no established industry playbook, you will be setting the standard.
* Evolve Design Frameworks: Create flexible, scalable design systems that translate complex AI behaviours into clear, predictable, and trustworthy user experiences.
* Co-Create & Coach: Work synchronously with ML engineers to understand model capabilities and constraints, while raising the design bar and mentoring other designers across the broader Vend community.


**Current & Exciting Projects**
 You Will Be Embedding Within Our Core Verticals (Mobility, Real Estate, Jobs, And Recommerce) To Build Autonomous Agents That Handle Heavy Lifting For Users
   

  

* Mobility: An autonomous agent that monitors a car dealer's inventory, dynamically adjusts pricing and budgets — where the dealer sets a goal and the agent handles the rest.
* Real Estate: An always-on home-buyer agent that watches the market, coordinates condition reports, and prompts the buyer only when human action is needed.
* Jobs: A recruiter agent that identifies passive talent through latent signals, conducts conversational screening, and surfaces top-tier matches.


**Key Stakeholders**
 You will be a core part of a cross-functional team of ~14, working directly with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Machine Learning Engineers, while acting as a bridge to Vend's wider design community.
   

  

**A few words from your Manager**
 "Hi, I'm Rob, Head of AI Product Transformation.
   

  

 I started Vend's AI product transformation team because I believe the next wave of marketplace value won't come from better search filters or smarter recommendations. It'll come from products that genuinely do the work on behalf of our users whilst keeping them firmly in control.
   

  

 Our team is a cross-functional group of ~14 across product, UX, engineering, and data science. The design challenges ahead are the ones I find most interesting: How do you build trust in a system that acts autonomously? How do you design for a user who checks in once a day rather than interacting continuously? How do you make an agent's decisions legible without overwhelming the user? These are fascinating design problems, but they only matter if what we build actually works in the market. We're not a design lab — every experience we ship needs to earn its place with real users and customers. And the design surface goes beyond people — you'll help define how Vend's products should work for non-human users too, designing experiences that serve both people and the agents acting on their behalf.
   

  

 I'd love to hear from you!"
   

  

 Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!
   

  

**GOT YOUR ATTENTION?**
 Let us hear from you! Please apply by
 **30th August 2026** 
 with your resume, portfolio, and help us answer the pre-screening questions. We will start reviewing applications on a rolling basis.
   

  

**QUESTIONS?**
**Rob, Head of AI Product Transformation,** 
 is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer questions. Rob is best reached via rob.van.sundert@vend.com. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please reach out to our Senior TA Partner, Clayton Don Corda, at clayton.don.corda@vend.com

title: Senior Principal UX Designer | Shared Technology (FTC to Mar 2027)
description:
**Craft:**
 UX & UI
   

  

**Job Description:**
 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Principal UX Designer** 
 to help transform the developer experience at King.
 **This is a fixed-term maternity cover contract ending 25 March 2027.**
 You’ll work with our Build & Infrastructure teams as we reset King’s continuous integration (CI) orchestration. We’re modernising the foundations of our CI ecosystem while addressing years of accumulated complexity across its workflows.
   

  

 This is more than a technology transformation. It’s an opportunity to understand what our game teams need from CI, simplify critical workflows and create a developer ecosystem that helps teams build and deliver great games effectively.
   

  

 You’ll bring deep user research expertise and senior design leadership to the programme. Initially, you’ll lead a summative study of our current CI workflows, helping the team understand users’ pain points, behaviours and unmet needs. You’ll identify the outcomes and jobs to be done that should shape the future CI experience.
   

  

 You’ll then work closely with engineers, product partners and King’s game teams to translate those insights into clear, efficient CI workflows and coherent end-to-end journeys across our developer ecosystem.
   

  

 This role belongs to part of the Kingdom we call Shared Tech. The teams within Shared Tech work across all the technology that we use to power our live games, including data infrastructure, machine learning, payments infrastructure and the game engine itself.
   

  

 Your role within the Kingdom
   

  

* Define and lead research into King’s existing CI workflows, using appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods.
* Identify pain points, workarounds and unmet needs, translating your findings into prioritised outcomes and clearly articulated user stories, jobs to be done, or similar.
* Map current and future developer journeys across CI and the wider developer ecosystem.
* Work with engineers and game teams to design, prototype and evaluate intuitive, efficient CI workflows.
* Facilitate workshops that build shared understanding, explore solutions and align teams around priorities.
* Communicate complex systems and design decisions clearly, influencing initiative direction through evidence, systems thinking and constructive challenge.
* Help establish sustainable practices for continuing to learn from users as our CI ecosystem evolves.


**Skills And Experience**
**Must have**
* Extensive experience as a senior UX, product or service designer, with a track record of leading complex, high-impact work through expertise and influence.
* Deep user research expertise, including planning and leading substantial studies and turning findings into product direction and practical design decisions.
* Strong interaction and workflow design skills, particularly for complex tools, systems or end-to-end user journeys.
* Experience applying jobs-to-be-done or comparable outcome-led frameworks.
* Confidence working closely with engineers and engaging with technical subject matter.
* Excellent facilitation, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to create alignment around competing needs and constraints.
* The ability to work independently, bring structure to ambiguity and balance user needs with technical and delivery considerations.


**Particularly valuable**
* Experience designing developer tools, internal platforms or other products for technical users.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery, build systems or software-development workflows.
* Experience with Jenkins, Buildkite or comparable CI/CD platforms.
* Experience simplifying legacy systems or supporting large-scale platform transformations.
* Knowledge of service design or systems thinking, particularly when working across interconnected tools, workflows and teams.
* Experience working in a large-scale engineering or game-development organisation.


 Direct experience with Jenkins or Buildkite is not essential. You will, however, need the curiosity and confidence to develop a strong understanding of technical workflows and earn the trust of experienced engineers and developers.
   

  

**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, you will help King develop:
   

  

* A robust, evidence-based understanding of how game teams experience CI today.
* Clear priorities based on the outcomes users need to achieve, not simply the features of the existing system.
* Simpler, smoother and more coherent CI workflows.
* End-to-end developer journeys that work well across the wider King ecosystem.
* Strong collaboration between Build & Infrastructure teams and the game teams they support.
* A sustainable foundation for continuing to improve the CI experience.


**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Director, Product Design
description:
**Director Product Design**
**Europe / Remote
   

  

 Reports to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer**
**About Velsera**
 Velsera builds software that turns complex biological data into research insight and clinical answers. Our platforms work across multi-omic and multi-modal data: genomics alongside proteomics, transcriptomics and other omics, together with imaging, clinical and real-world data, at the scale of some of the world's largest biomedical programs. Pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, public research initiatives and diagnostic laboratories use our products to advance precision medicine.
   

  

 We run like a scale-up: small teams with real authority, fast decisions, and AI woven into how we work day to day. We measure ourselves on impact for our customers and, ultimately, for patients.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You'd be joining as the design authority for our Seven Bridges Platform and the leader of design at Velsera, just as we rebuild how we design, validate and ship. You report directly to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer, and decisions that take quarters elsewhere happen here in days. Our product managers have already started turning ideas into working, on-brand prototypes with AI and put them in front of customers within weeks. The design foundations that make that speed safe are yours to build and own: design tokens, a component library, and the patterns everyone works with.
   

  

 That's the shape of your influence here. Product managers prototype with the system you build, you review what customers will see, and once a concept is validated, production design belongs to you: journeys that hold up across every state, edge case and installation. This is a product bioinformaticians, scientists and clinicians rely on every day, and you set its bar.
   

  

 This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our product designer working on the clinical side of our portfolio, you'll build the design function as it grows, and you'll keep doing the craft yourself. There's no large design team to inherit; there's one to create.
   

  

 The product is changing as fast as the craft is. Our users increasingly work alongside AI in research and diagnostic workflows, with dense, high-stakes data from many sources. Someone needs to rethink the journeys, trust models and information design of software like ours for that reality. That is a key remit of this job.
   

  

 This role won't suit everyone. If you're looking for a mature design organization with settled processes, you won't find that here yet. If you want to build the system a whole company designs with, lead design for products with real clinical stakes, and do it at scale-up speed, we should talk.
   

  

**What will you do?**
* Own the user journeys, flows and interaction design of the Seven Bridges Platform: partner with product managers on problems, outcomes and scope, then own how the experience actually works, from structure and states down to the number of clicks.
* Build our design system from the ground up: design tokens, a component library aligned with our front-end code, and the standards that bring our product surfaces together under one visual language. The whole organization will prototype with what you build.
* Keep rapid prototyping fast and safe: maintain the foundations PMs build with, review prototype quality before customers see it, and take validated prototypes through to production-ready design.
* Manage our product designer on the clinical side: set goals, develop their craft, give honest feedback, and answer for the quality of design across both businesses. As the team grows, you'll hire and shape it.
* Design for AI in the product itself: assistant and copilot experiences, AI-generated results that scientists and clinicians can trust and verify, and workflows where automation and human judgment work together.
* Work closely with front-end engineers so the design system lives in code, not only in Figma.
* Use product analytics to see where users struggle, make experience debt visible, and give product leadership a clear case for what to fix first.
* Bring design judgment into strategy conversations at the leadership level.


**Your first few months**
 The first version of the design system is live, with tokens and core components in Figma and in code, and product managers are actually prototyping on top of it. You've reviewed working prototypes before they went in front of real customers, and what we shipped is better for it. You and the designer you manage have a real working rhythm, with clear goals and honest feedback, and it shows in the work. And your map of our experience debt is on the leadership table with a clear case for what to fix first.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What do you bring to the table?**
 You've spent seven or more years in product design, with senior ownership of user journeys on complex, data-heavy or scientific software.
   

  

* You've built or led at least one design system that engineering genuinely adopted, and you know what it takes to keep one alive.
* You've managed designers formally, not just mentored them, and the people you've managed got better and would work for you again.
* You're comfortable having your biggest impact through a system other people build with, not only through screens you designed yourself.
* You've chosen fast, ambiguous environments before, and you're looking for another one.
* You already use AI tools to design, prototype and produce working software (we work with Claude, from design exploration through design-to-code), and you have well-formed opinions about where these tools help and where they mislead.
* You've designed AI-powered product experiences, or you have a clear point of view on trust, transparency and human oversight in AI interfaces.
* You're an expert in Figma, including variables and design-to-code workflows such as Code Connect.
* You know enough front-end to collaborate credibly with engineers on components and constraints. You don't need to write production code, but you do need to understand how your designs become it.
* You can operate as the most senior design voice in the company: comfortable with ambiguity, generous as a coach, and clear whether you're talking to executives, engineers or scientists.


 Nice to have: experience with genomics, multi-omics, imaging, clinical or other life sciences data products, or another regulated domain; products delivered across multiple environments or installations; familiarity with component documentation tools like Storybook; experience establishing design practice in an engineering-led organization.
   

  

**Why this position?**
 You get real authority over a core product and the design function itself, from day one, with a direct line to the Chief Strategy and Product Officer. You join a company that works the way it's asking you to work: AI-assisted, fast and hands-on. The work ends in research results and patient outcomes, which makes the pace worth it. And you won't inherit a design practice here; you'll build the one everyone after you inherits.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Flexible Work & Time Off - Embrace hybrid work models and enjoy the freedom of unlimited paid time off to support work-life balance
* Health & Well-being - Access comprehensive group medical and life insurance coverage, along with a 24/7 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health and wellness support
* Growth & Learning - Fuel your professional journey with continuous learning and development programs designed to help you upskill and grow
* Engaging & Fun Work Culture - Experience a vibrant workplace with team events, celebrations, and engaging activities that make every workday enjoyable
* & Many More..

title: Growth Product Owner — Web & Digital
description:
**About The Role**
 We are shifting the focus of our central marketing team toward growth, analytics, and a unified customer experience across all our brands and markets. As Growth Product Owner for Web & Digital, you will own the growth agenda for our web presence — and you will do this by putting the customer at the centre of every decision.
   

  

 Our product is a significant purchase — comparable in value to buying a car. A student and their family choose to trust us with one of the most formative experiences of their lives. That means every digital touchpoint must be intentional, human, and frictionless. We are not optimising for volume. We are building a white-glove experience at digital scale.
   

  

 You are not here to maintain a website. You are here to make every step of the customer journey work harder for the people going through it.
   

  

 This is a product management role with a growth mindset at its core. You think in experiments, numbers, and outcomes. You will lead the web development team but work across multiple teams — CRM, platform engineering, digital campaigns, and local marketing — to ensure the platform, tooling, and strategy are coherent, consistent, and driving real results.
   

  

**Our Marketing Context**
* We operate multiple brands across many countries. We are moving to a mature, unified, and consistent tech stack — no deviations, no fragmented tools, one platform for all markets
* Local marketing teams own content creation and local campaigns. Agencies support local markets on execution. This role sets the standard they all work to, helps to develop tools they all use.
* We have an existing team member responsible for Google digital campaigns. This role does not replace her but brings strategic product ownership and growth leadership improving that layer
* The customer journey spans digital touchpoints, CRM, and an operational platform — this role connects those dots from the customer's perspective


**Why This Role Exists**
* Our web platform is not yet working as a growth engine — the customer experience is fragmented across markets and the full journey is not being measured end to end
* We need someone obsessed with the customer — how they find us, what they experience, where they drop off, and how we earn their trust at every step
* AI-powered search is reshaping how customers discover services like ours — we need to lead this, not react
* We have strong technical and campaign capabilities but lack a product owner who connects them into a coherent customer-centric growth strategy
* We need a consistent and unified platform across all brands and markets — someone to drive and hold that standard


**What You Will Do**
 Customer Experience & Growth — The Core of the Role
   

  

* Own the end-to-end digital customer journey — from first discovery to inquiry to enrolment — and identify every point where the experience can be simplified, improved, or accelerated
* Together with Sales and Marketing team define and track the metrics that reflect real customer outcomes, not just traffic — conversion rates, drop-off points, time-to-inquiry, quality of leads
* Build a culture of experimentation — A/B tests, landing page experiments, journey optimisation — nothing is assumed, everything is tested and measured
* Develop strategies for engaging existing customers and partners digitally — not just acquisition but retention and advocacy
* Champion simplicity in every touchpoint — our customers are making a significant, emotional purchase and the digital experience must reflect that weight


 SEO & AI Search Optimisation
   

  

* Own SEO strategy across all markets — technical SEO, content structure, link authority, Core Web Vitals
* Lead the organisation's approach to AI search optimisation (GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation) — how do we show up when customers search via AI assistants, not just Google
* Translate search landscape shifts into actionable roadmap items and market playbooks before competitors do
* Build and maintain dashboards that show the full customer acquisition picture — rankings, traffic, CTR, conversion — by market and brand


 Digital Marketing — Strategy & Collaboration
   

  

 Digital campaign execution is handled by an existing team member and supported by local market agencies. Your role here is strategic:
   

  

* Set the growth framework and conversion goals that campaigns are measured against
* Own the UTM and attribution framework so every campaign's performance is fully visible and comparable across markets
* Ensure landing pages, conversion paths, and the web experience are built to support campaign performance — brief the web team accordingly
* Work with agencies and the campaigns team to identify what is working and scale it; identify what is not and stop it
* Guide agencies on platform standards, tracking requirements, and brand consistency — they work within your framework


 Product Ownership — Platform, CRM & Cross-Team Collaboration
   

  

* Work with the web development team, CRM team, and platform engineering to prioritise improvements that unlock customer journey value — not just web features
* Define how WordPress blocks, templates, and shared components should evolve to support the customer experience and growth — not just consistency for its own sake
* Bring product owner rigour to every piece of work: clear briefs, defined success metrics, and measurement after every release
* Drive and hold the standard for a unified tech stack across all markets — no deviations, no fragmentation
* Connect web platform data with CRM data to build a complete picture of the customer journey from first click to enrolment


 Local Marketing Teams & Agencies — Guidance & Standards
   

  

 Local marketing teams own their content and local campaign execution. Local agencies support them. You own the framework they work within:
   

  

* Set platform standards, SEO guidelines, and customer experience principles that all markets apply
* Share performance insights regularly — what is working across markets, what is not, and what local teams should do about it
* Review local market sites and content — not to approve, but to advise, challenge, and raise the bar
* Create playbooks that local teams and agencies can act on independently — practical, opinionated, and grounded in data
* Run regular performance reviews — hold local teams to customer experience and growth standards, not just publishing activity


**What You Bring**
 Must Have
   

  

* A genuine growth mindset — you think in hypotheses, experiments, and outcomes, not activities
* Deep understanding of the end-to-end customer journey in a considered, high-value purchase context
* Strong analytical skills — GA4, Search Console, attribution modelling, and the ability to build dashboards that drive decisions
* Proven SEO expertise — technical and strategic, with measurable results
* Product management experience — you know how to write a brief, manage a backlog, and ship things that move metrics
* Experience collaborating across multiple teams — development, CRM, marketing, agencies — and aligning them around customer outcomes
* Strong communication and influencing skills — you can set a standard and make people want to meet it
* Fluent English — additional European languages are a strong advantage


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Background in ecommerce or high-consideration digital products — you understand conversion at scale but can apply that discipline to a more personal, relationship-driven purchase context
* Experience with AI search optimisation / Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO)
* Familiarity with CRM attribution pipelines and how web and CRM data connect
* Experience managing digital growth across multiple brands or markets


**What This Role Is Not**
* A content role — local marketing teams and agencies own content creation
* A campaign execution role — the campaigns team and agencies handle execution; you set the strategy and framework
* A web developer role — you work with and direct the development team, you do not replace them
* A maintenance role — platform consistency is a means to an end, not the goal itself
* A pure traffic role — traffic without conversion and customer satisfaction is not success


**The Mindset We Are Looking For**
 The customer is making one of the most important decisions of their or their child's life. Every pixel, every word, every step in the journey either earns that trust or erodes it.
   

  

* You are obsessed with the customer's experience — not the technology that enables it
* You celebrate a failed experiment as much as a successful one — because both tell you something
* You have strong opinions, loosely held — you form a view, test it, and update based on evidence
* You take ownership of outcomes, not activities — a published page that does not convert is not a win
* You are comfortable with ambiguity and can bring clarity and structure to complex cross-team work
* You are curious about where digital and AI are going and you bring that curiosity into your daily work


**What We Offer**
* A high-impact role in a growing international organisation with a genuine mission
* Real ownership of the customer journey across multiple brands and markets
* A collaborative environment spanning web, CRM, platform engineering, and marketing teams
* Direct access to the CMO, CSO and CTO in a team that values both creativity and analytical rigour
* Stockholm base with international scope — our brands operate across Europe, UK, the US, Australia, and New Zealand

title: Design Lead
description:
We are looking for a Design Lead, who is convinced that strategic design can create real business value when based on profound human insights and future scenarios. The role is based at our Stockholm office, but you will work internationally with colleagues and clients.
   

  

 Do you want to push evidence-based design forward on a global market? Then apply for this position!
   

  

**The role**
 The Design Lead role is vivid and variable. We work in close collaboration with clients in our projects, and you will work together with a team of strategic, creative and analytic experts.
   

  

 Your primary job is to lead brand creative development, ensuring the highest possible standards from start to client delivery. Besides being a brand identity design expert, we highly value that you have experience from UI/UX projects. We are eager to find the right candidate, this could be a mid-level or more senior role depending on fit.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Working as a holistic design resource in client projects.
* Translate strategic objectives and brand strategies into clear creative strategies and execution.
* Lead the creative process from concept to completion, in collaboration with Design Director and Creative Director.
* Review work, lead and educate more junior designers and interns in projects.
* Execute a high level of craftsmanship and aesthetics across all brand design disciplines.
* Identify and act on opportunities for design and brand identity work in client projects.


**You**
 At Lynxeye, we share a passion for making companies understand how they can progress by making a positive change for people, businesses, and society. We believe you share that passion with us. You demonstrate a humble attitude and a genuine curiosity to explore a wide range of ideas, as well as Lynxeye’s other skills areas. In addition, you bring solid business acumen and a strategic mindset to every project.
   

  

 To be successful in this role, you’ll need a high level of understanding of brand strategy and have the ability to comfortably move across creative disciplines, including interaction, print, and spatial. We believe you are experienced working with stakeholder management, and that you thrive working with a variety of clients for shorter projects, as well as one client for longer periods of time. At times, you may also work independently on smaller projects. Experience from work with sales and pitches is a plus.
   

  

* Higher education within Visual communication, Graphic Design, Brand Communication, Brand Design, UI/UX, or similar.
* 6+ years of creative experience, preferably including international work with global brands.
* Relevant experience working with the craftsmanship of design and brand identity. Including logotype design, typography, color management, photography, illustrations and guidelines.
* Highly proficient in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign etc.
* Experience working with UI/UX.
* Business proficient in written and spoken Swedish and English.


 In this role, you would likely work with one of our larger clients in Asia. Therefore, it is considered a plus if you are able to travel to Asia a few times a year.
   

  

**Apply now!**
 If you feel you’re the person we are looking for, don’t hesitate to apply today. We will interview continuously. The preferred start date is as soon as possible, but we are flexible for the right candidate.

title: Product Experience Specialist (Full Time)
description:
**TL;DR**
 We are looking for Product Experience Specialists who want to shape the way the world builds software. You will be on the front lines of a fast-growing product, solving real user problems and feeding insights directly into product development. You will also take ownership of how we build, document, and improve support at scale. This role is for someone who has recently completed a bachelor's or master's degree, is user- and product-obsessed, cares deeply about helping others succeed, and is ready to grow into real responsibility fast.
   

  

 This is a full-time position based in Lund or Stockholm. We start with a 3-month contract with a potential 12-month extension and expanded responsibilities.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Recently graduated: You have completed a bachelor's or master's degree and are looking for a role where you can hit the ground running and grow fast.
* A driver, not a passenger: You spot problems before they're pointed out, come up with improvements on your own initiative, and follow through.
* Analytical problem solver: You break down complex situations systematically and move fast to get users unblocked even if it is something we haven’t seen before. You see opportunities where others see obstacles.
* Curious: You test ideas, try new approaches, and aren't afraid to get it wrong the first time. You're naturally drawn to AI tools and see the potential to get things done more efficiently.
* Crystal-clear communicator: Whether it's a user reply, a bug report, or an internal process doc, you communicate warmly and precisely.
* Bonus: Experience in B2C SaaS support using tools like Intercom.
* Bonus: Hands-on experience with Lovable, Claude and similar AI tools.


**What You'll Do**
* Own user problems end to end: Become a Lovable expert to solve a wide range of issues with speed and clarity, and escalate effectively to engineering when needed.
* Improve our support stack: Keep our internal knowledge base up to date, design smarter workflows, and find ways to make the whole team operate better.
* Be the voice of the customer: Continuously feed product feedback into the team so that what you see on the front lines actually improves the product.
* Grow your scope: As you build trust and ownership, the role expands. Internally at Lovable and externally in how we engage with users and the community, there is real room to develop.


**About Your Application**
 We welcome candidates from all backgrounds. What matters to us is mindset, drive, and curiosity. Please apply through our application system in English as it is our company language.

title: Digital strateg med fokus på kommunikation, AI och förändringsledning - (hybrid)
description:
*Vinnova, Sveriges innovationsmyndighet, söker dig som vill vara med och utveckla vår digitala närvaro och våra tjänster på kommunikationsavdelningen. Du har erfarenhet av kommunikation och digital utveckling, exempelvis som projektledare, produktägare eller i en liknande roll. Vi utvecklar just nu våra webbplatser och vår digitala plattform. Arbetet omfattar bland annat en ny webbarkitektur, headless-lösningar, AI-stödda arbetssätt och utveckling av nya arbetsprocesser.*
**Vi erbjuder**
 Vår kommunikation och våra metoder ligger i framkant. Vi vågar testa och lära – alltid på ett ansvarsfullt och metodiskt sätt. Just nu bygger vi om vår digitala plattform, samtidigt som vi integrerar AI i både produkter och arbetssätt.
   

  

 För dig som motiveras av att använda ny teknik för att utveckla och förbättra kommunikationsinsatser, erbjuder vi en spännande tjänst där du får vara involverad i allt från arkitektur och förvaltning till produktutveckling och förändringsledning. Rollen är både operativ och strategisk, där du är med och driver vår digitala förflyttning inom kommunikation och webb.
   

  

 Vår vision är att vara Sveriges mest attraktiva statliga arbetsgivare. För att nå dit ger vi dig bland annat goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling, generös friskvård och ett brett utbud av personalaktiviteter. Vi sitter i moderna lokaler i centrala Stockholm och har en öppen, innovativ och samarbetsorienterad kultur. Läs gärna mer om oss och vårt arbetsgivarerbjudande här.
   

  

**Rollbeskrivning**
 Kommunikationsavdelningen består av 17 personer. Som digital strateg arbetar du i gränssnittet mellan kommunikation, verksamhetsutveckling, användarbehov och externa leverantörer. Arbetet sker med användaren i fokus, och ofta i samarbete med det egna teamet och med andra avdelningar på Vinnova. Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av AI-stödda arbetssätt för analys, innehållshantering och kommunikation. Du har ett övergripande ansvar och är produktägare för innehållet på några av Vinnovas webbplattformar. Du kvalitetssäkrar och utvecklar plattformarna tillsammans med våra webbredaktörer.
   

  

 Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Leda förändringsarbeten och utvecklingsprojekt.
* Agera förändringsledare och stödja kommunikationsavdelningen i införandet av nya arbetssätt och digitala verktyg.
* Ge tekniskt beställarstöd till leverantörer samt identifiera verksamhetens och användarnas behov. Du omsätter behoven till krav i dialog med utvecklare och leverantörer.
* Analysera och presentera data för att följa upp och utveckla kommunikationsinsatser.
* Driva AI-baserade arbetssätt inom kommunikationsarbetet.


**Kvalifikationer**
**Utbildning:**
* Minst tvåårig eftergymnasial utbildning inom kommunikation, IT eller liknande område, från högskola/universitet eller YH, alternativt motsvarande utbildning som bedöms likvärdig.


**Erfarenhet** 
 :
   

  

* Minst fem års aktuell erfarenhet av en liknande roll.
* Minst tre års erfarenhet från arbete med produktägarskap och/eller projektledning.
* Erfarenhet av förändringsledning.
* Erfarenhet av att planera, utveckla och förvalta digitala kommunikationskanaler.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med verksamhetsmål, nyckeltal eller KPI:er för digitala kommunikationskanaler samt uppföljning och analys av resultat.
* God vana av att arbeta i CMS och webbplattformar.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med webbarkitektur, API:er och integrationer.
* Erfarenhet av kravställning och nära samarbete med utvecklingsteam.


**Språkkunskaper:**
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift.


**Meriterande:**
* Erfarenhet av Optimizely/EPiServer.
* Vana av att arbeta med headless CMS-lösningar, exempelvis Strapi eller Contentful.
* Kunskap om systemarkitektur kopplad till headless-lösningar.
* Grundläggande kunskaper i programmering eller webbutveckling.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med AI-transformation.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med användar- och kundresor samt CRM-system.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med digital tillgänglighet i en kunskapsintensiv organisation eller offentlig verksamhet.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 När vi anställer lägger vi stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och motivation.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som motiveras av Vinnovas uppdrag att främja tillväxt och konkurrenskraft för framväxande teknik och företag i ett ekonomiskt, socialt och miljömässigt hållbart perspektiv.
   

  

 Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och intresserad av ny teknik. Du ser möjligheter i nya arbetssätt samtidigt som du tar vara på det som redan fungerar. Du trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt och har förmåga att växla mellan olika perspektiv. Du tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt och samarbetar väl med andra.
   

  

 Vinnova är en lärande organisation och vi ser gärna att även du delar med dig av dina idéer och kunskaper. Våra värderingar: respekt, ansvarstagande och mod genomsyrar ditt dagliga arbete.
   

  

**Placering**
 Vi tillämpar hybridarbete, där våra medarbetare har möjlighet att kombinera arbete hemifrån och på kontoret. Minst hälften av arbetstiden ska förläggas till vårt aktivitetsbaserade kontor på Mäster Samuelsgatan 56, som ligger ett par minuters promenad från Stockholms centralstation.
   

  

**Anställningsform**
 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning och vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.
   

  

**Om Vinnova**
 Vinnova är Sveriges innovationsmyndighet. Vi öppnar upp för innovation som ger hållbara lösningar och stärker svensk konkurrenskraft. Läs mer på vinnova.se
   

  

**Kontakt**
 Vill du veta mer? Kontakta gärna Lovisa Roupe, som är enhetschef på kommunikationsavdelningen, via telefon 08-4733293 eller e-post lovisa.roupe@vinnova.se
   

  

 Vi avböjer all rekryterings- och annonseringshjälp.
   

  

**Fackliga kontaktpersoner**
 Företrädare för ST är Jonathan Nylander 08-473 3024 För SACO är det Karin Stenström 08-473 3152.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Välkommen att ansöka till oss via vår rekryteringsportal senast 2026-09-15. Inför att du skickar in din ansökan vill vi att du läser informationen om vår rekryteringsprocess här och bisysslor här.
   

  

 Vi eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning och de kvaliteter som kulturell och etnisk mångfald tillför verksamheten. Vinnova arbetar kompetensbaserat för att främja en objektiv och icke-diskriminerande rekryteringsprocess. Detta innebär bland annat att du inte ska skicka in ett personligt brev och att du kan komma att få göra arbetspsykologiska tester i den här rekryteringen.

title: Webb/huvudredaktör
description:
Vill du arbeta med kommunikation i en verksamhet som skapar möjlighet för utbildning, utveckling och utbyten både nationellt och internationellt?
 


  


 Vill du arbeta med att redaktionellt förädla och utveckla myndighetens hemsida för att säkerställa ett så träffsäkert och målgruppsanpassat innehåll som möjligt? Vill du guida och stödja ett team med kollegor runtom i verksamheten som ska bidra med innehåll? Då är det här en härlig möjlighet för dig!
 


  


 Vi söker nu en huvudredaktör för vår myndighetsövergripande hemsida UHR.se. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på ett år och är placerad på Kommunikationsenheten.
 


  


 Universitets- och högskolerådet, UHR, är en statlig myndighet med ett brett uppdrag inom utbildningsområdet. Vår vision är utbildning, utbyte och utveckling - för alla som vill vidare.
 


  

 Vad du kommer att göra/ansvara för
   


 Som Huvudredaktör kommer du att ansvara för det redaktionella innehållet på myndighetens övergripande webbsida, UHR.se.
 


  


 I rollen ingår att planera, samordna och driva utvecklingen av innehåll samt att utbilda, leda och coacha en intern redaktörsorganisation som har olika redaktörsuppdrag som är knutna till olika uppdrag och projekt.
 


  


 Du kommer också att operativt anpassa, redigera, skriva och publicera texter samt bilder på hemsidan, samt göra klarspråksanpassningar och se över tillgängligheten.
 


  


 I vissa fall kommer du att medverka i eller göra webbanalyser för att därigenom kunna ställa krav på digitala anpassningar. Självklart ser du ständigt över struktur för bästa målgruppsanpassning.
 


  


 Förutom kollegorna på Kommunikationsenheten, samarbetar du med kollegor runtom i organisationen som projektledare, produktägare, tjänstedesigners med flera.
 


  


 Även andra uppgifter kan förekomma.
 


  

 Du som söker
   


 Du har:
 


  

  
* Akademisk examen inom journalistik, media, kommunikation eller motsvarande utbildning som arbetsgivaren anser likvärdig.
  
* Mycket goda kunskaper att uttrycka dig på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
  
* Minst fem års dokumenterad och aktuell erfarenhet av redaktionellt arbete, textbearbetning på webb samt bildredigering på webb.
  
* Erfarenhet av webbanalys och ett operativt redaktionellt ledarskap.
  
* Dokumenterad och aktuell god pedagogisk förmåga där du bedrivit utbildningar i redaktörsarbete för webb.
  
* Du har dokumenterad och aktuell erfarenhet av och använder obehindrat Microsoft Office-paketet och Photoshop.
  
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CMS för webb.
  
* Kunskaper inom HTML, SEO, copywriting, klarspråk och tillgänglighet på webben.
  
* Erfarenhet av nära samarbete med agila tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam.
  


  


 Det är meriterande om du har:
 


  

  
* Det är meriterande att ha denna erfarenhet från myndighet eller annan offentlig verksamhet.
  
* Kunskaper i Optmizely/ Episerver är mycket meriterande.
  


  


 För att fungera bra i rollen som webb/huvudredaktör behöver du:
 


  

  
* Utmärkt skribent, strukturerad och samarbetsinriktad.
  
* God pedagogisk förmåga där du med stort engagemang inom ditt ansvarsområde, visar vägen för redaktörer runtom i verksamheten.
  
* Lyhörd och resultatinriktad.
  


  


 Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
 


  

 Vad vi gör och erbjuder
   


 UHR har flera uppdrag inom utbildningsområdet vars gemensamma nämnare är att skapa möjligheter till utveckling genom utbildning och internationella utbyten. Vi är cirka 340 anställda i Stockholm och Visby. UHR:s mål är att vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare där medarbetare och chefer jobbar tillsammans för långsiktig utveckling. Vi erbjuder en professionell och stimulerande miljö med goda möjligheter till personlig utveckling. Vi värnar om en rekrytering fri från diskriminering och ser inte ytterligare anpassningar som ett hinder.
 


  


 Anställningen omfattar heltid med start så snart som möjligt och är tidsbegränsad till ett år. Placeringsort är Solna.
 


  


 Våra villkor och förmåner
 


  


 Mer om UHR
 


  

 Ansök och bli en av oss!
   


 Välkommen med din ansökan i form av CV på svenska märkt med diarienummer 2.2.1-01399-2026. När du gör din ansökan vill vi att du besvarar ett antal urvalsfrågor. Vi kommer i det första urvalet att utgå från svaren på dessa frågor. På så vis utvärderar UHR kandidaterna på lika villkor. CV kommer att läsas i nästa steg i urvalsprocessen. Sista ansökningsdatum är 15 september 2026.
 


  


 Har du några frågor om rekryteringen är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Caroline Dietmann tfn. 010-470 0621. Representant för Saco-S är Kerstin Martínez tfn. 010- 470 04 69 och för ST Anneli Schönning tfn. 010-470 05 76 alt. e-mail: st@uhr.se.
 


  


 Universitets- och högskolerådet har gjort medieval för denna rekrytering. Vi undanber oss därför kontakt med annonssäljare eller andra säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

title: Praktik / LIA - Tech & Data
description:
Baby Journey lanserades hösten 2020 och är en app som riktar sig mot gravida samt föräldrar med småbarn. Vi är ett snabbväxande, grundarlett Scale-Up bolag med målet att bli Europas största community för målgruppen under 2026.
   

  

 Vill du få praktisk erfarenhet inom Tech, data, analys och arbeta nära ett tech- och produktteam i ett snabbväxande bolag? Är du strukturerad, självgående och gillar att få saker att hända? Då kan detta vara praktikplatsen för dig!
   

  

 Baby Journey är en app för gravida och föräldrar med småbarn och ett grundarlett scaleup-bolag med höga tillväxtambitioner. Nu söker vi en praktikant/LIA-student inom Tech och Data.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat vara:**
* Bygga AI-agenter och automationer som tar bort manuellt arbete i vår vardag
* Extrahera, analysera och visualisera data för att förstå hur våra användare faktiskt beter sig
* Bygga dashboards som gör att teamet kan fatta beslut på data istället för magkänsla
* Utveckla nya funktioner i vår app – gärna med AI-verktyg som en självklar del av arbetsflödet
* Förbättra och vidareutveckla befintlig produkt
* Testa ny teknik i skarpt läge och omsätta insikter till konkreta rekommendationer


**Vem är du?**
* Van användare och nyfiken på AI på riktigt – du har byggt egna agenter, automationer eller experiment, och du använder AI-verktyg dagligen
* En "doer" som hellre bygger en prototyp än skriver ett långt dokument om den
* Strukturerad, noggrann och självgående – du kör igång utan att någon behöver peka
* Intresserad av tech, kod, data och analys
* Håller koll på vad som händer i AI-världen och gillar att testa nytt innan alla andra gör det


 Du behöver inte ha lång erfarenhet. Vi bryr oss mer om vad du har byggt än vad som står på ditt CV – har du ett sidoprojekt, ett GitHub-repo eller en agent du är stolt över, visa gärna den.
   

  

**Låter det här som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!**

title: Head of Marketing (70k-90k SEK/month + Equity) at well-funded healthtech startup
description:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Head of Marketing
   

  

**Salary**
 70k-90k SEK/month + Equity
   

  

**Company Description**
 Well-funded healthtech startup
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the first marketing hire at a high-growth healthtech startup, you will own the end-to-end strategy from brand and PR to performance and CRM. You'll move from a hands-on solo lead to building a global function, driving user acquisition and international expansion for a disruptive at-home diagnostic platform.
   

  

**Location**
 Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Shape the future of women's health with a category-defining diagnostic platform backed by top-tier VCs.
* Experience true ownership as the first marketing hire, building systems from scratch rather than inheriting legacy processes.
* Join a high-growth venture with over 30% month-on-month growth and a massive, underserved global market opportunity.


**What You Will Do**
* Lead global growth and go-to-market strategies across Europe and North America to drive user acquisition and retention.
* Own the brand, PR, and communications strategy to position the company as a leading authority in digital health.
* Execute data-driven performance marketing campaigns and build personalized CRM journeys to optimize customer lifetime value.


**The ideal candidate**
* Proven experience as the first marketing hire in a seed-stage startup, building from zero to one.
* Deep expertise in subscription-based marketing, including CAC/LTV optimization and lifecycle management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to manage budgets, negotiate partnerships, and connect marketing activities to business outcomes.


**Who are Jack & Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

title: Commercial Analyst - Loyalty & Partnerships
description:
Are you a curious, fast-paced analyst who loves turning complex member and partnership data into commercial impact? Do you thrive in an environment where your insights directly shape strategic decisions, loyalty growth, and partner profitability - rather than dying in a presentation slide? If you're looking for a role with high autonomy, sharp colleagues, and the chance to build a true data foundation from the ground up, this is your place to thrive!
   

  





 We find ourselves at an exhilarating position. We’ve grown to over 250 hotels, broken the historic 20 billion NOK revenue milestone, and transformed how marketing, loyalty, and commercial growth operate at Strawberry. Now, we are taking our Loyalty Program and Strategic Partnerships to the next level. We need a proactive Commercial Analyst - Loyalty & Partnerships to be the dedicated analytics bridge to our key commercial, loyalty, and partnership leads. 
   

  





 Note: We are currently hiring three distinct analyst roles within our Commercial Insights & Personalization team. While all three share our passion for commercial data and high tempo, this specific role is 100% dedicated to driving real commercial value across our 2.5+ million loyalty members and strategic partner ecosystem (including Spenn).
   

  





  




**What you will be doing**

 As our Commercial Analyst your main role is to be a trusted business partner and commercial challenger. You’ll dive into our member and customer data, pinpoint why retention or engagement fluctuates, and proactively bring new solutions to the table – including the ones we didn't know we needed.
   

  





 A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Loyalty & Partnership leads - Jørgen Sando (Head of Performance & Member Acquisition) and Christian Lundén (Director Strategic Partnerships) – providing them with the actionable insights and data foundations needed to optimize member lifetime value and partner commercial performance
   

  





 (We’re not looking for a human dashboard generator to just pull static numbers. We want someone who tells the story behind the data and makes things happen.)
 


* Dig into the "why" behind member behavior shifts. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, loyalty program engagement, and retention metrics (LTV, churn) to present bold, actionable ideas.
* Evaluate our 40+ strategic partners (including Spenn) and their financial contribution. Dig deep into core source systems (such as PMS/Mews) to establish accurate baseline stay statistics, create reliable dashboards, and ensure data transparency for commission models.
* Drive Initiatives Proactively. Take full ownership. Spot opportunities, ask the brave questions ("Have we looked into this?"), and run with them.
* Balance strategy & speed. Move seamlessly between fast ad-hoc questions and broader strategic projects. Spread data literacy across commercial teams, increasing the organization's appetite for analytics and data-driven decision-making.



  




**Who we think you are**

 You are a curious commercial storyteller who naturally digs beneath the surface and has the confidence to translate raw data into persuasive business recommendations. You combine a solid technical foundation with strong commercial acumen and storytelling skills.
   

  





 You are pragmatic, action-driven, and resilient. When facing organizational data silos or missing baselines, you don't stall - you use your social skills, persistence, and proactive mindset to build bridges, explore data, and establish clarity. 
 


* Relevant background in Loyalty Analytics, Partnership Analytics, Commercial Financial Modeling, or Business Intelligence. Strong grasp of loyalty mechanics, loyalty economics, customer lifetime value, and partnership frameworks.
* Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery / Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and visualization tools such as PowerBI or Tableau. Experience using CRM platforms or similar tools.
* We believe you have a solid background in Loyalty, Partnership, or Commercial Analytics (around 5+ years of experience), but what truly sets you apart is your commercial acumen, technical confidence, and ability to drive impact through data.



  

  

  





 Details: 
   

 You will report to Dianne Robillos, as part of her Commercial Insights & Personalization team. Here, you get a solid data community of analyst colleagues to spar with, while acting as the primary bridge to daily commercial execution
   

 Location: Stockholm (Solna) or Oslo (with flexibility through our hybrid office setup).
   

 Working Language: Swedish, Norwegian, or English.
   

  





  




**What we can offer you**
* A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
* The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling.
* Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family!
* Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.



*We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.*

title: Global Product Manager – Turning Indexable Grades

 As Global Product Manager for grades, you steer the strategic direction of our Turning Indexable grade portfolio and ensure an attractive and competitive offering throughout its lifecycle, from idea generation and development to launch and portfolio optimization. You define the product vision, roadmap and business priorities while driving growth and commercial performance. You report to the Manager Product Management Turning.

 Send your application no later than September 8, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0095298.

title: Client Advisor
description:
LISA YANG is looking for experienced Client Advisors to join the team at the Stockholm flagship store which opens later this Autumn. In this role, you will serve as the primary ambassador of the brand, delivering an exceptional, inspiring and personalised experience to every guest who enters our first physical retail space.
 



  





  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Offer warm, serene hospitality to all visitors, providing a welcoming and inspiring brand experience
* Act as an expert on cashmere and the intricate craftsmanship behind our collections
* Communicate the design philosophy and technical craftsmanship behind each piece in inspiring ways
* Cultivate long-term brand loyalty by proactively building, maintaining and nurturing a dedicated client book using CRM tools and insights
* Conduct thoughtful, personalised outreach for new arrivals, collection previews, seasonal styling recommendations and personal milestones (birthdays, anniversaries)
* Ensure seamless follow-ups after purchases, sharing expert advice on material care and styling
* Host tailored styling consultations, private shopping appointments and wardrobe advice sessions
* Take ownership of individual sales goals and key performance indicators
* Conduct cross-selling by offering complete look suggestions
* Stay informed on daily and weekly store targets, actively contributing to team sales success and flagship performance goals
* Execute smooth transaction processing at the POS, accurate stock handling, inventory checks and packing procedures
* Participate in daily opening and closing routines, ensuring stock rooms and checkout areas remain orderly, secure and compliant
* Maintain flawless visual merchandising and presentation standards throughout the day, ensuring displays are visually appealing and fully stocked
* Share client feedback, sizing trends and product performance insights with the Store Manager to support assortment planning and store improvements



  





 Experience & Qualifications
 


* 2+ years of experience in luxury fashion or high-end lifestyle retail
* Demonstrated success in building client relationships, managing a client portfolio and driving repeat business using CRM tools
* Proven ability to consistently meet or exceed personal sales performance goals and KPIs
* Exceptional verbal communication skills
* Fluent in English (additional languages are an advantage)
* Passionate about luxury fashion, retail and the LISA YANG brand



  





 Based at the LISA YANG Stockholm flagship store, positions are available on a full-time and part-time basis.
 



  





  





 About LISA YANG
 



 LISA YANG is a Stockholm fashion house dedicated to cashmere. Founded in 2014 by Lisa Yang and Samuel Stenberg, the label is led by the East meets West heritage of its founders, with collections drawing from the ancient cashmere tradition inherited from Inner Mongolia and the understated ease of Scandinavian design.
 



 Through artisanal craft and technical innovation, the label refines the characteristics of cashmere and reimagines what the fibre can become. From the fine, downy cashmere hairs meticulously combed by hand to the exceptionally soft finished garment, every step of the process is a testament to precision and the intricate craftsmanship behind the product.
 



 At LISA YANG, cashmere becomes a science, a creative expression and an ongoing legacy, where each piece embodies a modern vision of artisanal luxury.

title: Trust & Safety Analyst Engineer
description:
**TL;DR** 
 You'll build, analyze, and scale the systems that keep Lovable a platform the world can trust. Sitting at the intersection of data analysis, software engineering, and policy enforcement, you'll turn safety policies into automated logic that protects millions of users from harmful content, fraud, and abuse.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 3+ years in trust & safety, platform integrity, or a related role combining data analysis and engineering at a consumer tech company.
* Strong technical foundation: you're comfortable writing code, querying data, and building backend workflows that run at scale.
* The ability to translate safety policies into automated logic, machine learning features, and scalable systems.
* Sharp judgment under ambiguity. You can dig into a pattern of abuse, gather context, and make the right call quickly.
* Comfort with sensitive content and a steady temperament. You know how to protect yourself while working close to hard material.
* Operational rigor: you document decisions, spot patterns, and turn one-off cases into policy and tooling improvements.
* Strong written English and clear, empathetic communication with users and internal teams.
* Bonus: familiarity with DSA, NCMEC reporting, or working with law enforcement requests.


**What You'll Do**
* Build, analyze, and scale the systems that protect Lovable users from harmful content, fraud, and abusive behavior.
* Translate safety policies into automated logic, machine learning features, and scalable backend workflows.
* Collaborate closely with trust & safety specialists, data, engineering, and product teams to turn policy into detection and enforcement.
* Identify trends across cases and abuse patterns, and feed them back into policy, tooling, and detection.
* Escalate complex or high-severity cases to T&S Experts, Legal, and Engineering with crisp summaries.
* Help build the AI-assisted moderation tooling that lets a small team punch far above its weight.


**About Your Application**
* Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join
* We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal

title: Digital strateg med fokus på kommunikation, AI och förändringsledning
description:
Vinnova, Sveriges innovationsmyndighet, söker dig som vill vara med och utveckla vår digitala närvaro och våra tjänster på kommunikationsavdelningen. Du har erfarenhet av kommunikation och digital utveckling, exempelvis som projektledare, produktägare eller i en liknande roll. Vi utvecklar just nu våra webbplatser och vår digitala plattform. Arbetet omfattar bland annat en ny webbarkitektur, headless-lösningar, AI-stödda arbetssätt och utveckling av nya arbetsprocesser.
  
Vi erbjuder
  
Vår kommunikation och våra metoder ligger i framkant. Vi vågar testa och lära – alltid på ett ansvarsfullt och metodiskt sätt. Just nu bygger vi om vår digitala plattform, samtidigt som vi integrerar AI i både produkter och arbetssätt.
  
För dig som motiveras av att använda ny teknik för att utveckla och förbättra kommunikationsinsatser, erbjuder vi en spännande tjänst där du får vara involverad i allt från arkitektur och förvaltning till produktutveckling och förändringsledning. Rollen är både operativ och strategisk, där du är med och driver vår digitala förflyttning inom kommunikation och webb.
  
Vår vision är att vara Sveriges mest attraktiva statliga arbetsgivare. För att nå dit ger vi dig bland annat goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling, generös friskvård och ett brett utbud av personalaktiviteter. Vi sitter i moderna lokaler i centrala Stockholm och har en öppen, innovativ och samarbetsorienterad kultur. Läs gärna mer om oss och vårt arbetsgivarerbjudande https://www.vinnova.se/m/arbeta-hos-oss/.
  
Rollbeskrivning
  
Kommunikationsavdelningen består av 17 personer. Som digital strateg arbetar du i gränssnittet mellan kommunikation, verksamhetsutveckling, användarbehov och externa leverantörer. Arbetet sker med användaren i fokus, och ofta i samarbete med det egna teamet och med andra avdelningar på Vinnova. Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av AI-stödda arbetssätt för analys, innehållshantering och kommunikation. Du har ett övergripande ansvar och är produktägare för innehållet på några av Vinnovas webbplattformar. Du kvalitetssäkrar och utvecklar plattformarna tillsammans med våra webbredaktörer.
  
  

**Exempel på arbetsuppgifter:**  

Leda förändringsarbeten och utvecklingsprojekt.
  
Agera förändringsledare och stödja kommunikationsavdelningen i införandet av nya arbetssätt och digitala verktyg.
  
Ge tekniskt beställarstöd till leverantörer samt identifiera verksamhetens och användarnas behov. Du omsätter behoven till krav i dialog med utvecklare och leverantörer.
  
Analysera och presentera data för att följa upp och utveckla kommunikationsinsatser.
  
Driva AI-baserade arbetssätt inom kommunikationsarbetet.
  
  

Kvalifikationer

Minst tvåårig eftergymnasial utbildning inom kommunikation, IT eller liknande område, från högskola/universitet eller YH, alternativt motsvarande utbildning som bedöms likvärdig.

title: IT System & Support Specialist
description:
SPEED & SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


Do you enjoy solving technical challenges, helping people and finding smarter ways of working? Are you looking for a broad IT role where you can combine hands on support with systems, infrastructure and exciting technology projects?


We are looking for an **IT System & Support Specialist** to join our Nordic IT team and help keep our business running smoothly.


**What you will do**


You will be a key IT partner for our colleagues across the Nordic organization. From troubleshooting everyday technical issues to supporting new locations, systems and technology projects, you will have a varied role with plenty of opportunities to make an impact.


Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:


* Provide hands on and remote IT support across the Nordic organization Troubleshoot and maintain hardware, software, networks, systems and end user devices
* Manage onboarding, user access, equipment and device lifecycle
* Support offices, stores and warehouse environments when needed
* Participate in IT projects and collaborate with global and local stakeholders
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and ways of working through new technology and AI
* Ensure IT solutions are secure, reliable and available with minimal disruption to the business
**Your talent**
---------------


You are a solution oriented and service minded IT professional who enjoys taking ownership and solving problems. You are comfortable working independently but also enjoy collaborating with people across different functions and countries.


**You also have:**

* Background in IT support, IT operations or a similar technical role
* Good knowledge of end user hardware, software, networks and IT infrastructure
* Strong problem solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues independently
* Familiarity with user administration, access management and device management
* Fluent English is required. Knowledge of Swedish or another Nordic language is an advantage

**Why PUMA?**


* Great benefits: 5000 SEK in product allowance every year, 45% in employee discount, health allowance, lunch card, and paid health hour every Friday.
* A broad and engaging role where no two days are the same
* Global connections and relationship-building across the organisation

At PUMA, we believe in finding the right person – someone who not only has the skills, but who fits our culture of energy, integrity, and collaboration. If you’re someone who thrives on variety, enjoys creating great experiences, and brings warmth and structure to everything you do, we’d love to meet you.


**Recruitment is ongoing – we’re looking to fill the role as soon as possible, so don’t wait to apply!**


**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.
