title: Pre-Sales Engineer SaaS Industry (Technical Swedish Speaker)
description:
Since 2020, Semine has been building AI-driven technology designed to eliminate the repetitive, manual tasks that slow down accounting teams. By automating accounts payable processes and reducing administrative burden, Semine empowers finance professionals to focus on analysis, strategy, and value creation rather than data entry.
 



  





 In July 2025, Semine joined forces with Rydoo and is now a Rydoo company. Together, we are advancing a shared vision: simplifying financial operations through intelligent automation. By combining Semine’s AI expertise in accounts payable with Rydoo’s trusted expense management platform - used by more than one million users worldwide - we are creating a comprehensive, AI-powered solution that streamlines both expenses and payables in one seamless ecosystem.
 



  





 As a global team of more than 200 professionals, we believe technology should make complex processes simpler and more efficient. If you’re driven to build impactful solutions and shape the future of financial automation, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





**Rydoo / Semine in a snapshot** 



* Ambitious international team
* 33 nationalities speaking over 15 languages
* 240+ employees across multiple countries
* Easy-to-use spend management app available on iPhone and Android
* Supporting over 10,000+ clients and 1 million+ users worldwide
* 4.6 employer score on Glassdoor
* Hybrid work policy



  





**The Role** 




 As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you will act as the link between technology and business, helping prospects understand how Semine’s AI-powered finance automation platform can solve real operational challenges and drive growth. Working closely with Sales Executives across the Nordics, you will design and deliver tailored product demonstrations, showcase Semine’s value in measurable business terms, and clearly communicate how the platform integrates with ERP systems and other financial tools. By translating complex technical concepts into simple, visual, and customer-focused solutions, you will play a key role in supporting the sales process and enabling successful customer outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Deliver engaging and tailored product demonstrations that showcase Semine’s capabilities.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer dialogues and workshops.
* Collaborate with Sales Executives to build solution proposals that align with client needs and ERP environments.
* Answer technical and functional questions with clarity and confidence.
* Support pre-sales activities from qualification to closing, ensuring smooth handover to delivery.
* Represent Semine in client meetings, webinars, and industry events.



  





**Requirements** 



* Experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales support within SaaS or ERP.
* Strong understanding of finance, accounting, or ERP workflows.
* Proven ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both business and technical audiences.
* Excellent presentation skills, proactive mindset, and adaptability.
* Fluent in Swedish and English (Finnish is a big plus)



  





 To succeed in this role, you should be ambitious, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced growth environment. You are motivated by solving client problems, balancing technical accuracy with commercial goals, and contributing directly to Semine’s success.
 



  





**If you believe you’re a great fit and are excited to contribute to this journey, don’t hesitate to apply and help us take our growth to the next level.** 




  





**Benefits** 




 Next to our amazing team, informal & international company culture and our mission to become the number 1 spend and invoice management platform in Europe, we offer some nice benefits that make working at Rydoo / Semine even more fun:
 


* A competitive package, including salary and benefits

* Solid pension and insurance packages

title: Sektionschef applikationsutveckling
description:
Vill du leda skickliga medarbetare, driva teknisk utveckling och bidra till ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag? Hos oss leder du team i en verksamhet där teknik är en förutsättning för att samhället ska fungera. Du skapar riktning, engagemang och resultat i en miljö där utveckling och lärande står i fokus. Upptäck ett mångsidigt uppdrag!
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Som chef och ledare på Skatteverket ser du till helheten, skapar förutsättningar och agerar medvetet i vardagen. Tillsammans med andra arbetar du för att skapa värde med fokus på kunden, med grund i vårt samhällsbärande uppdrag. I ditt ledarskap möjliggör du utveckling och lärande genom att ge mandat och skapa stort handlingsutrymme; du förstärker och följer upp de beteenden och den kultur som behövs för att vi tillsammans ska kunna genomföra vårt uppdrag. Du förväntas agera och leda även om svaren inte är givna, vägvalen inte tydliga och arbetssätten inte självklara. Med mod och insikt utmanar du våra invanda tankesätt och arbetssätt och är själv öppen för att låta dig utmanas.
   

  

 I rollen som sektionschef kommer du att coacha högt tekniskt kompetenta medarbetare som jobbar med utveckling och underhåll av mjukvara. Som sektionschef har du medarbetaransvar. Det innebär att du har den dagliga dialogen med sektionens medarbetare, genomför avstämnings- och uppföljningssamtal, arbetar med medarbetarnas arbetsmiljö och kompetensutveckling med mera. Du ingår i enhetens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar till enhetschefen. Du bidrar i arbetet med att kontinuerligt utveckla styrningen och de strukturer som bygger upp leveransförmågan.
   

  

 Skatteverket utvecklar och förvaltar it-stöd i samverkan med andra myndigheter. Vi söker nu en chef och ledare som ska leda en sektion som ska utveckla och förvalta it-stöd åt andra myndigheter. Din placeringsort är antingen Sundbyberg eller Visby. Regelbundna resor mellan orterna ingår i uppdraget. Sektionen har ca 20 medarbetare, både anställda och konsulter.
   

  

 Vår verksamhet är i ständig utveckling och förändring. Vi har en gemensam syn på hur ledarskapet bidrar till det, hur vi når resultat och främjar en förändringskultur. Som chef och ledare hos oss är du med och driver utveckling av både verksamhet och ledarskap. Det är en självklarhet för oss att du ska ha balans mellan arbete och fritid.
   

  

**Om dig**
 För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss på Skatteverket behöver du vara lyhörd, tänka nytt och ta ansvar. I arbetet är gott omdöme och förståelse för rättssäkerhet och säkerhet viktigt. Du ska också leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.
   

  

**I Det Här Jobbet Ska Du**
* ha förmåga att se helheten med fokus på kundvärde
* ha förmåga att skapa rätt förutsättningar utifrån din förståelse för verksamhet och uppdrag
* ha förmåga att agera medvetet i vardagen utifrån en god självinsikt
* kunna hantera och analysera informationsflöden, se samband, avgränsa och förmedla information
* ha förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och skapa ett klimat där vi lyssnar på varandra.


**Du Ska Även Ha**
* relevant högskoleutbildning inom it/datavetenskap eller annan utbildning i kombination med arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivare bedömer som relevant för tjänsten
* flerårig, aktuell och relevant erfarenhet från ledande roller inom något av följande områden: it förvaltning, tjänsteutveckling, verksamhetsutveckling eller förändringsledning
* aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att leda medarbetare och konsulter med hög teknisk kompetens.


 Det är önskvärt att du har flerårig och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom systemutveckling. Det är även önskvärt att du har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet från stora och komplexa it-miljöer.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och kan inledas med provanställning i sex månader. Inom Skatteverket tillämpar vi chefsförordnanden på upp till fem år, med möjlighet till förlängning i perioder om högst tre år, utan begränsning i antal förlängningar.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 Skatteverkets it-avdelning arbetar aktivt för att främja en inkluderande arbetsplats som präglas av jämställdhet och mångfald där alla medarbetare får lika möjligheter att bidra och utvecklas. Läs mer på Jobba med it hos oss
   

  

 På skatteverket.se/jobb kan du exempelvis läsa om vår samhällsbärande roll, vår syn på ledarskap och hur det går till när du söker våra jobb.
   

  

 När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekryteringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Information Security Officer
description:
Paligo is hiring an Information Security Officer to run and strengthen our information security work day to day. Enterprise customers in 38 countries trust Paligo with their most critical content, and this role exists to keep that trust earned — from our ISO 27001-certified ISMS to the security foundations of our evolution into the AI Content Infrastructure for businesses.
 



 This is a hybrid position based out of our Stockholm office. Candidates must currently reside in Sweden and hold the legal right to work there. We are unable to sponsor work visas or offer relocation for this role.
 



  





**About Paligo** 




 Paligo is an industry-leading SaaS company in the component content management system (CCMS) space. Global teams at Amazon, Allianz, Mitsubishi, and the European Commission use our platform to create, manage, publish, and translate technical content.
 



 After having built a successful documentation authoring tool, Paligo is transforming into a foundational AI Content Infrastructure, ensuring enterprise AI is safe, compliant, and accurate by grounding it in the rich context distributed across diverse business sources.
 



  





**About the role** 




 You'll own the day-to-day operation of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) under ISO/IEC 27001:2022: audits and evidence, risk assessments, policies, awareness training, and the security questions our enterprise customers ask us every week.
 



 You'll report to the CTO, who sets security strategy with you and backs you with the mandate to get things done. At a company of under 100 people, that means hands-on work and real visibility from day one. It also means room to grow — this role is built to expand as your experience does, and as Paligo does.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Keep our ISO 27001:2022 ISMS running and improving: documentation, internal audits, evidence collection, and preparation for external audits.
* Maintain the risk register and run risk assessments across Paligo CCMS.
* Support security reviews of our AI grounding infrastructure and data pipelines together with engineering.
* Help secure our external AI offerings, including MCP and APIs for autonomous agents, with a focus on data exposure and access control.
* Own customer security questionnaires, due diligence requests, and vendor risk reviews.
* Support GDPR and contractual compliance work alongside Legal and product teams.
* Coordinate incident response and business continuity testing, and keep both plans current.
* Run security awareness training and build a security culture people actually engage with.
* Report on ISMS performance and open risks to the CTO and leadership team.



  





**What we're looking for** 




**Required** 



* 2–5 years of experience in information security, risk, or compliance, preferably at a SaaS or technology company.
* Hands-on experience working inside an ISO 27001 ISMS: audits, evidence, risk assessments, and policy maintenance.
* Working knowledge of cloud security in AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* The ability to translate security requirements for engineers and non-technical colleagues alike, and the confidence to hold the line when it matters.
* A degree in computer science, information technology, information security, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
* Professional fluency in English.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Exposure to compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, NIST CSF, PCI-DSS, CCPA, or HIPAA.
* Experience with GDPR and the EU AI Act
* Experience handling enterprise customer security questionnaires and vendor assessments.
* Familiarity with securing AI integrations via MCP and APIs.
* Prior exposure to component content management systems or similar content- and data-heavy platforms.
* Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CompTIA Security+, or progress toward CISM or CISSP.



  





**What we offer** 



* Real ownership early in your career: you run the ISMS at a profitable, growing company that enterprises depend on.
* A CTO who acts as your sponsor and sounding board, with direct access to leadership.
* A role designed to grow. This is our first dedicated security seat, and it expands as you and Paligo do.
* A front-row seat as we build AI grounding infrastructure for enterprises, where security is a core part of the product story.
* Competitive benefits, flexible working hours, and a hybrid setup based in Stockholm.
* A culture that takes work seriously and the rest of life seriously too.



  





**Ready to talk?** 




 If you want to own security at a platform enterprises worldwide depend on, and grow into the person who leads it, we'd like to hear from you.
 



 (The final step of our recruitment process is a mandatory background check, including a financial and criminal check. Any offer of employment is contingent on its successful completion.)

title: Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform
description:
Are you a people-focused data leader who knows how to turn customer and marketing data into business value?
   

  

 We're looking for an experienced Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform to join our Nordic Marketing Automation & MarTech team and lead our data and platform capabilities across the Nordic region.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong people leadership with hands-on experience in data, customer data platforms, marketing technology, and data-driven decision making.
   

  

**About the role | Lead our Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform capabilities**
 As Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform, you will lead a team of Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Developers as well as Platform Solution Architects and Platform Developers and play a key role in enabling our customer engagement, personalization, automation, and measurement agenda.
   

  

 You will together with the leader team set direction and priorities for the Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data and Platform roadmap and ensure that our data ecosystem supports both business needs and customer-centric experiences and that we utilize our platforms in the best possible way to enable all business units. An important part of your role will also be developing your team, creating clarity and direction, and enabling specialists to succeed.
   

  

 Your key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Developers as well as Platform Solution Architects and Platform Developers
* Together with leader team set direction and priorities for the Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data and Platform roadmap
* Ensure high-quality, compliant, and actionable customer and marketing data processes
* Ensure that our platform tech stack is utilized in the best possible way
* Drive improvements within reporting, measurement, and attribution
* Support the development and optimization of our customer data platform (CDP) capabilities
* Establish and strengthen best practices for data governance, quality, and privacy together with leader team and Delivery Manager
* Translate complex data opportunities and business needs into clear priorities and outcomes.


**About you | A people leader with a strong data and platform mindset**
 You combine strong people leadership with a solid understanding of data and platforms in modern marketing. You know how to set direction while giving specialists the autonomy they need to succeed, and you are comfortable working across teams, functions, and countries.
   

  

 We imagine that you:
   

  

* Have proven experience leading data and platform teams and previous people management responsibility
* Have a strong understanding of customer data, Marketing Automation, and MarTech ecosystems
* Have experience with areas such as CDPs, customer journeys, segmentation, and personalization
* Understand data governance, quality, privacy, and GDPR in a marketing context
* Are a strong stakeholder manager who can collaborate with and influence stakeholders at different levels
* Combine a strategic mindset with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach
* Are comfortable working in a Nordic organization and communicating professionally in English.


 Experience with Marketing Automation platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Dynamics 365, Braze, HubSpot, Eloqua, or similar is an advantage. The same applies to analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Google Analytics, as well as cloud data environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
   

  

**About us |** 
**Make a Nordic impact and work across borders as one team**
 This is an opportunity to shape how data enables customer engagement and marketing platforms effectiveness across the Nordics. You will lead a highly skilled team, influence strategic decisions, and help accelerate our Marketing Automation and MarTech transformation journey.
   

  

 You’ll be part of a Nordic team working across Ballerup, Stockholm and Bergen. Even though we’re based in different countries, we collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and solve challenges together.
   

  

 We’re not just running tools and data – we’re building capabilities. You’ll have real influence on how marketing technology and automation develop across the Nordics.
   

  

 As a growing team, there’s room to take responsibility, deepen your expertise, and help shape future solutions and ways of working. We value autonomy, flexibility, and a supportive environment where people enjoy working together and learning from each other.
   

  

**Curious?**
 Send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 13 September, as we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding the role, you are welcome to contact Petra Talamo, Head of Nordic Marketing Automation/MarTech, +46 70 168 28 63, petra.talamo@trygghansa.se.
   

  

**Fackliga representanter**

title: Integration Subpractice Leader
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Our Cloud & Custom Applications teams focuses on developing tailored cloud solutions, integrating IT systems, and driving business transformation, delivering business-critical results with quality and speed, powered by Generative AI. Capgemini’s Integration & API capability helps clients connect their digital core; applications, data, partners, and platforms, securely and at scale. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world!
 



  





**Your Role** 




 We are now looking for an Integration Subpractice Leader to join the leadership team of our Integration business line in Sweden. You will be essential in driving the growth of our Integration business and practice capacity. You will be the people manager for team managers across Stockholm, Göteborg, Helsingborg and Malmö. In your role you will collaborate with our Head of Integrations & APIs to, for example, co-shape our strategy. You will ensure progress in execution of practice growth in and alignment to market demands. As an expert in your field you will be a visible ambassador for our integration and API offerings, and a client-facing leader. You are strong in architecture and will lead and develop our delivery teams, while also contributing part-time in billable engagements.
 



  





**Lead & grow the Integration Subpractice in Sweden** 



* Lead, coach and develop team managers across multiple locations; set direction, priorities, and execution cadence.
* Drive capability and talent planning: hiring, onboarding, upskilling/certifications, and building communities of practice.
* Establish a clear operating rhythm across sites (delivery governance, staffing strategy, quality gates, and performance follow-up).
* Collaborate with Head of Integrations and APIs in strategy setting and aligning development of the subpractice.
* Take a leading role in transforming Capgemini’s Integration & API capability for the AI Agentic era, where integrations are no longer only system-to-system, but agent-to-agent, agent-to-system, and event-driven by AI.



  





**Ambassador & market maker for Integration and APIs** 



* Act as a visible spokesperson for Integration & API: promote the offering internally (cross-business collaboration) and externally (events, client briefings, thought leadership content).
* Work closely with Capgemini’s partner representatives to develop partnerships and co-selling motions; strengthen ecosystem collaboration.



  





**Build pipeline through proactive presales & bids** 



* Collaborate closely with the Integration CoE in creating pipeline via proactive client engagement and structured presales.
* Contribute with the integration perspective into bids: solution shaping, estimations, staffing approach, delivery model, risk management and value proposition.



  





**Client-facing advisory and delivery leadership** 



* Engage confidently with clients and senior stakeholders, present integration strategies, architectures, and roadmaps with executive presence.
* Lead billable deliveries part-time, guide delivery teams to outcomes with strong governance and predictable execution.
* Shape client services in line with Head of Integration and APIs’ visions such as integration assessment & strategy, integration foundation/reference architecture, and delivery-at-scale.



  





***In this role you will play a key role in:***



* Lead and grow the Integration Subpractice in Sweden, in close collaboration with the Head of Integrations & APIs, ensuring strategic alignment and coordinated development of the subpractice.
* Acting as an ambassador and market maker for Integration and API driven solutions.
* Driving pipeline growth through proactive pre-sales activities and bid work.
* Providing client facing advisory support and leading delivery engagements.



  





**Your profile** 



* Proven leadership experience as a people manager, ideally including manager-of-managers responsibility (leading team managers).
* Track record of building high-performing teams through coaching, development planning, recruitment support, and stakeholder management across sites.
* Experience or strong interest in applying
 *agentic AI concepts* 
 within modern integration landscapes. Understanding how Agentic AI enhances integration platforms by enabling autonomous orchestration, intelligent observability, and proactive issue resolution—shaping more adaptive, scalable, and resilient integration landscapes.
* Extensive hands-on experience in integration architecture & solution design across hybrid environments (cloud + SaaS + on-prem).
* Strong experience with hyperscalers: Azure, AWS and/or GCP (integration services, patterns, security, governance) and SaaS/iPaaS integration platforms such as Boomi, MuleSoft, Workato. Certifications in any of these are beneficial.
* Experience with open-source integration variants is highly valued.
* IBM integration platform knowledge is a plus.
* Ability to align and collaborate across business lines and internal ecosystems, strong stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication in English; Swedish is highly valuable for many local client engagements.
* Relevant degree or equivalent experience.



  





**What we believe you will enjoy about working here** 



* You will get the opportunity to lead and shape our national integration subpractice.
* Work with leading clients and build a strong integration community with partners and hyperscalers.
* You will combine leadership with meaningful involvement in client engagements, ensuring you stay close to architecture, technology, and real-world value creation.
* Collaborate directly with leading hyperscalers and technology partners, co‑create solutions, and shape the next generation of integration capabilities.



  





**Application** 




*We look forward to receiving your application and will review candidates on an ongoing basis. As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.* 




  





**About Capgemini** 




 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
 



**Make it real | www.capgemini.com**

title: Spännande möjligheter för Systemingenjörer hos Saab! (Evergreen)
description:
Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.
   

  

 Din roll
   

  

 I nära samarbete med engagerade kollegor kommer du att ställas inför varierande och utmanande uppgifter där du är med genom hela produktcykeln — från kravhantering och systemdesign till testning och implementering. Oavsett om du är i början av din karriär eller erfaren specialist är det viktigaste att du delar vår passion för utveckling och ny teknologi. Hos oss på kontoret i Solna erbjuder vi en bred variation av spännande möjligheter inom systemområdet, i en kultur som präglas av långsiktighet, förtroende och en genuin vilja att ha roligt tillsammans.
   

  

 Din profil
   

  

 Du trivs i tekniskt komplexa miljöer och gillar att arbeta brett — du kan gå på djupet i ett problem utan att tappa helheten ur sikte. Du är nyfiken av naturen, kommunicerar tydligt och ser samarbete som en självklarhet snarare än ett krav.
   

  

 Vi söker personer för roller som systemingenjörer, system-safety-specialister, IT-säkerhetsexperter samt test- och kravingenjörer. Har du kunskap inom något av dessa områden vill vi gärna lära känna dig.
   

  

 Det här behöver du ha:
   

  

* Relevant högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen
* Erfarenhet eller kunskap inom något av områdena: test, kravhantering, system-safety eller aerospace
* Förmåga att kommunicera och samarbeta effektivt i tvärfunktionella team
* Flytande svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift


 Meriterande:
   

  

* Erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin eller säkerhetskritiska system
* Kännedom om relevanta standarder inom system-safety eller IT-säkerhet


 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

 Vad innebär en spontanansökan?
   

  

 Detta är en öppen ansökan för dig som är nyfiken på vår verksamhet i Solna. Om du vill bli en del av vår framtida resa är du varmt välkommen att skicka in en spontanansökan. Genom att göra det visar du att du är öppen för jobbmöjligheter hos oss — och om vi längre fram får in en roll som stämmer överens med din bakgrund och dina intressen, kan vi komma att kontakta dig. Vi vill dock tydliggöra att en spontanansökan inte är detsamma som att söka en tjänst. För att maximera dina möjligheter uppmanar vi dig att visa oss vad som lockar dig mest, genom att aktivt söka de specifika tjänster som du är intresserad av!
   

  

 Du kan alltid dra tillbaka din spontanansökan genom att logga in på din Workday-profil. Läs mer om dina rättigheter och hur du kontaktar Saabs dataskyddsombud här.
   

  

 Vad blir du en del av
   

  

 Bakom våra innovationer finns alla de som har gjort det möjligt. Modiga pionjärer och kluriga tänkare. Vardagshjältar och kreativa problemlösare. De som delar djup kunskap och de som utforskar nya områden. Och alla däremellan.
   

  

 Här har du chansen att påverka och bidra på ditt unika sätt. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. Vi ger dig möjlighet att anta utmaningar och skapa smarta innovationer. I vår vänliga och tekniksmarta värld finns plats för dig att växa. Vi finns här för att tillsammans skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

title: Agentic Identity Sales Specialist
description:
Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden Sales Ref ID: JR-021443  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


Idira, part of Palo Alto Networks, are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Agentic Identity Security business in Sweden, Finland and the Baltics.


The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment at scale, thrive in driving innovation, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.


**Your Responsibilities:**


* Work with a regional sales team to establish and maintain customer relationships at the executive and business decisionmaker level including but not limited to CISO, CIO, and other executives responsible for DevOps, Secrets Management, Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance. Hold regional responsibility for meeting and exceeding established sales quota associated with Idira’s Secrets Management and Agentic Identity solutions.
* Develop & present compelling business cases to customers, maintain expert-level knowledge of all elements of the business case, including the drivers of cost, benefits, and risk.
* Partner closely with subject matter experts, solutions engineers, and professional services teams to align the technology architecture to the customer's desired business outcomes.
* Work closely with post sales teams to ensure successful product adoption and realisation of the full value of customer’s technology investment.
* Work with channel partners, resellers and systems integrators to penetrate new accounts and extend reach of Idira’s Secrets Management and Agentic Identity solutions in the assigned geography.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise level accounts. Experience as an overlay sales specialist is a bonus.
* Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Vi växer och söker fler härliga kollegor som vill vara med och skapa moderna, stabila och kvalitativa digitala lösningar tillsammans med oss.  

  

  



Hos oss blir du en del av ett tryggt och etablerat bolag med ett starkt team där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kvalitet står i fokus. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och utvecklar och förvaltar lösningar som gör verklig skillnad – från nya digitala tjänster till vidareutveckling av verksamhetskritiska system.  

  

  



Nu söker vi en erfaren testledare/mjukvarutestare som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för kvalitetssäkring i komplexa IT-miljöer. Du får en viktig roll i att säkerställa kvalitet, stabilitet och regelefterlevnad, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att påverka både teststrategier, arbetssätt och den fortsatta utvecklingen av testförmågan.


Trivs du med att kombinera strategiskt testarbete med operativ testning? Är du van att driva kvalitet framåt i agila utvecklingsmiljöer och att samarbeta med både utveckling, verksamhet och externa leverantörer? Då kan det här vara helt rätt nästa steg för dig.  

  

  



**Om rollen**


Som testledare/mjukvarutestare blir du en central del i arbetet med kvalitetssäkring inom både projekt och förvaltning. Du kommer att arbeta brett med testning och kvalitet, från planering och koordinering till praktiskt genomförande och uppföljning.


Du ansvarar för att planera, leda och följa upp testarbete och tar fram teststrategier, testplaner och testfall. Du koordinerar testaktiviteter tillsammans med utveckling, verksamhet och externa leverantörer och säkerställer att testningen bedrivs strukturerat och effektivt.


Rollen är både strategisk och operativ. Du kommer själv att genomföra manuell testning och samtidigt bidra till automatiserad testning. Du arbetar aktivt med felrapportering och kvalitetssäkringsprocesser och ser till att det finns tydlig spårbarhet mellan krav, testfall och testresultat.


Du blir också en viktig part i kravarbete och bidrar med ett tydligt test- och kvalitetsperspektiv redan tidigt i utvecklingsprocessen. Vidare rapporterar du teststatus, risker och kvalitetsläget till projektledning och styrning samt bidrar till att utveckla och förbättra testmetodik och arbetssätt.


Du kommer att arbeta i en agil miljö och vara en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team där flera olika kompetenser tillsammans driver utveckling och förvaltning framåt.  

  

  



**Vi söker dig som**


* Har minst 5 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av mjukvarutestning sedan 2020
* Har minst 3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet i rollen som testledare sedan 2020
* Har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att ta fram teststrategier, testplaner och testfall
* Har erfarenhet av både funktionell och icke-funktionell testning
* Har erfarenhet av testning i agila utvecklingsmiljöer, exempelvis Scrum eller SAFe
* Har förmåga att samarbeta med olika roller och intressenter och att kommunicera kvalitet, risker och testresultat på ett tydligt sätt

**Det är meriterande om du har**


* Minst 3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av testning i komplexa systemlandskap med flera integrationer
* Minst 3 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av testning i säkerhetskritiska system eller system med höga krav på dataskydd

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
Optinova is more than a manufacturer of tubing – we are experts in advanced extrusion and material technologies. Our products are used where quality and precision are critical: IV catheters, infusion sets, small catheter systems, as well as components for coffee machines and aerospace technology.
  
  

Our global headquarters is located in Åland, Finland. We operate production facilities across three continents and have sales offices worldwide. We develop solutions together with our customer with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and reliability, we create the solutions of tomorrow.
  
  

Optinova is embarking on an exciting digital transformation journey, strengthening how we use data, technology, and AI to improve our operations and create business value.
  
  

We are looking for Data Platform Engineers to join our Digital Value Services function. You will contribute to the development of data platforms, digital services, and applications that support business processes, analytics, automation, and future AI capabilities.
  
  

This is a broad engineering role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of business and technology. The role offers opportunities to develop toward areas such as AI engineering and forward-deployed engineering. What You’ll Do
  
  

Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, integrations, data products, and platform capabilities.
  
  

Collaborate with business-stream process owners and stakeholders to productize business challenges into scalable and reliable digital services and products.
  
  

Develop domain-driven data products based on data mesh principles, supporting clear ownership, reusability, interoperability, and trusted access to data.
  
  

Deliver solutions iteratively using an agile mindset, incorporating feedback and adapting to evolving business needs and priorities.
  
  

Apply modern engineering practices, including DevOps and DataOps, while supporting quality, security, governance, documentation, and compliance throughout the solution lifecycle.
  
  

Explore how data, AI, and automation can solve business problems and create measurable value.
  
  

What We’re Looking For
  
  

You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field. Equivalent knowledge gained through practical experience is also relevant.
  
  

You have experience or a strong foundation in some of the following areas:
  
  

SQL, Python, or similar programming languages
  
  

Data & AI pipelines, integrations, APIs, and automation
  
  

Cloud data platforms, data modelling, and data products
  
  

Software development and deployment practices
  
  

Experience with Azure, Databricks, Power BI, or similar technologies is beneficial, but we do not expect you to be an expert in every area.
  
  

**You are also:**  

Able to work with technical and non-technical stakeholders, clarify requirements, and communicate solutions clearly.
  
  

Collaborative, curious, and motivated by solving real business problems.
  
  

Comfortable taking ownership and delivering iteratively as needs and priorities evolve.
  
  

Fluent in English. Swedish or other relevant language skills are considered an advantage.
  
  

Experience in manufacturing, ERP systems, regulated industries, AI, machine learning, or business-facing technical delivery is considered beneficial.
  
  

Why Join Us?
  
  

Play an active role in Optinova’s digital transformation journey.
  
  

Work across data platforms, digital services, applications, automation, analytics, and AI.
  
  

Develop toward different technical career paths based on your capabilities and interests.
  
  

Join a culture that values collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and employee wellbeing.
  
  

Location
  
  

The role can be based at our headquarters in Mariehamn, Åland, or at our office in Uppsala, Sweden.
  
  

**Compensation:**  

The salary range (3800-5000€ or 40,000 - 50,000 SEK) has been established based on the role's requirements and current market conditions. Placement within the range is determined by relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. If a candidate brings substantial additional experience, specialist expertise, or qualifications that exceed the requirements, compensation above the stated range may be considered.
  
  

We welcome your application!
  
  

**Please note:** We do not accept applications via email. Applications must be submitted through the application link only.
  
  

Please answer the questions in the application form and submit your CV. The deadline for applications is 15.09.2026 but we may begin interviewing during the application period. Please share a link to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or other examples of your technical work. Candidates progressing to the second interview stage will be asked to share and demonstrate their technical and programming capabilities.
  
  

For questions about the position, please contact People&Culture Business Partner Nadia Elamidi nadia.elamidi@optinova.com
  
  

If you are not a citizen of an EU/EEA country or Switzerland, you will need to present a valid work and residence permit at a potential interview.
  
  

Optinova is more than a tubing manufacturer — we are experts in advanced extrusion and material technologies. Our products are used in applications where quality and precision are critical. Our global headquarters is located in Åland, Finland. We operate production across three continents and have sales offices worldwide. By developing solutions together with our customers, with a strong focus on innovation, quality, and reliability, we create the solutions of tomorrow.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Smart Eye is leading the global market for Driver Monitoring Systems, which has become a standard component in every car. Monitoring the driver behavior is safety critical both for normal driving as well as for autonomous driving. We are constantly growing and are now looking for a Senior Project Managers who want to join our team.
  
  

Your Role
  
  

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of advanced Interior Sensing software programs for global automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers. This role serves as the primary interface between customers and internal cross-functional teams, ensuring customer commitments are met while maintaining alignment with company priorities, technical capabilities, and business objectives. You bring structure and clarity to complex automotive software programs while helping teams navigate uncertainty and change.
  
  

You will be leading one or more of our developer teams, communicating with the customers and other internal stakeholders as well as setting the priorities for the team.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Customer Program Leadership
  
  

Act as the primary program management contact for assigned OEM and Tier-1 customers, leading meetings, reviews, milestones, and issue resolution.
  
Build trusted customer relationships and manage expectations while balancing internal resources and business priorities.
  
Ensure clear alignment between customer requirements, commitments, and internal execution.
  
  

Program Planning & Execution
  
  

Develop and manage program plans, schedules, deliverables, risks, budgets, and customer commitments.
  
Coordinate cross-functional execution across Engineering, Product Owners, Validation, Data Management, and Customer Support.
  
Proactively identify execution risks and resource conflicts, driving mitigation and timely delivery of releases, demos, and evaluations.
  
  

Risk & Issue Management
  
  

Proactively identify, communicate, and manage program risks, dependencies, and roadblocks.
  
Lead customer escalations and drive timely, solution-oriented resolution of issues.
  
Facilitate decision-making and ensure closure of critical actions.
  
  

Requirements & Change Management
  
  

Coordinate customer requirements, feature requests, and change requests together with Product and Sales.
  
Assess impact on scope, schedule, and resources, ensuring commitments and changes are documented and communicated.
  
Support configuration management and release planning.
  
  

Communication & Reporting
  
  

Provide clear and concise program status updates to customers and internal leadership.
  
Translate complex technical topics into business-oriented communication.
  
Maintain executive-level reporting and program documentation covering status, risks, opportunities, and key decisions.
  
  

**Your qualifications:**  

At least Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technical Management, or a related field.
  
5+ years of automotive project/program management, including customer-facing software development programs.
  
Proven experience working with OEM and Tier-1 customers and managing multiple complex projects.
  
Strong understanding of automotive development processes and product lifecycle management.
  
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  
Ability to perform effectively in fast-paced customer environments and proficiency with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, MS Project, or similar.
  
  

Interviews are held on a continuous basis, so we highly recommend that you submit your application at your earliest convenience. Welcome with your application.
  
  

Smart Eye is the global leader in Human Insight AI, technology that understands, supports and predicts human behavior in complex environments. Together with our subsidiaries Affectiva and iMotions, we are bridging the gap between humans and machines for a safe and sustainable future.
  
  

Today, our technology is embedded in next-generation vehicles, leading the way towards human-centric mobility through Driver Monitoring Systems and Interior Sensing solutions. Our Research Instruments offer unparalleled insights into automotive, aviation, assistive technology, behavioral science and many more fields.
  
  

Visit www.smarteye.ai for more information.

Vi söker en **Agile coach** för ett uppdrag som utförs i **Sverige**


**Uppdragsbeskrivning:**


Vi söker en erfaren agile coach som ska ingå i coreteamet i ett transformationsprojekt och driva den agila förflyttningen. Rollen innebär att bygga agil mognad i organisationen genom utbildning, coaching av team och nära stöd till projektledningen i arbetet med att forma och genomföra planen för den agila omställningen.


Du kommer att arbeta nära projektledning, produktägare, teamledare och medlemmar i de agila teamen för att säkerställa att arbetssätten förändras och lever i vardagen. Transformationen befinner sig i ett skede där grundläggande förståelse och praktisk förmåga behöver byggas parallellt, vilket kräver någon som kan växla mellan att utbilda, coacha och stötta strategiskt beslutsfattande. Uppdraget passar dig som trivs med att kombinera pedagogiskt ledarskap med praktisk coaching på teamnivå.


**Huvudsakliga uppgifter & ansvar:**


* Ingå i projektets coreteam och driva den agila förflyttningen tillsammans med projektledningen.
* Planera och genomföra utbildningar i agila arbetssätt, ramverk och principer för team, produktägare och ledning.
* Coacha agila team i deras dagliga arbete – ceremonier, samarbetsformer, kontinuerlig förbättring och mognad över tid.
* Stötta projektledningen i att ta fram och justera planen för den agila omställningen samt fungera som bollplank i frågor om arbetssätt och förändringstakt.
* Identifiera hinder för agil mognad, föreslå konkreta åtgärder och anpassa coachingen efter olika mognadsnivåer.
* Bidra till att skapa gemensamt språk och förståelse för agila principer tvärs igenom projektet.
* Stötta produktägare i backlog-hantering, prioritering och samarbete med teamen.
* Följa upp och synliggöra effekter av den agila omställningen, och justera insatser därefter.

**Kvalifikationer**


**Ska-krav**


* Flerårig erfarenhet som agile coach, Scrum Master, produktägare eller motsvarande i större transformationsprojekt.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utbilda i och coacha team i agile ramverk (t.ex. Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
* God förståelse för agil transformation på både team- och organisationsnivå (inte enbart ceremonier och roller).
* Erfarenhet av att stötta projektledning i att forma och driva förändringsplaner.
* Stark pedagogisk förmåga och vana att möta grupper med olika förkunskaper.
* Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska, både muntligt och skriftligt.
* Vana att arbeta nära projektledning, produktägare och team samtidigt.
* God förståelse för hur agilt arbete samspelar med traditionell projektstyrning i hybridmiljöer.
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av Azure DevOps-konfiguration samt praktiskt arbete med backloghantering (strategisk, taktisk och operativ), planering och uppföljning i verktyget.

**BÖR-krav (Meriterande)**


* Erfarenhet från större IT-transformationer eller digitaliseringsprogram.
* Erfarenhet av skalade agila ramverk (t.ex. SAFe eller LeSS).
* Erfarenhet av att bygga upp agila coach-team eller Communities of Practice.
* Erfarenhet från energi-, industri- eller andra IT/OT-nära branscher.
* Certifieringar inom agila ramverk (t.ex. SPC, CSP, PMI-ACP).

**Personliga egenskaper:**


* Vi söker dig som är pedagogisk, trygg och van att möta motstånd med nyfikenhet snarare än konfrontation. Du har förmåga att anpassa ditt sätt att coacha efter olika individer och team, och du ser förändring som en process snarare än ett tillstånd att uppnå en gång för alla.
* Du är lyhörd men tydlig, och kan balansera stöttande coaching med att utmana när det behövis. Rollen kräver god samarbetsförmåga med många olika intressenter, hög integritet och ett genuint engagemang för att hjälpa både individer och organisationen att växa i sitt agila arbetssätt.

**Anställningsform**


Vi erbjuder två möjligheter:


* Fast anställning hos oss på RPS Software AB
* Samarbete som underkonsult (om du har eget bolag)

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a **Senior AI Platform Engineer** to design, build, and operate a production-grade AI platform within a complex enterprise environment.


In this role, you will take end-to-end technical ownership of the AI platform, including AI gateway engineering, governance, agent management, access control, cost telemetry, observability, and developer enablement.  The engineering platform team builds and operates EQT’s core platform, enabling product teams to run secure, reliable, and scalable services, data-products and agentic ai. The team works closely with developers and security partners, with a strong focus on automation, standards, and operational excellence.

* Lead the design, architecture, and rollout of platform projects from start to finish.

* Operate and continuously improve the engineering platform.

* Hands-on experience running Kubernetes production environments.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

* Strong networking knowledge across cloud and Kubernetes environments.

title: Senior Linux Platform Engineer
description:
**About Kambi** 




*Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end-to-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners.* 




*Our vision is to create the world’s leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners.* 




 Do you want to join a growing team responsible for the layer between hardware and applications?
 



 Kambi are in the middle of a DevOps transformation and are building a sustainable organisation for the future. For our Engineering Operations department, we are searching an experienced Linux Infrastructure Engineer with automation skills. We are looking for people who are passionate to learning modern technologies, thrives when collaborating with others, have an agile mindset and are solution oriented.
 



**Who are we?** 




 Engineering Operations supports the infrastructure of the organisation and the success of our partners. We ensure a stable environment twenty-four seven,year-round and we like open source in all flavours. We are dedicated to agile operations, believe dev-ops and automation are great ways of achieving that, whilst using agile methodologies to support our efforts along the road.
 



 We thrive in collaborative, ever-changing environment where we are using the collective resources of the team to meet objectives and find the best solution together.
 



**The role** 




 In this role, you’ll build and maintain on-prem infrastructure with a wide variety of technologies around the globe. You’ll do this by delivering reliable, scalable, and universally available systems.
 



 Technologies we are working with today include Ubuntu, Debian, infrastructure services (DNS, DHCP, NTP), globally hosted servers,
   

 virtualization (KVM), storage (Ceph), monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), automation (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform, GitHub Actions - reusable workflows) and private cloud environments, alongside our on-prem infrastructure.
 



**Who are you?** 




 We’re looking for a solution-oriented team player with a solid background in Linux. It is also beneficial if you have experience with infrastructure automation, basic understanding of networking (such as dynamic routing, data centre switching, site-to-site VPNs) and a “security first" approach.
 



 An agile mindset is crucial for us, and additionally experience working with Ubuntu, Debian and Puppet profiles would be a great fit within this team.
 



**You will like us if you:** 



* Think code & automation is the right way to evolve infrastructure.
* Driven and motivated to find the best solution to the problem at hand.

title: Senior Software Platform Engineer
description:
**Do you want to join the technological revolution? Tendium is looking for a
 *Senior Software Engineer* 
 to join the Platform team.**
**About Tendium**
 Tendium is the global pioneer in AI-driven public tender management, transforming how companies discover, analyze, and win government contracts. Our platform turns complex processes into something simple and transparent, empowering businesses to compete fairly for billions in public sector opportunities. We’ve been building our AI-native platform since 2018, leveraging a vast data moat, agentic AI, and tens of thousands of hours of R&D. Today, we serve large numbers of customers across Europe and are rapidly scaling.
   

  

 If you’re ready to make an impact and grow with us, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

 Our Platform team has a broad and exciting ownership. As a member of our Platform team you will build foundational services that all our features need, security and developer experience as well as being in the forefront of AI development. You will make sure that we have the AI tooling we need to build with both speed and quality, and that our platform is secure and easy to monitor and work with. This is a role where you will spend time on building our product and internal tools as well as building SRE guidelines and best practices cross-team. The whole tech organisation consists of approximately 20 engineers split into different teams, where everyone knows each other.
   

  

 Tech stack
   

  

* Microservice Architecture: Fargate, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, GraphQL, OpenAPI
* Databases and Querying: DocumentDB (MongoDB), MySQL, S3Tables (Iceberg), OpenSearch, Athena
* Languages: Python, TypeScript
* Infrastructure and platform: CDK, Github Actions
* Observability and tooling: CloudWatch, Aikido, PostHog
* AI Tooling: Claude Code, Internal MCP Server


**What You'll Bring**
**Infrastructure and platform:** 
 Hands-on experience with AWS (or equivalent cloud). Containerization (Docker), Infrastructure as Code (CDK or Terraform), and CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions).
   

  

**Site reliability and operations:** 
 Experience defining and tracking SLOs/SLIs, leading incident response, and writing postmortems. Comfortable structuring production-grade environments — multi-environment setups, security and access standards — and turning that knowledge into guidelines other teams can adopt.
   

  

**Cloud micro services:** 
 Hands-on experience building and maintaining micro service architectures using AWS services such as SQS, Lambda, Fargate/ECS (or close equivalents in another cloud).
   

  

**API design and development:** 
 Hands-on experience designing and maintaining APIs, including REST (OpenAPI) and GraphQL, with a focus on consistency, versioning, and developer experience.
   

  

**Observability & Reliability:** 
 Setting up and using monitoring/alerting tools (Datadog, Grafana, Aikido). Log aggregation and distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch)
   

  

**Software engineering:** 
 Strong proficiency in Python (or similar), including writing robust, testable, and maintainable code; familiarity with async programming patterns.
   

  

**AI Tooling:** 
 Integrates AI tooling effectively into daily workflows.
   

  

**Collaboration and communication:** 
 You enjoy collaborating both with your nearest team and with other teams. You are comfortable sharing knowledge and best practices.
   

  

**Based in Stockholm** 
 , within commuting distance from our office in central Stockholm.
   

  

 We offer hybrid flexibility while requiring the ability to commute daily to our Stockholm office.
   

  

 Application
   

  

**We work from the office the majority of the time and require the ability to commute daily to our Stockholm office.**
**Please note:** 
 At the moment we are not able to sponsor VISA applications, so you need to have the right to work in Sweden.
   

  

**We look forward to your application. We recruit on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible.** 
 To make this process even more efficient, feel free to sign in to your Connect profile and add your references at any stage.
   

  

 Please find additional information on our recruitment process
 *here.*
 If you want to know more about our culture and what you can expect when working at Tendium you can read more about it
 *here.*
**Equality and inclusion statement**
 At Tendium, we don’t just value diversity, we celebrate it. We’re building a workplace where everyone should feel that they belong, where your voice is heard, and your experiences are respected. Different perspectives fuel our creativity and drive innovation, and we’re always looking for people who can bring something new to the team. Whoever you are, wherever you're from, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s shape the future together.
   

  

 At Tendium we’re using data to transform public procurement, giving our clients better access to public tenders and helping governments to curb waste and enhance transparency.
   

  

 For more information contact career@tendium.com

title: Linux & Plattformsspecialist (Kubernetes / IBM-miljö)
description:

Du bidrar med din expertis inom systemadministration, nätverk och databaser, samt stöttar i tekniska vägval kopplade till plattform, säkerhet och licenshantering.

 I denna roll arbetar du med drift, förvaltning och utveckling av en komplex IT-miljö där stabilitet, säkerhet och prestanda är centralt. Du blir en nyckelperson i att säkerställa att plattformar och system fungerar effektivt och hållbart över tid.

title: Driftansvarig Azure (Senior)
description:

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
**Machine Learning Engineer - Stockholm** 




  





**Om eghed** 




 eghed är en expertgrupp med en stark passion för att skapa framtidens AI-lösningar. Vi är ett innovativt team med ett stort teknikintresse och en entreprenörsanda som genomsyrar allt vi gör. Genom nära samarbeten med våra partners, både ute hos kund och in-house, utvecklar vi lösningar som inte bara möter dagens behov utan också öppnar dörrar till morgondagens möjligheter. Vi har redan utvecklat egen IP som gör våra leveranser snabbare, och vi söker ständigt nya sätt att flytta gränserna för vad som är möjligt.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 I den här rollen kommer du att arbeta i varierande tekniska miljöer och verksamhetskontexter. Vi söker ingenjörer som har en djup förståelse för grunderna inom ML och engineering och som kan tillämpa dem i olika technology stacks. Om du är technology-agnostic, anpassningsbar och drivs av grundläggande principer snarare än specifika verktyg uppmuntrar vi dig att söka.
 



  





**Dina ansvarsområden kan omfatta** 




 Designa ML system och arkitekturer som täcker hela livscykeln: data pipelines, training infrastructure, model serving och monitoring. Göra arkitektoniska avvägningar utifrån skalbarhet, latency, kostnad och maintainability i production environments.
 



 Driftsätta och underhålla production ML systems i olika miljöer och utifrån varierande krav, med fokus på reliability, performance optimization och best practices för deployment, såsom "canary releases", A/B testing, rollback strategies och CI/CD integration.
 



 Bidra med tekniskt ledarskap genom code reviews, arkitekt diskussioner och mentoring. Vara länken mellan tekniska och affärsmässiga stakeholders genom att översätta komplexa ML-koncept till konkreta insikter och strategiska rekommendationer.
 



 Hjälpa både oss och våra partners att optimera processer, identifiera trender och utveckla data-drivna processer och strategier för tillväxt och innovation.
 



  





**Vi tror att du** 




 Har minst tre års erfarenhet som ML Engineer.
 



 Har en universitetsexamen inom ett tekniskt och kvantitativt område, exempelvis matematik, fysik, Software Development eller Engineering.
 



 Har mycket god förmåga att kommunicera i tal och skrift, både med tekniska och icke-tekniska målgrupper. Du har en stark förmåga inom kommunikation, organisation och teamwork, kombinerat med god business acumen. Du pratar svenska.
 



 Trivs i en dynamisk och snabbrörlig miljö där du får frihet att tänka stort och skapa lösningar i stor skala.
 



 Vill bidra till företagets framgång och tillväxt samt har en tydlig entreprenörsanda.
 



  





**Varför eghed?** 




 På eghed får du inte bara ett jobb – du får möjlighet att följa med på en resa där du kan påverka och skapa verklig förändring. Vi är ett team som värdesätter innovation, samarbete och en hälsosam dos nytänkande. Här får du utrymme att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt, och vi ser fram emot att ta del av dina idéer och visioner för framtiden.
 



  





**Ansökan** 




 Låter det här som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vårt team!

title: Server Consultant
description:
På Advania Managed Services Provider arbetar vi nära kunder inom både privat och offentlig sektor. Nu söker vi dig med erfarenhet av Windows Server, Azure och Entra ID som vill fortsätta utvecklas tekniskt och samtidigt ta ett större ansvar i kunduppdragen.
   

  

 Här får du arbeta i komplexa miljöer, bidra med tekniska rekommendationer och utvecklas tillsammans med både kunder och erfarna kollegor.
   

  

 Server Consultant på Advania 🚀
   

  

 Inom Managed Services Provider hjälper vi kunder inom privat och offentlig sektor med drift och utveckling av deras IT miljöer.
   

  

 Som Server Consultant arbetar du framför allt med Windowsbaserade servermiljöer och omkringliggande infrastruktur. Operations är en central del av rollen och du driver incidenter, förändringar och requests från start till mål.
   

  

 Du lär känna kundens miljö och behov, gör tekniska avvägningar och bidrar med rekommendationer som för arbetet framåt. Rollen innebär också att du tar ansvar för den tekniska riktningen i dina uppdrag och ser till att leveransen håller hög kvalitet.
   

  

**Du Arbetar Bland Annat Med Att**
* driva incidenter, förändringar och requests
* arbeta med Windows Server
* arbeta med Active Directory och Group Policy
* hantera Azure och Entra ID
* genomföra tekniska förbättringar
* bidra i projekt och lösningsdesign
* ge teknisk rådgivning


 När du lär känna kundernas miljöer på djupet får du också möjlighet att bidra till standardisering, modernisering och fortsatt utveckling.
   

  

 Vad vi söker hos dig ✨
   

  

 Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av serverdrift eller infrastruktur och som är trygg i att arbeta nära kund.
   

  

 Du är van att göra tekniska bedömningar, kommunicera tydligt och driva ditt arbete framåt med god struktur och kvalitet. Du planerar och prioriterar självständigt inom uppdragets ramar och vet när du ska driva en fråga vidare själv och när det är bättre att ta hjälp av en kollega eller specialist.
   

  

**Du Har**
* minst fem års erfarenhet av serverdrift eller infrastruktur
* gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av Windows Server
* erfarenhet av Active Directory och Group Policy
* erfarenhet av Azure och Entra ID
* erfarenhet av kundnära arbete
* flytande svenska och god teknisk engelska
* relevant IT utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet


 Erfarenhet av VMware är meriterande. Det är också meriterande om du har kunskap inom exempelvis Linux, automation, molntjänster, säkerhet eller containers. Certifieringar inom Microsoft Server, Azure eller VMware är meriterande men inget krav.
   

  

 För oss innebär senioritet att kunna kombinera tekniskt djup med ansvar i uppdraget. Du ska inte behöva välja mellan att fortsätta utvecklas tekniskt och att ta ett större ansvar. Här kan du fortsätta vara nära tekniken samtidigt som du utvecklas inom rådgivning, projekt, standardisering, modernisering och lösningsdesign.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋
   

  

 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".
   

  

 Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.
   

  

 Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.
   

  

 Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.
   

  

 I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.
   

  

 Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.
   

  

 Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Senior Engineering Manager** 




 Lead the teams building the governed knowledge layer for enterprise AI.
 



 Paligo is hiring a Senior Engineering Manager to lead two product teams: the CCMS that hundreds of enterprise customers depend on today, and a newly formed team building our AI-native product for enterprise content governance. One mature, one greenfield — and you'll hold both.
 



 This is a hybrid position based out of our Stockholm office. Candidates must currently reside in Sweden and hold the legal right to work there. We are unable to sponsor work visas or offer relocation for this role.
 



  





**About Paligo** 




 Paligo is an industry-leading SaaS company in the Component Content Management Systems (CCMS) space. Global teams at Amazon, Allianz, Mitsubishi, and the European Commission use our platform to create, manage, publish, and translate technical content. We're profitable, growing, and now building the next layer of the business on top of that foundation, a governed knowledge layer that lets organizations ground their enterprise AI in content they can actually trust.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Paligo is at a defining moment: we're evolving from a best-in-class CCMS into an AI content intelligence platform. This role sits right at the center of that.
 



 Your job is to create an environment where engineers do their best work, where trust is high, expectations are clear, and people feel genuinely empowered to take ownership. You'll do that across two very different mandates:
 



 Paligo CCMS — the core product. A sophisticated authoring and publishing system used by technical writing teams worldwide. Here the mandate is operational excellence and thoughtful evolution: keep it performing for the customers who rely on it, drive a steady improvement roadmap, and sustain the engineering culture that keeps a mature system reliable and maintainable.
 



  





 The AI-native product. A new product that reimagines the content lifecycle for the AI era. Where the CCMS serves technical writers, this one targets organizations that need to govern and validate the content feeding their AI systems. It's AI-native from the ground up: agents do the heavy lifting of ingestion, tagging, and transformation, while human decision-makers judge what meets the trust standard for the knowledge graph. You'll help build this team from early stages, shape its engineering culture, and be a real technical partner in turning a bold vision into a working system.
 



  





 You'll bring a strong technical background — contributing through code, architecture, and review, and serving as a grounded technical voice in product and design conversations. You'll also lead how we adopt AI-assisted development: agent-assisted coding, AI SDLC tooling, and the practical work of figuring out what good engineering looks like when autonomous agents are part of the daily workflow. Budget and resourcing decisions are made in close partnership with the CTO.
 



  





 This is a leadership role for someone who cares as much about people as about craft, and finds meaning in both.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Attract, develop, and retain talented engineers who want to do meaningful work at a company that's genuinely evolving.
* Contribute hands-on through coding, architecture discussions, and code review — staying close enough to the work that your guidance is grounded and your team feels supported.
* Bring a clear technical perspective to product and design conversations, helping teams decide with confidence.
* Lead the adoption of AI-assisted development practices: agent-assisted coding workflows, AI SDLC tooling, and thoughtful integration of autonomous agents into how the team works.
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1-1s, honest feedback, and growth plans that reflect what each person actually wants.
* Drive technical excellence on the CCMS — performance, reliability, and clean evolution without disrupting the customers who depend on it.
* Build the new product team from the ground up: hiring, onboarding, and establishing the engineering foundations it needs to thrive.
* Own the delivery process, and keep evolving how we work to suit a team where AI agents are part of the workflow.



  





**What we're looking for** 




**We know strong candidates don't always tick every box. If this role excites you and you bring most of what's below, we'd encourage you to apply.** 




  





**Required** 



* 7+ years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading and growing engineering teams.
* Practical experience with AI-assisted development — using LLMs in engineering workflows, building AI-integrated products, or working out what the AI SDLC looks like in practice.
* Deep familiarity with modern web stacks, backend development, and cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS).
* Comfort working directly in the codebase alongside the teams you lead.
* The ability to navigate ambiguity — holding steady on a greenfield product and a mature product at the same time.
* A track record of raising engineering standards: quality, testing, documentation, deployment practices.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Professional fluency in English.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with TypeScript, Go, Rust, Python and/or PHP.
* Experience building products where AI agents do meaningful work in production, not just in demos.
* Experience in a fast-paced company mid-transformation.



  





**Who this is for** 




 You'll do well here if you're energized rather than unsettled by holding two different jobs at once, protecting something mature while building something that doesn't exist yet. You lead through trust rather than process, you'd rather stay close to the code than manage from a distance, and you're curious about what engineering leadership actually means now that agents are in the workflow. There's a lot of room to leave your mark here, and that prospect appeals to you.
 



  





**What we offer** 



* Two teams, two mandates, and genuine influence over how Paligo's next product gets built.
* A growing company where the transformation is real work rather than a slide deck.
* Close partnership with the CTO, and the autonomy to shape how your teams work.
* Competitive benefits, flexible working hours, and a hybrid setup based in Stockholm. In-person collaboration matters to us, especially while the new team is forming.
* A culture that takes work seriously and the rest of life seriously too.



  





**Our commitment to inclusion** 




 We believe the best teams are built from diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Paligo is an equal-opportunity employer, and we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels genuinely welcome. We especially encourage applications from women, people from underrepresented groups in technology, and anyone who took a non-traditional path to get here. If you need any adjustments to the application process, just let us know.
 



  





**Ready to talk?** 




 If leading the teams behind a platform that enterprises worldwide depend on — while helping build what comes next — sounds like the job you want, we'd like to hear from you.
 



 (The final step of our recruitment process is a mandatory background check, including a financial and criminal check. Any offer of employment is contingent on its successful completion.)

 Välkommen med din ansökan. Vi arbetar löpande med urval och intervjuer, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Svea Solar is on the verge of transforming how we manage energy with just the click of a button. We're here to help our customers make the most of their energy usage while also balancing the energy grid with smart, innovative solutions. To bring this vision to life, we're expanding our engineering team and are on the lookout for our next Backend Engineer.
   

  

**About The Role & The Team**
 As a Backend Engineer, you'll join our Sunbeam Labs, where we’re creating digital services that range from energy optimization to virtual power plants. You’ll work closely with a talented and energetic team of engineers and domain experts, all focused on building cutting-edge software solutions that make energy optimization a reality for our customers.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll be involved in every stage of the software development lifecycle, from brainstorming ideas to deployment and ongoing maintenance. Since we’re pioneering services that haven’t existed before, there’s plenty of room for discovery and problem-solving! You’ll be working with thousands of connected devices that we control in real-time, based on measurements taken multiple times per second. Your daily challenges might include figuring out how to distribute work among devices, handling AWS datacenter failovers without a hitch, counting milliseconds and megawatts, and even predicting tomorrow’s sunshine.
   

  

 If you love tackling challenges, writing code, and having fun while doing it, this could be the

 – your work directly contributes to fixing the planet and driving the energy transition.
   

  

**About**
**A value-driven workplace** 
 – read more about our values here.

 – grow, take responsibility, and power up as both we and the energy industry evolve.
   

  

**Diversity and inclusivity** 
 – different perspectives drive innovation. Here, you can be yourself and contribute with your experiences, identities, and ideas.

 Are we a match?
   

  

 At Svea Solar, we’re all about our values, and we want to make sure they resonate with you too. We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer who’s not just experienced, but who’s also passionate about end-to-end development. You should be comfortable with architecture styles and APIs (like REST or RPC) and have strong communication skills with a proactive attitude.
   

  

**Here’s What We’re Looking For**

**Bonus Points If You Have**
