 If this sounds like you, we’d love to meet you! Join us on our mission to revolutionize home energy solutions and create a greener, more sustainable future.
   

  

 ⚡Who are we
   

  

 As Sweden’s - and one of Europe’s - leading providers of energy tech and solar, we help our customers optimize their energy use with smart, connected solutions. From solar panels to heat pumps, batteries, EV chargers, and software, we’re shaping the future of energy. We call it

title: Lösningsarkitekt
description:
Ett jobb som räknas! Hos oss bidrar du till ett välfungerande samhälle för all­män­het och företag.
   

  

 Just nu letar vi efter dig som är lösningsarkitekt och har ett stort intresse för teknik och arkitektur med fokus på webbutveckling inom .NET och Angular. Du kommer att jobba med ett av myndighetens kritiska verksamhetssystem inom summariska processen.
   

  

 Vi är närmare 230 medarbetare på Kronofogden som arbetar med it-utveckling. Vi skapar de tekniska förutsättningarna för våra 2 200 kollegor, som till vardags bidrar till att säkerställa finansieringen av den offentliga sektorn, skapa ett väl fungerande kreditsamhälle för medborgare och näringsliv samt att motverka brottslighet.
   

  

 Våra medarbetare jobbar hemifrån i kombination med att arbeta på något av våra 32 kontor. Vi söker dig som vill utveckla och utvecklas tillsammans med oss och vårt viktiga samhällsuppdrag.
   

  

 Just nu anställer vi medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Kalmar eller på någon av de orter där vi har kontor.
   

  

**Om jobbet**
 Just nu letar vi efter dig som är lösningsarkitekt och har ett stort intresse för teknik och arkitektur med fokus på webbutveckling inom .NET och Angular. Som lösningsarkitekt hos oss kommer du att få medverka i hela livscykeln för systemet som är högt strategiskt prioriterat. Du är tillsammans med områdesarkitekten ansvarig för teknisk utformning, kommer vara ytterst ansvarig för exempelvis systemarkitektur, kodkvalitet, kompetensspridning inom teamet.
   

  

 Tillsammans med kompetenta och trevliga kollegor kommer du även att utveckla och stötta Kronofogdens kärnverksamhet. – Du kommer att bidra till utveckling och förvaltning av det systemstöd som används för hantering av ärenden om betalningsföreläggande och handräckning inom den summariska processen. Summarisk process är ett snabbt och enkelt sätt för den som t.ex. vill ha betalt eller få tillbaka ett föremål att få ett bevis om att hans krav är riktigt.
   

  

 Du kommer att få möjlighet att arbeta med komplexa miljöer och många integrationer, där vi samarbetar flitigt med flera andra myndigheter. Vi arbetar i .Net (C#), Entity Framework, MVC / Web-API, XML, MS SQL Server och TSQL. Andra ramverk, tekniker och verktyg vi gillar är NUnit, Git, Jenkins, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, köhantering (ActiveMQ Artemis) och REST-API. Du är en del i ett agilt utvecklingsteam som tar helhetsansvar för plattform och lösning, innefattar allt från förvaltning till nyutveckling samt leverans.
   

  

 Tycker du, precis som vi, att det låter spännande? Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan för att bli en del av Kronofogdens utvecklingsteam!
   

  

**Om dig**
 Som medarbetare på Kronofogden förväntas du leva upp till vår medarbetarpolicy.
   

  

 Du tar initiativ, är engagerad och tar ansvar för att målen nås. Du bidrar till verksamhetens utveckling och hjälper dina kollegor att lyckas. Du bemöter andra med respekt, vänlighet och lyssnar aktivt på andra och visar positiv attityd.
   

  

 Du är ansvarstagande, tekniskt kreativ samt har förmåga att kommunicera och skapa goda relationer med kollegor och leverantörer. Du är van vid och trygg med att leda andra.
   

  

 Vi har en utmanande uppgift och problemställningarna vi utmanas av kräver både kreativitet och en hög teknisk nivå. Vi arbetar agilt med tvärfunktionella team där var och ens bidrag är avgörande för om hela teamet lyckas. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt, är noggrann och kvalitetsmedveten.
   

  

**Dina Kvalifikationer**
 Vi söker dig som har
   

  

* Minst 3 års erfarenhet som lösningsarkitekt eller motsvarande
* Har minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av applikationsutveckling C#/.NET de senaste 8 åren
* Har arbetslivserfarenhet av lösningar baserade på händelsedriven arkitektur
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av meddelandehantering med ActiveMQ Artemis eller motsvarande
* Har arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta med utredningar/förstudier de senaste 3 åren
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta med kodgranskning och kontinuerlig förbättring av koden
* Förmågan att sätta sig in i komplexa miljöer och lösningar
* Förmågan att leda och styra andra utvecklare
* Har arbetslivserfarenhet i någon form av ledande roll under de senaste 5 åren
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
* Utbildning på minst gymnasienivå


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av**
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av Angular de senaste 5 åren
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av JavaScript/TypeScript de senaste 5 åren
* Erfarenhet av agila metoder såsom Scrum och SAFE
* Har arbetslivserfarenhet av kravhantering de senaste 3 åren
* Arbetslivserfarenhet av automatiserad enhetstestning och tillhörande verktyg.


**Om oss**
 Kronofogden är en statlig myndighet med ett viktigt uppdrag. Vi jobbar nära människor i utsatta situationer. Vi hjälper den som inte har fått betalt och vägleder den som ska betala. Vi ger medborgare och företag information och god service, så att de kan fatta långsiktiga och hållbara beslut. Det kräver kunskap, handlings­kraft, omtanke och mod. Vi bidrar till ett väl fungerande samhälle för allmänhet och företag – ett samhälle där skulder och andra krav blir fastställda och indrivna på ett rättssäkert sätt.
   

  

 Hos oss kan du räkna med utmanande arbetsuppgifter som även är utvecklande för dig. När du går hem från en dag på jobbet kan du vara säker på att du har gjort något som verkligen räknas – både för andra och för dig.
   

  

**Bra att veta**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds med provanställning i sex månader. Du blir anställd som it-handläggare. Kronofogden erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete efter överenskommelse med arbetsgivaren.
   

  

 Att arbeta i staten innebär att du följer den statliga värdegrunden. Det ställs också särskilda krav på omdöme, säkerhetstänkande och att du följer gällande lagar. Vi ställer frågor vid intervju om tidigare eventuell brotts­lighet och brister i tidigare anställning. För slutkandidater ställs även dessa frågor till referenspersoner. Vi tar även in uppgifter om skulder registrerade hos Kronofogden, konkurs och närings­förbud. Framkomna uppgifter vägs in vid helhetsbedömningen av din lämplighet för den aktuella anställningen.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhets­prövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

 När du ansöker bifogar du ditt cv. Vi använder inte personligt brev i våra rekry­teringar och du ska därför inte bifoga det i din ansökan.
   

  

 Lär känna oss bättre genom att besöka vår webbplats och följa oss på Linkedin.
   

  

**För att komma vidare till den fullständiga annonsen och för att söka tjänsten vänligen klicka på, eller kopiera, länken nedan. Referensnummer 2026/155**
 Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-07!

title: Senior Data Engineer - Feature Engineering for AI Models
description:

 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Feature Engineering team. You will play a key role in transforming big and complex data into meaningful features that enables machine learning model to predict patterns to fight against financial crime .
   

  

**About Our Team**
 Meet the Data and Platform team. Our role is to build robust data and platform foundation to enable threat detection capabilities, keeping our customers, Nordea and society safe. Our team is about 30 people as a part of the group financial crime prevention (GFCP) unit that provides financial crime prevention services to all of the bank.
   

  

 Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

You're passionate about designing and building data pipelines to produce features for machine learning models to identify complex financial crimes, ensuring both the bank’s and society's safety.

**We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.**
**We build relationships.** 
 We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.
   

  

**We learn and develop.**

**We lead change.** 
 We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.
   

  

**We are Nordea.**

As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.
   

  

 A Background Check will be performed for the person selected for this position, including internal applicants.

 For union information, please contact finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACONordea@nordea.com.

title: Commercial Analyst - Loyalty & Partnerships
description:
We are Strawberry. With over 245 hotels, 120 restaurants, 20 spas and more, we create thousands of experiences every day. With urban Comfort Hotel®, warm Quality Hotel™, stylish Clarion Hotel® and cosy Home Hotel and more than 40 unique independent hotels, our guests can pick and choose. Our team of 20,000 passionate individuals from more than 120 countries is what makes us grow! Strawberry is built on our core values: energy, courage and enthusiasm.
Are you a curious, fast-paced analyst who loves turning complex member and partnership data into commercial impact? Do you thrive in an environment where your insights directly shape strategic decisions, loyalty growth, and partner profitability - rather than dying in a presentation slide? If you're looking for a role with high autonomy, sharp colleagues, and the chance to build a true data foundation from the ground up, this is your place to thrive!


We find ourselves at an exhilarating position. We’ve grown to over 250 hotels, broken the historic 20 billion NOK revenue milestone, and transformed how marketing, loyalty, and commercial growth operate at Strawberry. Now, we are taking our Loyalty Program and Strategic Partnerships to the next level. We need a proactive **Commercial Analyst - Loyalty & Partnerships** to be the dedicated analytics bridge to our key commercial, loyalty, and partnership leads.

*Note: We are currently hiring three distinct analyst roles within our Commercial Insights & Personalization team. While all three share our passion for commercial data and high tempo, this specific role is 100% dedicated to driving real commercial value across our 2.5+ million loyalty members and strategic partner ecosystem (including Spenn).*

### **What you will be doing**


As our **Commercial Analyst** your main role is to be a trusted business partner and commercial challenger. You’ll dive into our member and customer data, pinpoint why retention or engagement fluctuates, and proactively bring new solutions to the table – including the ones we didn't know we needed.


A core part of your mission will be to support and empower our Loyalty & Partnership leads - Jørgen Sando (Head of Performance & Member Acquisition) and Christian Lundén (Director Strategic Partnerships) – providing them with the actionable insights and data foundations needed to optimize member lifetime value and partner commercial performance

*(We’re not looking for a human dashboard generator to just pull static numbers. We want someone who tells the story behind the data and makes things happen.)*

* Dig into the "why" behind member behavior shifts. Evaluate campaign effectiveness, loyalty program engagement, and retention metrics (LTV, churn) to present bold, actionable ideas.
* Evaluate our 40+ strategic partners (including Spenn) and their financial contribution. Dig deep into core source systems (such as PMS/Mews) to establish accurate baseline stay statistics, create reliable dashboards, and ensure data transparency for commission models.
* Drive Initiatives Proactively. Take full ownership. Spot opportunities, ask the brave questions (*"Have we looked into this?"*), and run with them.
* Balance strategy & speed. Move seamlessly between fast ad-hoc questions and broader strategic projects. Spread data literacy across commercial teams, increasing the organization's appetite for analytics and data-driven decision-making.

### **Who we think you are**


You are a curious commercial storyteller who naturally digs beneath the surface and has the confidence to translate raw data into persuasive business recommendations. You combine a solid technical foundation with strong commercial acumen and storytelling skills.


You are pragmatic, action-driven, and resilient. When facing organizational data silos or missing baselines, you don't stall - you use your social skills, persistence, and proactive mindset to build bridges, explore data, and establish clarity.

* Relevant background in Loyalty Analytics, Partnership Analytics, Commercial Financial Modeling, or Business Intelligence. Strong grasp of loyalty mechanics, loyalty economics, customer lifetime value, and partnership frameworks.
* Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery / Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and visualization tools such as PowerBI or Tableau. Experience using CRM platforms or similar tools.
* We believe you have a solid background in Loyalty, Partnership, or Commercial Analytics (around 5+ years of experience), but what truly sets you apart is your commercial acumen, technical confidence, and ability to drive impact through data.

 **Details:**  

You will report to **Dianne Robillos,** as part of her **Commercial Insights & Personalization** team. Here, you get a solid data community of analyst colleagues to spar with, while acting as the primary bridge to daily commercial execution
  

**Location:** Stockholm (Solna) or Oslo (with flexibility through our hybrid office setup).  

**Working Language:** Swedish, Norwegian, or English.

### **What we can offer you**

* A flat organization with trust and autonomy in your work. We are rebels that support innovation without imposing strict corporate rules.
* The chance to be part of a passionate team with exceptional colleagues and an inclusive culture that believes every stay should be a story worth telling.
* Plenty of social events including smaller gatherings with your team and huge get-togethers with the whole Strawberry family!
* Great benefits! In addition to our collective agreement, we also offer staff discounts and friends & family rates at our 250+ hotels.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------



Cyber Defense Centre Operations protects the business through 24/7 cyber defence capabilities, including security monitoring, incident response, threat intelligence, threat hunting, and digital forensics. We also own and continuously enhance strategic security platforms and services, including SIEM, SOAR, endpoint protection, and Data Loss Prevention (DLP), to strengthen the organization's cyber resilience.

**What you'll do**
------------------



Responsible for investigating cyber threats, security incidents, and critical vulnerabilities, while coordinating response activities across stakeholders.

  



The role leverages cyber threat intelligence to assess risks, support threat hunting, and drive timely containment and remediation to strengthen the organization's security posture.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------



You would carry a Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Information Security, Computer Science, or related field. You should bring 3+ years of experience in Security Operations (SOC), Incident Response, Threat Hunting, or Threat Intelligence. You should also bring experience coordinating and managing cyber security incidents.

  



Some technical competencies you should bring would be a strong understanding of cyber threats, attack techniques, and vulnerability management. Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, and security monitoring platforms as well a knowledge of cyber threat intelligence frameworks and methodologies (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK, Kill Chain). You should also bring experience investigating security incidents, malware, phishing, and advanced threats.

  

You would bring understanding of network, endpoint, cloud, and identity security technologies. You have a strong analytical and investigative mindset. You should have the ability to coordinate incident response across multiple stakeholders as well as excellent communication and reporting skills. You are capable to prioritize and manage multiple security events simultaneously and have a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating cyber risks.

  



Preferred Certifications:



GIAC (GCIH, GCFA, GCTI), CISSP, Security+, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Hypertype is looking for an exceptional **Founding Engineer** to join a lean, ambitious team building AI infrastructure and applications for industrial companies.


This is a high-ownership startup role. You’ll work closely with the two founders, customers, and the business team to take products from idea prototype production customer deployment. We’re looking for someone who is entrepreneurial, moves extremely fast, and is comfortable owning major technical decisions rather than waiting for detailed specifications.


We use AI-assisted development extensively to increase development speed, while maintaining high standards for reliability, security, architecture, and code quality.

#### **What You’ll Own**

* Build, ship, and maintain production systems across frontend, backend, AI, data, and cloud infrastructure.
* Develop web applications using **React, Next.js, and TypeScript**.
* Design backend services and APIs using **Python and FastAPI**.
* Build and improve end-to-end AI products, including **RAG, AI agents, retrieval, evaluation, and data ingestion pipelines**.
* Build data extraction pipelines capable of handling complex industrial documents containing **text, tables, images, manuals, and other unstructured data**.
* Work with **Vector RAG, SQL-RAG, GraphRAG, embeddings, retrieval/reranking, prompt construction, and context management**.
* Help operate our current **GCP infrastructure** and contribute to the migration of relevant infrastructure to **Microsoft Azure**.
* Prototype rapidly, test with customers, iterate based on real usage, and turn successful prototypes into scalable production systems.
* Work directly with customers to troubleshoot technical issues and ensure successful deployments.
* Define and track product and technical KPIs together with the founders and business team.
* Monitor production systems and continuously improve reliability, latency, AI quality, and infrastructure costs.
* Evaluate new AI models, frameworks, and infrastructure and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions.

#### **What We're Looking For**

##### **Core Technical Experience**

* Strong full-stack engineering experience with particular strength in **backend engineering**.
* **2-3+ years of Python experience**, with a strong understanding of asynchronous programming, CPU-bound vs. I/O-bound workloads, multiprocessing, multithreading, GIL, asyncio, and production API development.
* Strong experience with **FastAPI** or similar Python backend frameworks.
* Production experience with **TypeScript, React, and Next.js**.
* Experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native applications on **Azure, GCP, or equivalent infrastructure**.
* Practical experience building **end-to-end LLM/RAG applications**, including:


	+ LLMs and embedding models
	+ Vector databases
	+ Document ingestion, parsing, and chunking
	+ Retrieval and reranking
	+ Vector RAG / SQL-RAG / GraphRAG
	+ Prompt and context management
	+ Evaluation and monitoring
	+ Latency and cost optimization
* Experience building **agentic AI workflows**, including tool use, orchestration, state management, and multi-step execution.
* Experience with complex data extraction and ingestion pipelines across text, tabular data, and images.
* Experience using AI coding tools extensively while still reviewing, validating, and taking full ownership of production code.

##### **Startup Mindset**


We are particularly interested in people who have previously been an **AI startup founder, founding engineer, or early engineer at a pre-seed/seed-stage company**.


You should:

* Be highly entrepreneurial and comfortable working with ambiguity.
* Enjoy building in a lean team alongside **two founders**.
* Have the hunger to go beyond a traditional 9-to-5 role when the company or customer requires it.
* Be able to move from prototype to production quickly without sacrificing engineering judgment.
* Be comfortable speaking directly with B2B customers and owning technical deployments.
* Understand how technology decisions affect **unit economics, infrastructure costs, customer value, and company runway**.
* Stay constantly up to date with developments across AI models, agents, developer tooling, and infrastructure.
* Be pragmatic: choose the simplest technology that solves the customer problem rather than over-engineering.

##### **Strong Advantages**

* **2+ years of GCP/Microsoft Azure experience**, particularly migration experience.
* Experience with **Firebase and BigQuery**, particularly where these systems need to be migrated or replaced.
* Experience configuring or troubleshooting **IPsec tunnels** and enterprise networking.
* Experience operating LLM-powered applications at production scale.
* Experience with asynchronous processing, event-driven architectures, queues, caching, and background jobs.
* Experience systematically evaluating and improving AI quality and reliability.
* Experience building B2B software for **customer support, aftersales, sales, industrial companies, or enterprise workflows**.
* Experience with **Rust** (Tokio, Axum) or **Go**.
* Machine learning background.
* Experience at a startup that grew from **pre-seed/seed toward Series A or beyond**.
* Experience supporting fundraising from the technical side — creating technical materials, explaining architecture and AI differentiation, and presenting technology to investors.

### **Our Stack**

**Frontend**  

React · Next.js · TypeScript

**Backend**  

Python · FastAPI

**AI & Data**  

LLMs · AI Agents · RAG · Vector Search · SQL-RAG · GraphRAG · Document/Data Extraction

**Cloud**  

GCP Microsoft Azure  

Firebase · BigQuery

**Additional technologies**  

Rust · Go


Rust and Go currently represent a relatively small part of the stack, so deep expertise in both is **not required**.

### **The Person Who Will Thrive Here**


You are someone who can look at a customer problem on Monday, build a working prototype quickly, put it in front of the customer, learn from real usage, and turn it into a reliable production product.


You don't think of yourself as only a frontend, backend, AI, or infrastructure engineer. You take ownership of the **whole problem**.


You care about the technology, but you also care about whether customers deploy it, whether it creates measurable value, whether the infrastructure economics make sense, and whether what you're building helps the company grow.


For the right person, this is an opportunity to have unusually high ownership over the technical direction and next stage of Hypertype.

title: Performance Engineer
description:
️ **What We Do**


Swiftly gaining ground as Sweden’s industry leader in battery storage and expanding rapidly in selected European markets, Flower is on a mission to enable the energy system of tomorrow.


With an industry-leading AI-powered platform at its core, our service includes stabilizing the energy system by enhancing predictability and flexibility for both energy producers and consumers. By combining pioneering technology with a portfolio of flexible energy assets, we break new ground towards a fossil-free energy system, allowing clean energy to power society.

**Who We Are**


Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core.﻿ Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.


At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.


To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled **Performance Engineer.**


‍ **About The Role:**


As **Performance Engineer**, you'll join our Asset Management team and be an important part of monitoring and performance across Flower's growing portfolio of energy assets, including battery storage (BESS). You'll ensure our assets run at industry-standard availability by proactively detecting issues before they cause downtime, managing incident escalation, and continuously improving how we monitor performance through our asset management platform. You'll also play a key role in turning operational data into insights that feed directly into our optimization models - helping us make smarter decisions and unlock long-term value from every asset in the portfolio.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Monitor and ensure the performance and availability of Flower's energy assets
* Onboard new and existing assets into our monitoring platform, configuring data points and validating that signals and alarms are correctly set up
* Drive proactive, data-driven analysis to catch potential failures early and minimize unplanned downtime
* Coordinate with external partners, suppliers, and system integrators to troubleshoot issues and improve data integration
* Maintain clear downtime reporting and track KPIs to keep asset health transparent across the organization

**Who You Are:**

* You have a technical degree with a focus on energy systems or equivalent proven experience within Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and/or energy production
* Strong technical understanding of energy asset hardware, cloud integrations and industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus, IoT gateways)
* You bring minimum 3-5 years of experience working with performance monitoring or operations on energy assets
* Proven ability to analyze complex data sets to perform predictive maintenance and fault detection
* Strong interpersonal skills for high-stakes coordination with external partners, subcontractors, and emergency rescue services
* Strong communication skills in English both written and spoken
* Confident cross-company communication skills, able to liaise and coordinate effectively with external partners, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholder organizations

**Location**


Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.


️ **Apply**


Our corporate language is English, as we have about 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.


Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, the Hiring Manager, the Team, and the VP Engineering.


We look forward to hearing from you!


—

*We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.*

title: Business Area Lead, AWS
description:
SwedQ is a consultancy that has lately proven to have a model that works for people who want to build something rather than just deliver hours. Year after year we have served clients across a wide range of industries (still intentionally excluding gambling and weaponry), and we have grown steadily in revenue, in team size and in the weight of what we deliver.


Now we are building AWS into a business area of its own. Both as a reseller and as the team that delivers the projects that follow. We are looking for the person who is going to run it.


You get two things on day one. The first is a client base where we already deliver consultants but where the cloud consumption sits somewhere else entirely. The second is a blank page.

**What the role actually is**


You own the P&L. Revenue, margin, pricing, budget, the lot. You decide what we sell, at what margin, and how we deliver it.


The first job is the money that is already close. We have clients who trust us and who buy their cloud elsewhere. Going and getting that is where you start. After that comes new mid market clients in the Nordics, companies in the 200 to 2000 employee range where we can actually make a difference instead of being supplier number fourteen.


You will own the relationship towards AWS and towards our distributors, and push our partner status forward. You will sit with the client's architect as often as you sit with their CTO, and you need to hold your own in both conversations without bringing someone along to translate. And you will work closely with our consultants, because we do not sell things we cannot deliver.


When the business area grows, you hire into it. You report to the CEO.

**Who we think you are**


You have five years or more in technical sales, business development or partner business within cloud, IT consulting or distribution. You understand the economics of cloud resale, meaning margin structure, commitments, cost optimisation, and not only how to close a project.


You come from a technical background, or you have worked close enough to the technology that you can reason about architecture and migration paths on your own. You either hold AWS certifications or you take them within six months, and we pay for them.


You want ownership of a result rather than a quota. If a target handed to you by someone else is what motivates you, this is probably the wrong company.


Swedish and English, both working level. Experience with Swedish framework agreements and public procurement is a plus, as is having built a business from nothing before.

**What is in it for you?**


The question goes back to you: what do you want (with common sense or not)? We are looking for someone who wants to be part of the company in a literal sense. That means taking on the commercial challenges as well as getting a portion of the company in the future.

**SwedQ culture**


SwedQ began with siblings who brought in people they knew. Those people recommended friends, and from there the company grew further through open head hunting. Over time we have built a diverse team with different backgrounds, experiences and insights. We made sure to amplify that by embracing independence and accountability while driving value creating work. We are 25 people, not 1300. Nobody hands you a territory inside somebody else's plan.


Sounds like you? Apply, or just get in touch and ask.

title: Workforce Identity Sales Specialist
description:
Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden Sales Ref ID: JR-021444  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
**Job Summary**


Idira, part of Palo Alto Networks, are seeking a dynamic and experienced Sales Specialist to drive the growth of our Agentic Identity Security business across the Nordics region.


The ideal candidate will operate in a high-growth environment at scale, thrive in driving innovation, have a solid background in cybersecurity sales, and a deep understanding of security solutions. They will have a proven track record of developing strong customer relationships and executing strategies that support rapid expansion and success. This role requires a strategic thinker who excels in collaboration with internal teams, engages effectively with customers, and drives revenue growth through the sale of complex solutions.


**Your Responsibilities:**


* Work with a regional sales team to establish and maintain customer relationships at the executive and business decisionmaker level including but not limited to CISO, CIO, and other executives responsible for Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Security, Governance, Risk, and Compliance. Hold regional responsibility for meeting and exceeding established sales quota associated with Idira’s Workforce Identity solutions (IAM, IGA, Endpoint Security).
* Develop & present compelling business cases to customers, maintain expert-level knowledge of all elements of the business case, including the drivers of cost, benefits, and risk.
* Partner closely with subject matter experts, solutions engineers, and professional services teams to align the technology architecture to the customer's desired business outcomes.
* Work closely with post sales teams to ensure successful product adoption and realisation of the full value of customer’s technology investment.
* Work with channel partners, resellers and systems integrators to penetrate new accounts and extend reach of Idira’s Workforce Identity solutions in the assigned geography.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of field sales experience focusing on key customer accounts and delivering value to Enterprise level accounts. Experience as an overlay sales specialist is a bonus.
* Extensive platform selling experience in complex sales with multiple buying centers.
* In depth knowledge on Identity & Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Identity Security best practices and technologies and other vendors and products in that space. An emphasis on vendors and technologies in use across large enterprises for both on-premises and cloud is preferred.
* Established trusted relationships with, and experience presenting to, CIOs and CISOs with the ability to influence and drive strategic conversations.
* Expertise in applying complex solution sales methodologies to drive results.
* Experience working with channel partners and a deep understanding of a channel-centric go-to-market strategy.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment while collaborating effectively with sales engineers and cross-functional teams.
* Experience operating in a continuous adoption, expansion, and upsell sales motion within a matrixed sales organisation is preferred
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory and other locations approximately 30% of time.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.


We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.


Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.


Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Som **Service Delivery Lead för Cybersecurity & Identity Services** ansvarar du för våra leveranser inom cybersäkerhet och identitetstjänster inkluderat IAM. Du är den interna ägaren av våra tjänster inom cybersäkerhet och identitetshantering och fungerar som huvudsaklig kontaktpunkt gentemot vår leverantör av managerade tjänster.


I denna roll arbetar du nära interna intressenter, IT-ledningen och externa partners för att säkerställa tillförlitliga, robusta och regelmässiga säkerhetstjänster som gör det möjligt för verksamheten att bedriva sin verksamhet på ett säkert och effektivt sätt.


En viktig del av rollen är att ha en stark förmåga att beställa, styra, följa upp och förvalta outsourcade cybersäkerhetstjänster. Detta inkluderar att säkerställa kostnadseffektivitet, transparens samt att tjänsterna är i linje med företagets strategi och mål.


**Det börjar med dig!**


I rollen som Service Delivery Lead kommer du att:


* Äga och följa upp tjänsteleveranser inom Cybersäkerhet, Identitet och IAM.
* Leda forum och möten för att följa upp och förbättra leveranser av IT-tjänster relativt säkerhet och compliance.
* Forma och förverkliga vår cybersäkerhetsstrategi tillsammans med övriga organisationen. Du identifierar, bedömer och prioriterar risker, samt implementerar åtgärder som matchar både verksamhetens mål och gällande regelverk.
* Övervaka hanteringen av säkerhetsincidenter och sårbarheter. Vid kritiska säkerhetsincidenter är det du som säkrar effektiv kommunikation, samordning och uppföljning.
* Säkerställa att vi alltid ligger i linje med säkerhetspolicyer, arkitekturstandarder och regulatoriska krav inom cybersäkerhet.
* Godkänna och koordinera förändringar från vår driftleverantör (MSP) för att garantera minimal affärspåverkan.
* Knyta samman arbetet med Identitet och Säkerhet med IT-drift, plattformsägare, arkitekter och ledningsgrupp.
* Tillsammans med ditt team översätta säkerhetsbehov till krav på tjänster och kommunicera risker på ett självklart sätt.
* Tillsammans med ditt team stötta funktioner som kvalitet, risk och internkontroll kring tolkning och uppföljning av krav på cybersäkerhet, direktiv, standarder och kontroller som ligger inom området för cybersäkerhet.

**Din passion för IT och verksamhet**


Du är en trygg och inkluderande ledare som tar ett ägandeskap och får saker att hända. Din nyfikenhet och förmåga att skapa engagemang gör att du trivs i en roll där du har många kontaktytor. Du kommunicerar effektivt med både IT och interna kunder inom vår verksamhet.


Vi ser också att du har:


* God förståelse för cybersäkerhetsområdet (on-prem och cloud) och IAM såsom **Identity and Access Management (IAM)**, **SOC/SIEM**, sårbarhetshantering och hantering av säkerhetsincidenter.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer av managerade säkerhetstjänster (Managed Security Service Providers, MSSP).
* God kunskap om hur en IT-avdelning fungerar exempelvis Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management och Service Level Management.
* Förståelse för molntjänster såsom **Azure AD / Entra ID**, Microsoft 365, AWS med flera, samt moderna identitets- och säkerhetsarkitekturer såsom **Zero Trust**, Conditional Access, multifaktorautentisering (MFA) och hantering konton med höga privilegier.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med säkerhetsramverk och ledningssystem som **NIST**, **ISO 27001** och **CIS Critical Security Controls**, samt kunskap om regulatoriska krav inom cybersäkerhet på verksamheter inom EU.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med leverantörer och tjänsteleverantörer.
* Flytande engelska samt goda kunskaper i svenska.

Utöver detta tror vi att du har en akademisk examen och minst fem års erfarenhet från en liknande roll. Du trivs med en kombination av strategiska och operativa arbetsuppgifter


  
**Ansökan**
-----------


Låter detta intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning och gör bakgrundskontroll. Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

description:
Are you driven by innovation and looking to thrive in a fast-paced, growing environment? Join us at Calabrio-Verint and be part of our dynamic team! As a **Principal Database Engineer** you are responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and optimizing database systems to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient management of organizational data. Beyond day-to-day database ownership, you serve as the connective tissue for how data is structured across our products — holding deep domain and data-model expertise that enables cross-product data mapping and integration. In your role, you support business operations by delivering high-performing, enterprise-scale database solutions and ensuring data availability, integrity, and security.


\*\*Candidate must be located in Stockholm, Sweden.\*\*

**What You'll be doing:**

* Own and maintain deep expertise in the organization's domain model — designing database structures, schemas, tables, indexes, and data models that reflect how data is structured and related across products.
* Develop and optimize queries, stored procedures, and database processes to improve system performance and efficiency.
* Map and reconcile data models across products to enable cross-sell initiatives and other data-integration efforts, acting as the go-to technical authority for adjacent teams on how data connects across the platform.
* Monitor database health, troubleshoot issues, and implement performance tuning and capacity planning activities to meet the scale and performance demands of large enterprise customers.
* Implement and maintain database security controls, including user access management, encryption, and compliance requirements.
* Support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence needs through data extraction and database solutions.
* Collaborate with application developers, data teams, and infrastructure teams to integrate and support enterprise systems.
* Maintain database documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies and best practices to improve scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Set database standards and best practices across teams, and act as the senior technical point of contact for data-integration questions from product, engineering, and adjacent teams.

 **Requirements**  

* 10+ years of professional experience with strong knowledge of SQL and database platforms such as Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL. Experience with relational and NoSQL databases.
* Understanding of data modelling, indexing, query optimization, and database architecture.
* Programming and automation skills using languages such as Python, Java, or C#.
* Expertise in database security, backup and recovery, and performance management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.
* Experience mapping and integrating data models across multiple products or systems, and supporting database performance at enterprise scale.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Fem kilometer utanför Helsingborg ligger Scandic Helsingborg Nord. Våra gäster tar sig lätt in till staden där restauranger och nöjesliv finns. Här finns allt för våra gäster- en lekhörna för barnen, en relaxavdelning med bastu och pool och biljard i restaurangen för de vuxna.


Vi lägger stor vikt vid ett personligt och välkomnande bemötande, mot våra gäster så klart, men också mot varandra. Vi har fokus på vårt gemensamma arbete och sluter upp tillsammans där det behövs. Vi tror på en god stämning med mycket glädje och skratt bland medarbetare leder till hotellupplevelser i världsklass för våra gäster som de kommer att minnas.



**Nu söker vi en Receptionist till Scandic Helsingborg Nord.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten är en anställning med vikariat på deltid fram till januari 2028. Med möjlighet till förlängning.  

Arbetet är fördelat på dag, kväll, helg (samt natt kan förekomma)

description:

Vi söker en erfaren Nätverks- och Zscaler-specialist som kommer ha en central roll i utvecklingen av våra nätverks- och säkerhetslösningar med fokus på Zero Trust och molnbaserad säkerhet. Du kommer att arbeta nära nätverksarkitekter, säkerhetsspecialister, IAM-team och verksamheten för att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla säkra, skalbara och framtidssäkra lösningar.


Du blir en del av ett kompetent team där du bidrar med din tekniska expertis inom nätverk, säkerhet och Zscaler. Rollen har ett tydligt fokus på design, implementation och vidareutveckling av lösningar snarare än traditionell drift. Du förväntas bidra med specialistkompetens, driva tekniska initiativ och vara en viktig del i vår resa mot en modern Zero Trust-arkitektur.


Teamet är geografiskt utspritt över flera orter i Sverige. Möjliga placeringsorter är Linköping, Malmö, Solna eller Göteborg.

Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för nätverk och IT-säkerhet samt erfarenhet av att arbeta med moderna nätverks- och säkerhetslösningar och/eller cloud security.


Du är självgående, ansvarstagande och har en god förmåga att omsätta verksamhetskrav till tekniska lösningar. Samtidigt värdesätter du samarbete och kunskapsdelning och trivs i en miljö där man utvecklas tillsammans.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
As a Site Reliability Engineer at Epidemic Sound, you will be a core member of the central platform team that builds and operates the platform the rest of Engineering ships on - keeping it reliable, scalable, and secure is what this team exists to do. This is infrastructure-flavoured software engineering: you will write the code that defines and automates the platform, and treat it as a product whose customers are the rest of Engineering. The goal is to make the reliable way the easy way - self-service paths that let product teams build and ship safely without waiting for anyone.
  
Your key responsibilities include
  
Build and operate the platform our services run on - GKE clusters, the controllers that extend them, and the Terraform that defines our cloud.
  
Own the path from commit to production - CI/CD, GitOps, and the progressive-delivery patterns that turn a merge into a safe release.
  
Strengthen the networking and routing layer - traffic management on top of the VPC, firewalls, and network policies that keep it safe and predictable.
  
Govern access and guardrails - IAM across every layer, policy-as-code, and break-glass paths - so teams move fast within safe defaults rather than waiting on tickets.
  
Grow reliability and observability - alert hygiene, runbooks, SLOs, and the metrics and tracing that show how the platform behaves in production.
  
Enable product teams and raise the bar - make production readiness the default, and drive healthy adoption of the standards and docs you would rather share than gatekeep.
  
  

Requirements
  
**Kubernetes fundamentals:** a solid grasp of controllers, core components, and CNI and networking - depth in the domain matters more than any single tool (GKE a plus).
  
**Infrastructure as code and delivery:** Terraform, Helm or Kustomize, CI/CD and GitOps (ArgoCD), and the traffic-management and progressive-delivery mechanisms that move releases out safely.
  
**Networking and access:** routing fundamentals, the VPC, firewall, and network-policy primitives beneath it, and IAM and access management at different levels.
  
**Operational depth:** monitoring fundamentals (a clear view of when to reach for metrics versus tracing, and experience with an open-source observability stack), strong troubleshooting across distributed systems, and solid Unix/Linux.
  
**Agentic development mindset:** you use AI agents actively in your own work, knowing where they add leverage and where human judgement is non-negotiable.
  
**Collaboration and judgement:** you do your best work on large, cross-cutting projects, communicate openly, and stay opinionated but open to discussion - reaching for the right tool over your own creation.
  
  

It would also be music to our ears if you have
  
Familiarity with GCP and an observability stack with Prometheus, Thanos, and Grafana.
  
Experience running containerised platforms at scale.
  
Service mesh experience with Cilium eBPF, Linkerd, or Istio.
  
Familiarity with platform building blocks like cert-manager, external-secrets, or external-dns.

title: Researcher in aerosols and extreme precipitation
description:
**The Department of Meteorology** at Stockholm University (MISU) conducts research and education spanning the atmosphere, ocean and physical climate sciences. MISU offers educational programmes at the Bachelor's, Master's and PhD levels. Our research addresses fundamental questions concerning the dynamics, physics, chemistry and biogeochemistry of the atmosphere and ocean relevant to weather and climate. MISU strives toward a broad representation of research within our scientific domain.  

  

We study questions originating from the deep ocean to the upper atmosphere and from the tropics to the poles. In this effort, we use and develop theory, statistical methods, and numerical models in close interplay with observations. We also develop and lead observational research using remote-sensing and in-situ measurements, including satellite missions and icebreaker expeditions to the Arctic.  

  

The department has around 60 employees and is embedded in a larger research environment, including the Bolin Centre for Climate Research, the Baltic Sea Centre and the Swedish e-Science Research Centre. The department is highly international, with over half of our employees coming from outside Sweden and both Swedish and English are used as working languages. We welcome and value diversity in our working environment. For more information about us, please visit: The Department of Meteorology.

**Project description**
-----------------------


Aerosol particles in the atmosphere play an important role in cloud formation and in the Earth's radiation balance. In this project, which is linked to the EU project CERTAINTY, we study how interactions between aerosol particles and clouds are manifested in changes to both precipitation patterns and the frequency and intensity of extreme rainfall events. The project will primarily make use of high-resolution simulations.

**Main responsibilities**
-------------------------


In this project, you will conduct research on the role of aerosol particles in precipitation patterns and extreme rainfall. This will primarily be carried out through the analysis of global high-resolution simulations using the ICON climate model, but may also include the analysis of observations and other models.

**Qualification requirements**
------------------------------


Postdoctoral positions are appointed primarily for purposes of research. Applicants are expected to hold a Swedish doctoral degree or an equivalent degree from another country.

**Assessment criteria**
-----------------------


The doctoral degree must be in meteorology, atmospheric sciences, oceanography or a related field. The degree must have been completed at latest before the employment decision is made. In the appointment process, special attention will be given to research skills within the area of the employment. An excellent command of written and spoken English is also required.

**About the employment**
------------------------


The position involves full-time employment for a maximum of 12 months. Start date 2026-10-01 or as per agreement.


Stockholm University strives to be a workplace free from discrimination and with equal opportunities for all.

**Contact**
-----------


Further information about the position can be obtained from prof. Thorsten Mauritsen, thorsten.mauritsen@misu.su.se,


For information about the recruitment process and terms of employment, please contact head of administration Sara Engström, sara.engstrom@misu.su.se.

**Application**
---------------


Apply for the position at Stockholm University's recruitment system. Attach a personal letter and CV as well as the attachments requested in the application form. It is the responsibility of the applicant to ensure that the application is complete in accordance with the instructions in the job advertisement, and that it is submitted before the deadline.


The instructions for applicants are available at: How to apply for a position.

title: Senior Legal Counsel - Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations
description:

We work at the forefront of connectivity by collecting and analyzing data from over 1 700 000 customer vehicles and machines. Our solutions enable our customers to improve efficiency by leveraging vehicle data.

Someone who not only advises the business on legal risks and opportunities, but also helps transform how legal services are delivered across the Volvo Group. As a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, you will help the organization navigate a rapidly evolving legal landscape covering data, cybersecurity, AI, intellectual property and digital services.

  

Your responsibilities will include:

* Acting as a subject matter expert on strategic digital, technology and data-related legislation.
* Advising on legal and compliance risks and opportunities connected to digital products, connected services, AI solutions and data-driven business models.
* Providing legal guidance on data privacy, cybersecurity, open-source software, IP and other technology-related matters.
* Designing and implementing practical legal frameworks, playbooks, templates and governance models.
* Driving innovation within the legal function by leveraging legal technology, automation, AI and modern ways of working.
* Educating and influencing stakeholders across the organization through training, thought leadership and strategic advice.
* Drafting, negotiating and leading complex technology, software, cloud, data and commercial agreements.
* Collaborating closely with colleagues across Legal & Compliance and contributing to the continued development of a strong, collaborative and high-performing legal team.
**Competence Profile & Qualification**
--------------------------------------


We believe you have a law degree and at least 8 years of relevant experience from a leading law firm, a multinational company or a combination of both.


You have substantial experience advising businesses operating at the intersection of technology, data and commercial innovation. You combine strong legal judgment with a genuine interest in understanding technology, business models and operational realities.


You are curious about technology and understand how AI, data-driven business models, automation and digital platforms are changing industries. You actively explore how technology can improve legal processes, enhance decision-making and create scalable ways of supporting the business.

  

To succeed in this role, you are:

* A strategic thinker who can translate complex legal requirements into practical business solutions.
* Comfortable engaging with senior executives, engineers, architects and product teams alike.
* Curious about emerging technologies and how they create both opportunities and risks.
* An influential communicator who builds credibility through expertise, pragmatism and collaboration.
* Passionate about improving and modernizing the delivery of legal services through technology, automation and process excellence.
* Motivated by shaping the future rather than maintaining the status quo.
* A collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues.
**Why Join Us?**
----------------

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the center of Volvo Group's digital transformation. You will work on cutting-edge questions involving connected vehicles, data-driven services, artificial intelligence and global digital platforms. You will join a highly engaged and supportive team of legal professionals who value expertise, collaboration and an enjoyable working environment. We believe the best results are achieved when talented people work together, learn from one another and have fun along the way.

  

You will not only help shape how Volvo Group navigates the evolving regulatory landscape, but also influence how legal services are delivered within one of the world's leading industrial companies. If you are excited about combining deep legal expertise with technology, innovation and transformation, we would like to hear from you.

 **Last application date:** September 14, 2026.  

**Start****:** November 1, 2026 or as soon as possible  

**Preferred location:** Gothenburg, Sweden

 **For further information please contact:** Bobi Mitrovic, SVP Head of Legal & Compliance Digital Technology & Operations, bobi.mitrovic@volvo.com.


In some countries and specific positions, background checks may be required, in accordance with local laws and regulations. If this is applicable to the role you have applied for, you will be informed.

  

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

 **Who we are and what we believe in**


We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.


Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

 **Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO)** is a new division established to integrate the capabilities of VG Digital & IT and VG Connected Solutions to accelerate the digital transformation in Volvo Group. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.

  

Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. We put people first and build our culture on trust, passion, customer success, change, and performance. If you want to grow, collaborate across functions and entities, and help shape the future of digital products within Volvo Group, DTO is a great place to be.

title: Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform (28639)
description:
Are you a people-focused data leader who knows how to turn customer and marketing data into business value?  

We're looking for an experienced Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platformto join our Nordic Marketing Automation & MarTech team and lead our data and platform capabilities across the Nordic region.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong people leadership with hands-on experience in data, customer data platforms, marketing technology, and data-driven decision making.


**About the role | Lead our Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform capabilities**


As Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform, you will lead a team of Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Developers as well as Platform Solution Architects and Platform Developers and play a key role in enabling our customer engagement, personalization, automation, and measurement agenda.  

You will together with the leader team set direction and priorities for the Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data and Platform roadmap and ensure that our data ecosystem supports both business needs and customer-centric experiences and that we utilize our platforms in the best possible way to enable all business units. An important part of your role will also be developing your team, creating clarity and direction, and enabling specialists to succeed.


Your key responsibilities will include:


* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Developers as well as Platform Solution Architects and Platform Developers
* Together with leader team set direction and priorities for the Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data and Platform roadmap
* Ensure high-quality, compliant, and actionable customer and marketing data processes
* Ensure that our platform tech stack is utilized in the best possible way
* Drive improvements within reporting, measurement, and attribution
* Support the development and optimization of our customer data platform (CDP) capabilities
* Establish and strengthen best practices for data governance, quality, and privacy together with leader team and Delivery Manager
* Translate complex data opportunities and business needs into clear priorities and outcomes.

**About you | A people leader with a strong data and platform mindset**


You combine strong people leadership with a solid understanding of data and platforms in modern marketing. You know how to set direction while giving specialists the autonomy they need to succeed, and you are comfortable working across teams, functions, and countries.


We imagine that you:


* Have proven experience leading data and platform teams and previous people management responsibility
* Have a strong understanding of customer data, Marketing Automation, and MarTech ecosystems
* Have experience with areas such as CDPs, customer journeys, segmentation, and personalization
* Understand data governance, quality, privacy, and GDPR in a marketing context
* Are a strong stakeholder manager who can collaborate with and influence stakeholders at different levels
* Combine a strategic mindset with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach
* Are comfortable working in a Nordic organization and communicating professionally in English.

Experience with Marketing Automation platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Dynamics 365, Braze, HubSpot, Eloqua, or similar is an advantage. The same applies to analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Google Analytics, as well as cloud data environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.


**About us |** **Make a Nordic impact and work across borders as one team**
This is an opportunity to shape how data enables customer engagement and marketing platforms effectiveness across the Nordics. You will lead a highly skilled team, influence strategic decisions, and help accelerate our Marketing Automation and MarTech transformation journey.


You’ll be part of a Nordic team working across Ballerup, Stockholm and Bergen. Even though we’re based in different countries, we collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and solve challenges together.  

We’re not just running tools and data – we’re building capabilities. You’ll have real influence on how marketing technology and automation develop across the Nordics.  

As a growing team, there’s room to take responsibility, deepen your expertise, and help shape future solutions and ways of working. We value autonomy, flexibility, and a supportive environment where people enjoy working together and learning from each other.  

**Curious?**


Send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 13 September, as we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.


If you have any questions regarding the role, you are welcome to contact Petra Talamo, Head of Nordic Marketing Automation/MarTech, +46 70 168 28 63, petra.talamo@trygghansa.se.

As a Metro Construction EHS Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundation technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, XBOX, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. Empower Billions!

title: Linux & Plattformsspecialist (Kubernetes / IBM-miljö)
description:
Nion är ett IT-konsultbolag med kontor i Stockholm, Malmö, Göteborg, Skopje, Bitola och Sofia, där över 200 IT-specialister arbetar tillsammans för att leverera skräddarsydda digitala lösningar. Våra kunder verkar inom bland annat bank och finans, offentlig sektor, telekom, fintech och försäkringar – och vi hjälper organisationer att förenkla komplexa utmaningar och skapa verkligt värde.


Just nu söker vi en erfaren och tekniskt driven Linux- och plattformsspecialist som vill arbeta i en avancerad IT-miljö med fokus på containerplattformar, databaser och infrastruktur.


I rollen kommer du arbeta nära både kund och team för att säkerställa stabil drift och vidareutveckling av plattformar baserade på Linux och Kubernetes/OpenShift. Du bidrar med din expertis inom systemadministration, nätverk och databaser, samt stöttar i tekniska vägval kopplade till plattform, säkerhet och licenshantering.

**Om rollen**


I denna roll arbetar du med drift, förvaltning och utveckling av en komplex IT-miljö där stabilitet, säkerhet och prestanda är centralt. Du blir en nyckelperson i att säkerställa att plattformar och system fungerar effektivt och hållbart över tid.

**Kravprofil**


Vi söker dig som har goda kunskaper inom:

* Minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet av Linux-administration
* Minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet av Databaser, särskilt Db2
* Minst 1 års arbetslivserfarenhet av Nätverk
* Erfarenhet av Kubernetes / OpenShift

 **Meriterande erfarenheter**


Det är extra positivt om du även har erfarenhet av:

* IBM Cloud Pak
* HCL BigFix
* IBM License Metric Tool (ILMT)
* IBM License Service för Kubernetes
* Generell kunskap om IBM-licensmodeller
* Tidigare arbete som konsult

 **Övriga krav**

* Du kan komma att behöva genomgå och bli godkänd i säkerhetsprövning
* Relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
* Relevant Högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande utbildning inom YH
* Flytande i svenska och engelska – skrift och tal

 **Vem är du?**


Vi tror att du är en lösningsorienterad och självgående person som trivs i tekniskt komplexa miljöer. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och ett stort intresse för drift, plattformar och modern infrastruktur.  

  

**Hos oss får du**

* En samarbetsinriktad och platt organisation där stöd är en självklarhet. Din konsultchef fungerar som mentor för att säkerställa din professionella utveckling och trivsel.
* En tydlig karriärplan och kontinuerliga möjligheter till lärande genom projekt, mentorskap och kompetensutveckling.
* En levande företagskultur med stark teamkänsla, kunskapsdelning och sociala aktiviteter som gör jobbet roligt.

 **Utvalda förmåner**

* Möjlighet till delägarskap
* Konkurrenskraftig fast lön
* 30 dagar semester
* Företagsdator, mobil och abonnemang.

 Om rollen
   

  

 Som Cloud Network Architect hos Ving får du en central roll i företagets fortsatta transformation mot en molnbaserad och framtidssäkrad infrastruktur. Du ansvarar för att utveckla och forma nätverksarkitekturen med fokus på Azure, Cloud Networking och säker, skalbar kommunikation mellan verksamhetens plattformar och tjänster.
   

  

 Rollen kombinerar arkitekturansvar med operativt arbete. Du driver tekniska initiativ, tar fram målarkitekturer och roadmaps samt omsätter idéer till lösningar i produktion. Samtidigt fungerar du som teknisk rådgivare och samarbetar nära utvecklingsteam, cloudspecialister, arkitekter och externa partners för att säkerställa att vår nätverksmiljö utvecklas i linje med bolagets cloudstrategi.
   

  

 Här erbjuds du stort mandat, hög teknisk mognad och möjligheten att påverka framtida teknikval i en internationell verksamhet där innovation och utveckling står högt på agendan.
   

  

 Din profil
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Djup kompetens inom Microsoft Azure och Azure Networking (VNET, Hub & Spoke-arkitektur, VWAN, NSG, Private Link & Private Endpoints, Azure Firewall)
* Djup kompetens inom WAN och Hybrid Connectivity (WAN-design, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, BGP, Private Link, Private Endpoint)
* Erfarenhet av Cloud Architecture & Governance
* Erfarenhet av Infrastructure as Code, exempelvis Bicep eller Terraform
* Erfarenhet av Cloud Security och moderna säkerhetsprinciper (Zero Trust)
* Vana av att samarbeta med utvecklingsteam och DevOps-miljöer
* Har erfarenhet av att arbeta agilt
* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens


**Meriterande Om Du Även Har**
* Erfarenhet av Datacenter & Enterprise Networking
* Är certifierad inom IT arkitektur (ex. TOGAF, COBIT)
* Azure-certifieringar (t.ex. AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-700)


 Som person är du engagerad, nyfiken och ansvarstagande. Du motiveras av att driva teknisk utveckling framåt och tycker om att omsätta strategier till konkreta resultat. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa förtroende hos både tekniska och affärsnära intressenter. Dessutom är du prestigelös i ditt samarbete och trivs i en kultur där kunskapsdelning, initiativförmåga och laganda värdesätts högt.
   

  

 Om oss
   

  

 Vi erbjuder en spännande och utvecklande miljö där du får möjlighet till en intern karriär. Du får en omväxlande vardag tillsammans med härliga kollegor – vi arbetar i nära samarbete mellan de nordiska länderna för att ge våra gäster de bästa veckorna på året. Vi har dessutom ett högt medarbetarengagemang som år efter år visar sig i vår interna medarbetarundersökning.
