 På Conscia hjälper vi några av Nordens mest verksamhetskritiska organisationer att bygga, modernisera och säkra sin digitala infrastruktur. Nu söker vi en Affärsområdeschef för Hybrid Cloud som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för att utveckla vårt erbjudande, våra medarbetare och vår affär.
 



  





 Affärsområdet har sin tyngdpunkt inom lösningar och tjänster baserade på marknadsledande teknologier från Cisco, Everpure och Red Hat, där vi hjälper kunder att bygga moderna, säkra och automatiserade plattformar för datacenter, privata moln och hybridmoln.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Det här är en strategisk ledarroll för dig som kombinerar affärsmannaskap med starkt ledarskap och en djup förståelse för modern infrastruktur och molnteknologi.
 



  





 Som Affärsområdeschef för Hybrid Cloud har du det övergripande ansvaret för affärsområdets strategi, resultat, tillväxt och kompetensutveckling. Du är drivande för specialister och ledare som arbetar med datacenter- och hybrid cloud-lösningar baserade på teknologier från Cisco, Everpure och Red Hat, kompletterat med närliggande plattformar och ekosystem.
 



  





 Du ansvarar för att vidareutveckla vårt erbjudande inom områden som:
 



  




* Hybrid Cloud.
* Datacenter Infrastructure.
* Kubernetes och containerplattformar.
* Automatisering och Infrastructure as Code.
* Virtualisering och moderna plattformstjänster.
* Plattformar baserade på Cisco, Everpure och Red Hat.



  





**Ditt ansvar** 



* Driva affärsområdets strategi, utveckling och lönsamhet.
* Förstå, nyttja och leda AIs påverkan på affärsområdet och Conscias   erbjudande.
* Strategiska kunddialoger och affärer.
* Leda, utveckla och inspirera ledare och specialister inom området.
* Identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och vidareutveckla vårt   kunderbjudande.
* Säkerställa hög kvalitet i leveranser och kundrelationer.
* Utveckla partnerskap med ledande teknikleverantörer.
* Bidra till Conscias övergripande strategi och marknadsposition.



  





 Vi tror att du är en erfaren ledare med dokumenterad förmåga att skapa tillväxt, bygga högpresterande team och utveckla affärer inom IT-infrastruktur, molntjänster eller närliggande områden.
 



  





**Du har sannolikt:** 



* Flerårig erfarenhet av personal- och resultatansvar.
* Erfarenhet av att leda specialistorganisationer eller konsultverksamhet.
* God förståelse för hybrid cloud, datacenter, automatisering och moderna plattformstjänster.
* Stark kommersiell förmåga och vana att arbeta nära kunder och partners.
* Erfarenhet av förändringsledning och verksamhetsutveckling.
* Förmåga att kombinera strategiskt tänkande med operativt genomförande.



  





 Som person är du engagerande, tydlig och prestigelös. Du bygger förtroende, skapar riktning och får människor att växa.
 



  





 På Conscia samlar vi några av marknadens främsta specialister inom cybersecurity, networking, hybrid cloud och observability. Vi tror på att dela kunskap, utvecklas tillsammans och ge våra medarbetare frihet under ansvar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka på riktigt, både för våra kunder och för organisationens framtid.
 



  





**Hos oss får du:** 



* Ett strategiskt uppdrag med stort inflytande.
* Möjlighet att leda marknadens främsta specialister.
* En kultur som präglas av kunskapsdelning, samarbete och entreprenörskap.
* Flexibilitet och förtroende i hur du leder och arbetar.
* Möjlighet att vara med och bygga framtidens digitala infrastruktur.



  
 



**Secure
 *your* 
 progress** 




 Vi tror att utveckling sker när människor får möjlighet att växa, påverka och göra skillnad. Om du vill kombinera affärsutveckling, ledarskap och teknik i en av branschens mest spännande roller vill vi gärna höra från dig.

title: Sales Executive AWS
description:
Vill du arbeta med nykundsförsäljning inom ett av marknadens mest spännande cloudområden? Nu söker vi en Sales Executive AWS som vill vara med och utveckla vår affär inom AWS.
   

  

 På affärsområde Licens hjälper vi våra kunder att hitta rätt lösningar inom mjukvara, licenser och cloud. Här får du möjlighet att skapa nya affärer, bygga långsiktiga kundrelationer och bidra till vår fortsatta utveckling.
   

  

 Sales Executive AWS på Advania 🚀
   

  

 I rollen som Sales Executive AWS ligger fokus på nykund. Du skapar nya kundkontakter och driver affärer från första dialog till avslut. Du ansvarar för att utveckla din egen kundportfölj och arbetar nära både presale och tekniska specialister genom hela affären.
   

  

**Du kommer bland annat att:**
* Identifiera och skapa kontakt med nya kunder
* Bygga långsiktiga relationer och utveckla din kundportfölj
* Förstå kunders behov och identifiera nya möjligheter
* Driva säljprocessen från första kontakt till avslut
* Arbeta nära presale och tekniska specialister i kunddialoger
* Bidra till att utveckla vår affär inom AWS


 AWS är ett område du är nyfiken på och vill lära dig mer om. Du behöver inte vara den tekniska specialisten, men du vill förstå kundernas behov och utmaningar. I rollen arbetar du nära våra presale-kollegor och specialister.
   

  

 Rollen är placerad i Liljeholmen och du rapporterar till Affärsområdeschef. Du blir en del av vårt licensteam där samarbete, kunskapsdelning och affärsmannaskap är en naturlig del av vardagen.
   

  

 Vad vi söker hos dig ✨
   

  

 Du tycker om att skapa nya kontakter och motiveras av att göra affärer. Du är nyfiken, tar egna initiativ och gillar att förstå kunders verksamhet.
   

  

 AWS är ett område du är nyfiken på och vill lära dig mer om. Du behöver inte vara den tekniska specialisten, men du vill förstå kundernas behov och utmaningar.
   

  

**Vi tror att du har:**
* Erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning
* Vana av kundkontakt och att driva affärsdialoger framåt
* Intresse för IT, mjukvara eller AWS
* Erfarenhet av eller intresse för nykundsbearbetning


 Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med nykundsförsäljning, byggt upp en kundportfölj eller sålt IT-relaterade lösningar. Erfarenhet av AWS eller Dynamics är också ett plus.
   

  

 Det viktigaste för oss är att du är nyfiken, tar initiativ och tycker om att skapa affärer.
   

  

 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! 👋
   

  

 Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".
   

  

 Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.
   

  

 Det är du som arbetar nära kunden som vet vad dem behöver och vad som blir den bästa lösningen för just deras unika behov, både i dag och i morgon. Därför tycker vi att det är du som ska fatta besluten. Det är genom att erbjuda säkra, hållbara och kundanpassade lösningar som vi skapar värde för kunderna och samhället i stort.
   

  

 Vi bryr oss om hur våra medarbetare mår – på riktigt. Därför samarbetar Advania med Ljung & Sjöberg för att skapa en trygg, proaktiv arbetsmiljö med stöd kring alkohol-, drog- och beroenderelaterade frågor. Tillsammans bygger vi en hållbar arbetsplats där det är okej att be om hjälp, och där förebyggande arbete gör skillnad – för individen, teamet och företaget.
   

  

 I en miljö präglad av stort kundfokus och frihet under ansvar blir det extra viktigt för oss att bygga starka team bestående av ödmjuka stjärnor. Att arbeta i en inkluderande miljö, med kollegor och kunder som vill utvecklas, ger oss möjligheten att trivas och ha riktigt roligt på jobbet. Vi tror på en platt organisation med agilt arbetssätt och flexibilitet. Detta är det enda sättet för en hållbar framtid.
   

  

 Advania Sverige, ”The tech company with people at heart”, har kontor över hela landet, från Luleå i norr till Malmö i syd. Dagligen hjälper våra 1 700 specialister våra kunder, både inom privat och offentlig sektor, i deras ambitioner och mål att digitalisera sina verksamheter. Genom långsiktiga relationer, ledande teknologier, moderna plattformslösningar och strategiska partnerskap formar vi framtidens IT-landskap. Vårt syfte sträcker sig bortom teknik: att ge människor kraften att skapa hållbara värden.
   

  

 Advaniagruppen levererar tjänster till kunder i Sverige, Norge, Storbritannien, Island, Finland och Danmark inom hållbar och säker digitalisering.

title: Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform
description:
Are you a people-focused data leader who knows how to turn customer and marketing data into business value?
   

  

 We're looking for an experienced Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform to join our Nordic Marketing Automation & MarTech team and lead our data and platform capabilities across the Nordic region.
   

  

 This role is ideal for someone who combines strong people leadership with hands-on experience in data, customer data platforms, marketing technology, and data-driven decision making.
   

  

**About the role | Lead our Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform capabilities**
 As Teamlead Marketing Automation MarTech Data & Platform, you will lead a team of Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Developers as well as Platform Solution Architects and Platform Developers and play a key role in enabling our customer engagement, personalization, automation, and measurement agenda.
   

  

 You will together with the leader team set direction and priorities for the Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data and Platform roadmap and ensure that our data ecosystem supports both business needs and customer-centric experiences and that we utilize our platforms in the best possible way to enable all business units. An important part of your role will also be developing your team, creating clarity and direction, and enabling specialists to succeed.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Engineers, Data Architects, and Data Developers as well as Platform Solution Architects and Platform Developers
* Together with leader team set direction and priorities for the Nordic Marketing Automation MarTech Data and Platform roadmap
* Ensure high-quality, compliant, and actionable customer and marketing data processes
* Ensure that our platform tech stack is utilized in the best possible way
* Drive improvements within reporting, measurement, and attribution
* Support the development and optimization of our customer data platform (CDP) capabilities
* Establish and strengthen best practices for data governance, quality, and privacy together with leader team and Delivery Manager
* Translate complex data opportunities and business needs into clear priorities and outcomes.


**About you | A people leader with a strong data and platform mindset**
 You combine strong people leadership with a solid understanding of data and platforms in modern marketing. You know how to set direction while giving specialists the autonomy they need to succeed, and you are comfortable working across teams, functions, and countries.
   

  

**We Imagine That You**
* Have proven experience leading data and platform teams and previous people management responsibility
* Have a strong understanding of customer data, Marketing Automation, and MarTech ecosystems
* Have experience with areas such as CDPs, customer journeys, segmentation, and personalization
* Understand data governance, quality, privacy, and GDPR in a marketing context
* Are a strong stakeholder manager who can collaborate with and influence stakeholders at different levels
* Combine a strategic mindset with a pragmatic and delivery-focused approach
* Are comfortable working in a Nordic organization and communicating professionally in English.


 Experience with Marketing Automation platforms such as Adobe, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Dynamics 365, Braze, HubSpot, Eloqua, or similar is an advantage. The same applies to analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or Google Analytics, as well as cloud data environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
   

  

**About us |** 
**Make a Nordic impact and work across borders as one team**
 This is an opportunity to shape how data enables customer engagement and marketing platforms effectiveness across the Nordics. You will lead a highly skilled team, influence strategic decisions, and help accelerate our Marketing Automation and MarTech transformation journey.
   

  

 You’ll be part of a Nordic team working across Ballerup, Stockholm and Bergen. Even though we’re based in different countries, we collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and solve challenges together.
   

  

 We’re not just running tools and data – we’re building capabilities. You’ll have real influence on how marketing technology and automation develop across the Nordics.
   

  

 As a growing team, there’s room to take responsibility, deepen your expertise, and help shape future solutions and ways of working. We value autonomy, flexibility, and a supportive environment where people enjoy working together and learning from each other.
   

  

**Curious?**
 Send your application as soon as possible, but no later than 13 September, as we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 If you have any questions regarding the role, you are welcome to contact Petra Talamo, Head of Nordic Marketing Automation/MarTech, +46 70 168 28 63, petra.talamo@trygghansa.se.
   

  

**Fackliga representanter**
 Akademikerföreningen: Lena Darin, lena.darin@trygghansa.se, 070-168 28 44
   

  

 Forena: Elias Bakk, elias.bakk@trygghansa.se, 070-730 68 54

title: Senior Software Engineer Backend
description:
**Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!** 




  





 Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
 



  




* We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
* We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
* We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities



  





 We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
 



  





**The role:** 




 As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend, you will leverage your deep technical expertise to ensure alignment, quality, and long-term maintainability across the organization. You will be building strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders, driving project delivery, and ensuring our backend infrastructure remains scalable and robust enough to support millions of users worldwide.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Design and develop high-volume, low-latency services and cope with the challenge of working in a distributed environment.
* Operate mission-critical services at high availability.
* Collaborate across business units and drive solutions.
* Explore new solutions and technologies.
* Build a scalable and reliable system.



  





**What you bring in:** 



* 5+ years of experience with Scala, Java, or Go
* Experience of working with scalable, highly available, real-time distributed systems
* Experience of working with non-relational databases
* Good understanding of data structures and algorithms
* Mentoring/ Leadership skills
* Excellent communication skills in English.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.



  





**It would be great if you also have:** 



* Experience building systems in the Google Cloud Platform
* Experience with virtualization environments, e.g., Docker
* Experience with systems for managing containerized applications, e.g., Kubernetes
* Experience with Cassandra and Kafka.



 .
 



**What we offer:** 




 We support growth through learning resources, leadership programs, mentoring, and real hands-on work. People can move between teams and projects to build new skills and keep things interesting. We offer clear internal mobility and a transparent path for progression, with leaders who stay involved and provide guidance throughout the year. In addition, you will benefit from:
 








* **A comprehensive compensation package:** 
 We offer a competitive salary, 30 days of paid vacation, private health insurance, parental leave top-up, pension, and wellness contributions.
* **Modern tools to do your best work:** 
 Choose your preferred computer and phone within our budget, so you can work comfortably and efficiently.
* **A people-focused office culture:** 
 We value in-person collaboration and follow an office-first model, with some flexibility. Our offices offer a vibrant environment with opportunities to learn, connect, and recharge, from breakfast, lunch, and well-stocked snack stations and quiet spaces to team activities such as movie nights, tech meetups, and cultural events. There's something for everyone.
* **Truecaller’s “Lab Days” offer a space for imagination:** 
 5 times per year for 3 days, where everyone steps away from their normal tasks to explore new, bold ideas and build things they’ve always wanted to. It’s a space where curiosity leads the way, and prototypes take shape. Some concepts even make it into production, and a few have grown into real features used by millions today. Lab Days allow you to be creative, learn fast, and help shape Truecaller's future.



  





**Come as you are:** 




 Truecaller is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe that a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique and would love to get to know you.
 




  





 Check out Life at Truecaller - Behind the code: https://www.instagram.com/lifeattruecaller/
 



  





**Sounds like a great opportunity?** 




  





 We will fill the position as soon as we find the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, we will conduct a background check.
 



  





**We only accept applications in English.**

title: Special Sales Executive AI Powered Solutions
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Our Cloud & Custom Applications team focuses on developing tailored cloud solutions, integrating IT systems, and driving business transformation, delivering business-critical results with quality and speed, powered by Generative AI. Capgemini’s Integration & API capability helps clients connect their digital core; applications, data, partners, and platforms, securely and at scale. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world!
 



  





**Your role** 




 As a Special Sales Executive for Cloud & Custom Applications, you will drive the development of sales strategies, create client offerings, and lead the work of closing deals within large business opportunities. You will identify and develop new business opportunities, build a sustainable pipeline, and leverage our partner ecosystem and your network to capture trends and opportunities. You will share key market insights with clients and internal leaders, contribute to relevant thought leadership, and help design marketing activities that create visibility and impact.

* Address complex client challenges, engaging effectively with senior stakeholders and demonstrating strong meeting facilitation and negotiation skills.

* 10+ years of experience driving results-driven sales, market growth, and closing complex transformation deals within the IT consulting industry.

* Strong understanding of innovative delivery and commercial models, with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities.

 | www.capgemini.com

title: Machine Learning Engineer - Energy Optimization
description:
Residential heating is one of Europe’s largest sources of CO₂ emissions, while energy prices remain unpredictable for many households. At Aira, we’re on a mission to change that. Founded in 2022 and now employing more than 800 people, we develop and install clean energy solutions—including heat pumps, solar panels, and battery systems—powered by intelligent technology that helps homes operate more efficiently.
   

  

 Our goal is simple: to help households reduce both their carbon footprint and their energy costs.
   

  

 With headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Poland, and hubs across the UK, Germany, and Italy, Aira is rapidly scaling to bring clean energy technology to 5 million homes by 2034.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In the Energy Optimization team, we build optimization and machine learning systems that help control when heat pumps run, when batteries charge or discharge, and when it makes sense to export energy to the grid. We are also building new flexibility capabilities by coordinating fleets of homes to support the grid when it matters most.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join this product team. You’ll work on models and systems that turn messy real-world signals into reliable decisions for customers’ homes. This includes building and improving forecasting and optimization models, productionising them, monitoring their performance, and iterating based on real-world outcomes.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and other teams to ship customer-facing intelligence that is reliable, understandable, and valuable. We value clear communication, thoughtful collaboration, curiosity, and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
   

  

 If you enjoy turning ML models into production systems that create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Build and improve ML and optimization models that power customer-facing energy optimization features.
* Work on time-series forecasting, scheduling, and decision models for heat pumps, batteries, solar, tariffs, weather, and customer behaviour.
* Productionise and own models end-to-end, including deployment, monitoring, reliability, and iteration based on real-world outcomes.
* Run experiments on real customer systems, evaluate impact, and turn results into product decisions.
* Contribute to initiatives from discovery to production impact, helping define success metrics and align with stakeholders.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, model behaviour, and what is good enough to ship.


**What You’ll Bring To The Role**
* Experience building ML, data, or optimization systems that are used in real-world products.
* Good programming skills in Python and software engineering fundamentals.
* Experience taking models beyond notebooks, including evaluation, testing, deployment, or monitoring.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Comfort working with real-world data, including ambiguity, imperfect signals, and changing requirements.
* A pragmatic, product-oriented mindset: you care about measurable customer impact, not model complexity for its own sake.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate well in cross-functional teams.


**Bonus points if you have**
* Experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand response, or flexibility.
* Experience with constrained optimization, control systems, or physical systems modelling.


**What is in it for you?**
* Gain hands-on experience in a fast-growing scale-up, with a supportive and inclusive culture, and career advancement opportunities.
* Collaborate with diverse teams across international markets and launch products globally.
* Develop and grow personally and professionally in an entrepreneurial-minded environment.
* Thrive in a dynamic, solution-oriented culture, tackling challenges and driving meaningful solutions that make a positive impact on the world.
* Influence the company's success, with a visible impact on product development and market growth.
* Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.


 At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.

title: NDR Product Specialist
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an** 
**NDR Product Specialist** 
**to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Managed Services domain.**
**About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**
 Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.
   

  

 Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.
   

  

 Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an NDR Product Specialist to our Product team, who wants to make a difference in our Managed Security Services domain.
   

  

**The Role**
 Join our Product Specialist team as an NDR Specialist, where you’ll take ownership of the technical landscape across our network detection and response capabilities. This hybrid role blends deep cyber security expertise with both internal and external enablement, ensuring our NDR platforms are optimally configured, continuously improved, and fully leveraged by our Security Operations teams and our customers. You will work primarily with Vectra and Darktrace to strengthen detection coverage, improve response workflows, and drive operational value from our NDR service offering.
   

  

 In this role, you will:
   

  

* Act as the technical platform specialist for NDR solutions, with a focus on Vectra and Darktrace, including deployment strategies, use case development, detection tuning, and operational best practices.
* Monitor, assess, and communicate product updates, new capabilities, and roadmap changes from NDR vendors to ensure our detection capabilities remain effective and relevant.
* Enable and educate – share your expertise by keeping SOC analysts and internal stakeholders up to date on NDR platform developments, detection opportunities, and best practices. Translate technical changes into actionable guidance and ensure knowledge is embedded in our processes.
* Work closely with vendors, engineering teams, and internal stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, optimize deployments, and increase detection and response capabilities, representing the Product team with clarity and credibility.
* Drive ongoing enhancements across our NDR tooling and processes, ensuring that new platform capabilities are rapidly and effectively integrated into our managed detection service.


**Your Potential Background**
 We are looking for someone with a passion for cybersecurity, a strong sense of product ownership, and a collaborative mindset. You thrive in a dynamic environment, are eager to stay current with the latest developments in network detection and response, and enjoy sharing your expertise with others. You have 2-5 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, ideally as a product specialist within NDR, a technical account manager, a detection engineer, or in a similar role within a SOC or MSSP environment.
   

  

**Required Skills:**
* Deep familiarity with NDR platforms, including deployment strategies, detection engineering, and advanced technical capabilities within tools such as Vectra and Darktrace.

title: Data Engineer with strong Microsoft Fabric focus
description:
**Are you eager to be part of Atea’s data transformation and help build the foundation for trusted, scalable, and business-driven data across the Nordics and Baltics?** 




 At Atea, we are on a journey to developing our modern
 **Data Platform** 
 in close partnership with Microsoft. We are now looking for a curious, motivated, and skilled
 **Data Engineer** 
 who wants to contribute to a committed team and help shape how data is collected, structured, governed, and made available across the organization.
 



  





 If you are passionate about modern data platforms, data modelling, Microsoft Fabric, and turning business needs into reliable data solutions, we would be excited to receive your application.
 



  





**Your role** 




 As a
 **Data Engineer** 
 , you will play an important role in building, maintaining, and improving Atea’s modern dataplatform. You will work closely with data architects, data governance specialists, product owners, business stakeholders, and development teams to ensure that our data solutions are scalable, trusted, well-documented, and aligned with business objectives.
 



  





 You will contribute both technically and functionally, helping us create robust data pipelines, reusable datamodels, high-quality data products, and clear data lineage. The role is part of Atea’s broader transformation towards a more data-driven and AI-enabled organization, where trusted data serves as the foundation for decision-making, automation, reporting, business development, and future AI innovation. You will play a key role in ensuring that our data platform can support advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions at scale. Atea strongly believes in continuous learning and offers opportunities for training, certification, and professional development.
 



  





**Your tasks may include** 



* Developing, maintaining, and optimizing data pipelines, data models, and ETL/ELT processes in Microsoft Fabric.
* Designing and implementing scalable data solutions that support business-critical processes, analytics, reporting, and enterprise applications.
* Working with data from multiple source systems and ensuring that data is properly structured, transformed, documented, and made available for consumption.
* Supporting the implementation and maintenance of Atea’s information model and common datastructures.
* Collaborating with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards, architects, and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Supporting data quality processes by identifying, analysing, and resolving data-related issues together with business and technical stakeholders.
* Contributing to metadata management, data cataloguing, and data lineage using tools such as Microsoft Purview.
* Supporting Master Data Management initiatives by implementing and maintaining data structures for key business entities.
* Monitoring and optimizing data solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost-efficiency.
* Ensuring that data engineering solutions follow agreed standards, governance principles, and platform best practices.
* Contributing to continuous improvement of development processes, documentation, reusable patterns, and ways of working.



  





**What we are looking for** 




 To succeed in this role, we believe you are a structured, curious, and collaborative person with a strong interest in data and modern cloud-based data platforms. You enjoy solving problems, understanding business needs, and building technical solutions that create real value. You are comfortable working in an agile and changing environment and can balance hands-on technical delivery with a holistic understanding of how datasupports business processes. You take ownership of your work, actively contribute to improvements, and communicate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are also interested in the “why” behind data solutions, not only the “how”, and you understand the importance of data quality, documentation, governance, and long-term maintainability.
 



  





**To excel in this role, we believe you should have** 



* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, information systems, or equivalent professional experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a similar data engineering role.
* Strong hands-on experience with the Microsoft data platform, especially Microsoft Fabric.
* Experience with technologies such as Azure Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Microsoft Purview.
* Strong skills in data modelling, data transformation, and building scalable data pipelines.
* Good understanding of data management principles, including data quality, metadata, lineage, and documentation.
* Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into scalable technical solutions while collaborating effectively across business and IT teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with a structured approach to prioritization and delivery.
* Fluency in spoken and written English.



  





**It is considered meritorious if you** 



* Have a good understanding of Data Governance and how it impacts data engineering.
* Have experience with Master Data Management (MDM) or enterprise information models.
* Have experience implementing data lineage, metadata, or governance-related capabilities in Microsoft Purview.
* Have experience working with data products, domain-oriented data ownership, or federated datagovernance.
* Hold a DP-700 Fabric Data Engineer Associate certification or similar Microsoft certification.



  





**About Atea** 




 Atea is the leading supplier of IT infrastructure in the Nordic and Baltic regions. Atea is present in 88 cities with over 8,000 employees in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Lithuania, Latvia, and Estonia. Atea delivers hardware and software from leading global vendors and provides consulting and technical services to support its customers with the design, implementation, and operation of their IT environments. Atea had gross sales of approximately 60 billion NOK i gross sales (2025) and is listed on Oslo Stock Exchange.

 Applications are handled continuously.
 



 Please contact Tobias Forss, Head of Data Platform and Governance, at tobias.forss@atea.se for further information about the role.
 



  





 As part of Atea’s recruitment process, background checks are included. Atea wants to be The Place To Be as we value and work actively with diversity and inclusion. We welcome your application!

title: Engineering Manager - Team Intelligence
description:
At Voyado, we’re building the intelligence layer that powers analytics, insights, and AI-driven experiences for retailers across Europe.
   

  

 We’re now looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Team Intelligence — a growing team of Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts responsible for analytics products, reporting capabilities, and the data foundations that enable trusted decision-making across our platform.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to combine people leadership with technical influence. Your primary mission will be to help the team grow and succeed, while also contributing to the technical direction of our analytics platform together with architects and senior engineers.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with Area Lead Robin Bodin, an experienced engineering leader, who will support you in both your leadership journey and the continued development of Team Intelligence. Whether you’re already an Engineering Manager or a Tech Lead ready to take your first step into formal people leadership, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Engineering Manager for Team Intelligence, you’ll lead a team working at the intersection of analytics, data and AI.

At the same time, you’ll stay close to the technology, supporting technical discussions and helping guide decisions around data products, analytics platforms, and modern data architecture.

 Also someone who is comfortable navigating technical discussions and contributing to decisions around data products, analytics platforms, and modern data architecture.  At Voyado, we care about creating an environment where people can grow, collaborate, and enjoy the journey together. We move quickly, challenge ideas, and work closely across teams to deliver meaningful impact.
   

  

**Some of our benefits:**
* 30 days of vacation
* Wellness allowance
* Personal development opportunities
* Summits and team activities

**About Voyado**

 We’re growing across Europe and are looking for people who want to help shape the future of retail technology.

title: Data engineer/Data Warehouse Specialist inom Data Provisioning till Handelsbanken
description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla en av bankens mest centrala dataplattformar? Vi söker en data engineer / data warehouse specialist som vill arbeta i en utvecklarroll nära verksamheten, där teknik, data och affär möts. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta med en affärskritisk plattform, lösa komplexa tekniska utmaningar och bidra till att data håller hög kvalitet och är tillgänglig för hela banken. Du blir en del av en miljö där erfarenhetsutbyte, samarbete och ständiga förbättringar står i fokus, och där du har stora möjligheter att utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
   

  

**Ditt team**
 Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team som ansvarar för drift och förvaltning av bankens Enterprise Data Warehouse. Teamet består av utvecklare, DBA, Configuration Manager, testmiljöansvarig, Agil Product Owner och Team Coach. Tillsammans arbetar vi enligt agila principer och hos oss blir du en del av ett erfaret team där samarbete och ständig förbättring är en naturlig del av vardagen. Under året blir vi en del av ett större plattformsteam, vilket skapar ännu fler möjligheter till erfarenhetsutbyte och kompetensutveckling. Vi har roligt på jobbet och vårt team präglas av hög kompetens, stort engagemang och bred erfarenhet inom både teknik och affären.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som Data Engineer / Data Warehouse Specialist ansvarar du tillsammans med teamet för att utveckla, förvalta och säkerställa en stabil och effektiv drift av bankens Enterprise Data Warehouse.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:
   

  

* vidareutveckla och effektivisera system och driftmiljö
* underhålla och administrera testmiljöer
* utveckla och förvalta ETL-lösningar
* genomföra kodgranskningar
* felsöka- och analysera problem samt säkerställa hög datakvalitet
* arbeta med både planerade förbättringar och produktionsnära förvaltning
* bidra till arkitektur- och förvaltningsfrågor för att skapa en långsiktigt hållbar plattform


 På sikt kommer du även att bli en viktig kunskapsresurs för andra team genom att bidra med din förståelse för bankens Enterprise Data Warehouse, hur data flödar genom plattformen och hur olika delar av verksamheten använder informationen. I rollen får du en djup förståelse för bankens data och hur den används i verksamheten, samtidigt som den nya plattformsorganisationen öppnar dörrar till fler teknikområden, bland annat cloud- och BI-plattformar.
   

  

 Här får du en roll med stort lärande, varierande arbetsuppgifter och möjlighet att påverka hur en av bankens viktigaste dataplattformar utvecklas över tid.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att arbeta med Data Warehouse eller andra större dataplattformar och som trivs i en roll där utveckling, förvaltning och drift går hand i hand.
   

  

 Vi tror även att du har:
   

  

* erfarenhet av Data Warehouse och ETL-utveckling
* mycket goda kunskaper i SQL
* förståelse för datamodellering
* erfarenhet av drift och förvaltning av affärskritiska system
* erfarenhet av något ETL-verktyg.


 Som person trivs du med att arbeta i team, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och stöttar kollegor för att nå gemensamma mål. Du organiserar, dokumenterar och planerar ditt arbete väl så att du och andra kan följa det. Samtidigt är du lösningsorienterad och nyfiken, hittar kreativa sätt att lösa problem och ser hur olika delar hänger ihop. Eftersom du kommer samarbeta med flera delar inom koncernen, är det viktigt att du kan kommunicera flytande på både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift.
   

  

 Det är meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av:
   

  

* PowerCenter eller liknande ETL-verktyg
* DB2 eller SQL Server
* bank- eller finansbranschen
* jour- eller beredskapsarbete.


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.

title: Senior Data Engineer – Oncology Analytics Platform
description:
RaySearch develops software that supports cancer treatment at hospitals and radiotherapy clinics worldwide.
   

  

 We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to work on RayIntelligence, an oncology analytics platform helping radiotherapy clinics turn data into actionable insights.
   

  

**About RayIntelligence**
 Radiotherapy clinics generate large amounts of clinical and operational data every day. Much of this information remains difficult to access, analyze, and act upon. RayIntelligence is designed specifically for radiotherapy clinics and brings together data from treatment planning systems, oncology information systems, and other clinical and operational sources.
   

  

 The platform supports everything from treatment workflow analysis, patient volumes, machine utilization, and resource planning to the analysis of treatment patterns and long-term patient outcomes. By making data more accessible and trustworthy, RayIntelligence enables clinics to better understand their operations, learn from past treatments, and continuously improve care.
   

  

 For healthcare analytics to be useful, clinics need confidence in the data they are using. Metrics must be calculated consistently, results must be understandable, and the path from source data to displayed insight must be possible to verify. The platform is already deployed at customer sites, and we are now focused on expanding both its analytical capabilities and its adoption across clinics worldwide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The role spans data ingestion, integration, transformation, analytical data modeling, and the implementation of new analytics use cases.
   

  

 Working in healthcare brings unique engineering challenges. Data quality, traceability, reproducibility, validation, and risk management are important parts of how we develop software. While RayIntelligence is not a medical device, we apply many of the same engineering principles and quality practices used throughout RaySearch.
   

  

 Unlike internal analytics teams, we are building a product for environments where we do not operate the source systems ourselves. Development must therefore account for limited access to real-world customer data, variation between customer environments, and the need to build analytics that clinics can understand and trust.
   

  

 The platform currently focuses on analytics and reporting use cases, but future AI and machine learning capabilities are expected to build upon the foundations being developed today.
   

  

 RaySearch supports the use of modern AI-assisted development tools where appropriate, while maintaining the quality standards and engineering rigor required in healthcare software development.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Capture and integrate data from clinical and operational source systems
* Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines
* Develop analytical data models supporting product capabilities and customer use cases
* Implement new analytics capabilities using SQL and Python
* Contribute to architecture and design decisions related to scalability, maintainability, and data quality
* Improve observability, traceability, and reliability across the platform
* Ensure that metrics, transformations, and data flows can be understood, tested, and verified
* Participate in validation, testing, and risk-management activities appropriate for healthcare software environments


**Technology Stack**
**Our Platform Includes Technologies And Programming Languages Such As**
* Python & SQL
* PostgreSQL & SQL Server
* dbt
* AWS
* CDC-based ingestion
* Apache Superset


**Your Profile**
 We believe successful candidates will typically have experience in several of the following areas:
   

  

* SQL development
* Python development
* Data engineering and ELT/ETL development
* Data modeling and data warehousing
* Experience applying software engineering best practices to data platforms and production systems
* Translating product and analytical requirements into robust technical solutions
* Working with data quality, observability, testing, or traceability in production data systems
* Formal education in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field is beneficial. Equivalent practical experience is equally valued
* Seniority is typically demonstrated through several years of professional experience designing, building, and operating production data systems


**Our Culture**
 At RaySearch, we share a passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our team consists of dedicated experts who strive to deliver exceptional results through collaboration, attention to detail, and cutting-edge technology. We take pride in our role as a leader in cancer treatment, developing solutions that truly make a difference for patients worldwide.
   

  

**Our Offer**
 We offer a dynamic and inclusive work environment in Hagastaden, Stockholm’s Life Science Hub. Our modern office space includes an in-house gym, yoga classes, and social activities such as ping pong, table football, and after-work events. We also provide a fantastic lunch buffet, daily fika, and a stunning rooftop terrace with a 360-degree view of Stockholm. This comes with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
   

  

**Application**
 Please apply for the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications via e-mail.

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------



At Volvo Cars, we are on a mission to provide freedom to move in a personal, sustainable, and safe way. As vehicles become increasingly connected and software-defined, cybersecurity is a critical enabler of safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and customer confidence.

  



We are now looking for a Senior CSMS Engineer to strengthen cybersecurity governance and engineering coordination within ConX / Head Unit Platform. The Head Unit Platform organization provides and maintains the core infotainment platform that powers the in-car experience. It is responsible for platform engineering, software releases, ECU/head unit ownership, and functional safety, ensuring a stable and scalable foundation for all customer-facing applications and vehicle functions. In this role, you will help ensure that cybersecurity activities are planned, executed, reviewed, traced, and evidenced in line with the Cybersecurity Management System (CSMS), UNECE R155, and ISO/SAE 21434 expectations.

  



You will work closely with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, software developers, system architects, verification teams, suppliers, Shield / central CSMS stakeholders, CSAP / Quality, and PSIRT to make ConX cybersecurity work products audit-ready and delivery-focused.

**What you'll do**
------------------


* Drive CSMS execution and coordination for ConX / Head Unit Platform cybersecurity activities across planning, development, verification, release, and post-development support
* Coordinate creation, review readiness, and lifecycle maintenance of cybersecurity work products such as CSPD, TARA, Cybersecurity Concept, cybersecurity requirements, verification specifications, SWTR, CSPV, CS Case / CAC, CS-SOW, and CSJR evidence
* Ensure traceability from cybersecurity requirements to verification activities, validation evidence, Software Test Reports (SWTR), and cybersecurity case evidence
* Support TARA activities by facilitating risk discussions, aligning security goals and risk treatment decisions, and ensuring outputs are reflected in security concepts and requirements
* Coordinate audit and homologation readiness by tracking evidence completeness, Teamcenter publication/release status, review records, and open gaps before they become certification blockers
* Act as the ConX interface towards Shield / central CSMS support on CSMS questions, templates, process alignment, compliance expectations, and evidence status
* Prepare and maintain CSMS delivery status, governance dashboards, risk summaries, and escalation material for Product Owners, Engineering Managers, ART leadership, and central cybersecurity stakeholders
* Coordinate confirmation review and assessment preparation with CSAP / Quality, ensuring verification review findings are closed and work products are ready for independent review
* Support supplier cybersecurity coordination by following up CS-SOW / CSJR expectations, supplier evidence status, and supplier-related cybersecurity risks or deviations
* Contribute to vulnerability-management and PSIRT-related coordination by ensuring ConX impact assessments, remediation evidence, and updated CSMS work products are aligned when cybersecurity issues affect infotainment scope
* Coach and guide ARTs and feature teams on CSMS expectations, cybersecurity documentation quality, evidence creation, and secure-by-design ways of working
* Continuously improve the local ConX CSMS operating model by identifying bottlenecks, ownership gaps, recurring evidence issues, and opportunities to simplify delivery while maintaining compliance
**What you'll bring**
---------------------



To succeed in this role, you bring strong cybersecurity process knowledge, engineering judgement, and the ability to coordinate complex technical deliveries across multiple teams:


* University degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, automotive software development, system engineering, compliance engineering, product governance, or related technical roles
* Solid understanding of automotive cybersecurity lifecycle activities, including cybersecurity planning, TARA, cybersecurity concepts, requirements, verification, validation, and cybersecurity cases
* Practical knowledge of CSMS expectations and regulatory frameworks such as UNECE R155 and ISO/SAE 21434
* Experience coordinating cybersecurity work products, evidence chains, review preparation, and audit or certification readiness activities
* Ability to work across organizational boundaries with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, architects, software teams, verification teams, suppliers, and central process stakeholders
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate cybersecurity compliance needs into practical engineering actions
* Structured way of working, with confidence in tracking deliverables, risks, dependencies, deviations, and decisions
* Ability to challenge unclear ownership, identify traceability gaps, and drive resolution pragmatically without losing stakeholder alignment
* Comfortable working in agile / ART-based development environments where compliance deliverables must be integrated into product planning and release execution

title: Engineering Manager RadioPharmacy
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


We are looking for our next Engineering Leader for the Global RadioPharma business segment, part of the Molecular Imaging and Computed Tomography (MICT) Engineering team at GE HealthCare. This role leads an engineering team responsible for RadioPharmaceutical Isotope production systems and processing solutions.  

  

These systems and solutions play an increasingly important role in Oncology, Neurology, and Cardiology care pathways, enabling early and precise diagnosis for personalized treatment and therapy guidance. Our products impact the care of millions of patients daily and support cutting-edge medical research. GE HealthCare has been a leader in medical imaging history and continues to define the future of this essential work.  

  

This role oversees all engineering efforts across Field, Factory, and Futures activities for the RadioPharma business segment. Specifically, the leader guides the team responsible for delivering successful Advanced Technology Development (ATD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) programs, meeting key deliverables, driving end-to-end execution, achieving product quality targets, and ensuring business continuity through Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Service. This leader will work with product management teams, manufacturing, and sourcing to support customers and ensure customer operations uptime, manufacturing continuity, safety, quality, and cost.  

  

This position requires guiding the engineering team in solving technical problems in the field or factory, and shaping customer-needs-based and outcomes-driven global technology and innovation roadmaps for future products and solutions. The role demands acting on all matters related to the RadioPharma engineering department and program plans, within the boundaries defined for each program and the overall engineering budget. Participation in the GEHC business process, including World Wide Technology Planning (WWTP), World Wide Product Planning (WWPP), Long Term Strategy (LTS), and Annual Talent Review sessions, is essential.**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities:**
-------------------------------

* Own the complete end-to-end engineering of RadioPharmaceutical Isotope production systems and processing solutions – roadmap, conceptualization, design, implementation, and install base management.
* Manage team stakeholders and priorities; work closely with the RadioPharma Business Segment leader, Product Management, Marketing, Service, and Program Management Office to prioritize engineering activities and define system roadmaps. Clearly communicate complex technical information and progress in an organized, simple, and easy-to-understand manner to both leadership and team members.
* Provide operational management for the engineering team; manage budgets, milestones, and KPIs for ongoing support and projects. Drive ATD projects for new ideas and innovations. Ensure that engineering teams consider design for manufacturability, install, and service early in the product design cycle. Collaborate with advanced manufacturing engineering and sourcing teams, ensuring their inputs are considered in design.
* Handle the deliverables of a team of 40 to 50 engineers with diverse skills, ensuring that programs are delivered on time with safety and quality requirements through Lean and Design for Six Sigma practices.
* Foster technical leadership and engineering excellence in the core technologies required for these systems and corresponding subsystems. Manage career development and performance processes. Promote the growth of technical experts in these core technologies and ensure the depth and breadth of the team for supporting new designs and installed base quality.
* Coach and mentor the engineering team with end-to-end ownership and accountability. Drive rigor in design controls, design transfer, verification, validation, and acceptance activities to ensure that product, equipment, tools, processes, software, training, and documentation meet requirements.
* Ensure product compliance with Local and Global regulatory guidelines, rules, and standards; GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position.
* Be a key member of the Uppsala site leadership team.
* Develop and maintain program plans with individual program managers/LPIs, including productivity programs.
* Participate in scheduled program reviews. Maintain and communicate appropriate Quality and program metrics.
* Utilize appropriate communication methods and processes at all levels of the organization to promote team goals, progress, and results.
* Adhere to the GEHC Quality System, using the PRD process and the EQPM during the engineering design process.
* Facilitate the protection of IP.
* Provide product quality support.
* Support Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) activities, as required.

**Quality Specific Goals:**
---------------------------

* Be aware of and comply with the GEHC Quality Manual, Quality Management System, Quality Management Policy, Quality Goals, and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position.
* Complete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines.
* Identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate corrective action as required.
* Drive compliance/closure of Regulatory and Quality requirements before approving Design Outputs/Program Deliverables.
* Champion continuous improvement activities by initiating process and product quality improvement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* Overall industry experience of more than 15 years with 10 years of engineering and/or program management and leadership experience.
* BS in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry or equivalent (defined as a High School Diploma/GED and 20 years relative experience).
* 15 years progressive experience as an engineer or scientist within the appropriate field of study, including 7 years experience in leadership within a manufacturing, development, or research environment.
* Experience in complex systems design, qualification, and support. Extensive experience and functional expertise in quality, reliability, and Lean.
* Strong experience in Stakeholder and Priority management, working closely with Business segment leaders and global teams.
* Demonstrated leadership and project management skills. Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, facilitation, and coaching skills.
* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* High level of energy, drive, and enthusiasm.
* Strong process skills and business analysis skills.
* Strong English skills.
* Must be legally authorized to work in Sweden full-time.
* Must be willing to work in our Uppsala facility full-time.

**Desired Characteristics:**
----------------------------

* MS or PhD in Engineering or Physics or equivalent experience.
* Advanced degree in relevant engineering disciplines, such as electronics or high energy physics.
* Experience in relevant complex electronics design, including RadioFrequency (RF) electronic systems.
* Familiar with artificial intelligence and deep learning technologies to either enhance engineering team efficiency or drive product performance.
* Strategic planner and thinker with the ability to drive change across the business, products, and industry.
* Experience driving technology and business planning processes with a focus on differentiation and financial return.
* External focus. Understands the customer and market and is able to translate opportunities into concrete actions.
* Experience with medical/radiopharmacy equipment.
* Proven competency in key business tools such as Change Acceleration (CAP), LEAN, etc.
* Ability to prioritize and drive multiple programs.
* Experience working with academic institutions for advanced research.

**Inclusion and Diversity**
---------------------------


GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**Behaviors**
-------------


We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards**
-----------------


Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

title: Solutions Engineer, Sweden
description:
### **About Us**



At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world's largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine's Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.



At Cloudflare, we're not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we're looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you'll fit right in.

**Available Locations**
-----------------------


* Sweden

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers.
* You are a customer facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team. You have experience in working in a pre-sales or other technical customer facing role supporting large enterprise accounts or acquiring new enterprise customers, as well as excellent verbal and written communication skills suited to explain the benefits of CloudFlare products and services to existing and potential customers. In this role you will be responsible for partnering with the sales team to understand customer requirements and provide sales support, prepare and deliver technical presentations and demos explaining the benefits of Cloudflare products to existing and potential customers, and run proof of concept trials for customers.


Specifically, we are looking for you to:


* Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems to Cloudflare solutions
* Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts
* Develop and present customer presentations at every Enterprise Customer's organization level
* Lead demo and proof-of-concept activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers
* Demonstrate your expertise of Cloudflare with your peers through the creation of professional content, including white papers, blog posts and other knowledge sharing activities
* Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology, Cybersecurity and Industry focused events with thought leadership and expertise.
* Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.

**Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience**
-----------------------------------------------


* Fluency in a Nordic language
* Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer facing technical role with CDN, Security, Networking or SaaS
* Solid communication, written and presentation skills
* Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently
* Highly driven individuals that are curious, team players and work with a sense of urgency
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in relevant work experience
* The role requires up to 50% travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.
* Fundamental understanding of customer network and/or application architectures.
* Detailed understanding of workflow from user to application including hybrid architectures with Azure, AWS, GCP.
* Understanding, knowledge or experience of application and/or network security
* Understanding, knowledge or experiences with SaaS application environments
* Understanding, knowledge or experience with VPN and remote access challenges
* Understanding, knowledge or experience with SIEM and log analytics platforms
* Client OS fundamentals and software distribution
* Experience interacting with senior level/executives to communicate a message of network and security transformation
* Routing, subnetting, split tunnels. SD-WAN, local internet breakout
* End user and application security risks - DDoS, malware, phishing, viruses
* Knowledge of competitive market around CDN providers and internet security technologies

**Compensation**
----------------



For Sweden based hires: Estimated annual salary is between SEK 1,102,000 - SEK 1,515,000.



This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.


### **Equity**



This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

### **What Makes Cloudflare Special?**



We're not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We're a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.


**Project Galileo**: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare's enterprise customers-at no cost.


**Athenian Project**: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.


**1.1.1.1**: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here's the deal - we don't store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.



Sound like something you'd like to be a part of? We'd love to hear from you!



Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.



This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.



Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.



Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

description:
### **Job description**


Vi söker en erfaren och engagerad R&D Manager för en ledande teknikverksamhet i södra Skåne. Företaget utvecklar och tillverkar avancerade elektroniska produkter för industriella tillämpningar och befinner sig i en spännande tillväxtfas. title: Software Engineering Analyst
description:
**Software, the fuel for mobility**  

We bring bold digital visions to life. So we’re on the lookout for more curious and creative engineers who want to create change – one line of high-quality code at a time. Our transformation isn't for everyone, but if you're excited about solving the leading-edge technological challenges facing the auto industry, then let’s talk about your next move.

**Let's introduce ourselves**
-----------------------------

  

The Resource Management team is responsible for testing Resource management including Wake up and shutdown. We work with manual testing and test automation. The team covers the following test environments: vehicle, boxcar, domain HIL and base tech HIL. Each team member covers 1-2 environments. In your daily work you update software in the test environment, run tests, take logs, analyse logs and try to identify root cause to issues. When needed, we also support other teams with troubleshooting.  

  

The majority of the test team are working in Gothenburg but we also have remote members based in Krakow.

**What you'll do**
------------------

  


We are looking for an experienced and driven Software Vehicle Test Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring the quality and reliability of software in real vehicle environments. You will work hands-on with test vehicles, executing and developing tests, analyzing results, and collaborating closely with system designers and software developers to resolve issues and improve solutions.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Update and integrate software builds in test vehicles
* Design, develop, and maintain test cases and test strategies
* Execute tests in vehicles and other test environments
* Analyze test results, logs, and data to identify issues and trends
* Troubleshoot software and system issues in collaboration with cross-functional teams
* Propose and drive solutions together with system designers and developers
* Document findings, test results, and improvement recommendations
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing methods, tools, and processes
**What you'll bring**
---------------------

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

  

* Proven experience in software testing in automotive
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Experience working with vehicle systems, ECUs
* Ability to read and interpret logs, traces, and diagnostic data
* Hands-on experience in test design and execution
* Experience with tools such as **CANalyzer, INCA, ParallelDiag, DSA, and DLT**
* Familiarity with debugging tools and test frameworks
* Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience

  

  

**Personal Skills**

  

* Strong collaboration and communication skills across disciplines
* Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive
* Ability to work independently while being a strong team player
* Curiosity and persistence in troubleshooting complex issues
**Volvo Cars. For Life.**  

For nearly a century, Volvo Cars has empowered people to move freely in a personal, sustainable and safe way. Today, we are driving bold advancements in electrification, sustainability and automotive safety. To realise our ambitious vision, we are seeking innovative minds who are ready to tackle the challenges of tomorrow – today.
  

  

At Volvo Cars, we believe extraordinary things are achieved by ordinary people with a passion for making a difference. If you’re inspired by the opportunity to help redefine the future of mobility, we invite you to be part of our journey.  

  

**Ready to take the next step?**  

  

Submit your CV in English and tell us why you’re the ideal candidate for a role at Volvo Cars. Applications must be received no later than 11th of September 2026. You will receive a confirmation email after your submission.  

  

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Recruiter Radoslaw Piela at radoslaw.piela@volvocars.com. For specific questions about the position, please reach out to Hiring Manager EMELIE NORMAND at EMELIE.NORMAND@VOLVOCARS.COM.  

  

As part of the recruitment process, the final candidates will undergo a background check.  

  

We welcome your application!
