title: Member of the technical staff
description:
**Company Description**

**About Paraglide**
-------------------


Paraglide is a fast-growing AI startup, backed by the investors behind Anthropic, LinkedIn, Shopify, and Twitch. We build AI agents for back-office finance teams, helping them manage their email inbox and get paid faster.


We're a team of 20, based in Malmö and London. The role is in person in central Malmö

### **How are you?**

* You are an fantastic product builder and engineer
* You get things done, and you understand why that matters more in a startup than almost anywhere else.
* You're good at solving problems, and the hard ones are what get you going.
* You thrive in a fast-paced environment where the answer isn't always clear.
* You think the work should be fun, and that a startup is about doing things together.

### **Role Description**

**TL;DR:** We're looking for someone who wants to own problems, not just tasks. Someone who enjoys going deep technically, cares deeply about our customers, and wants to help build the next big financial enterprise software company.


We're a team of engineers who work end to end: understanding the problem, shaping the product, then designing, building, deploying, and operating the solution. We believe in strong ownership and giving engineers the freedom and responsibility to make an impact.


We're **customer obsessed**. Great engineering starts with understanding the why, not just the how. That means working closely with customers, challenging assumptions, and constantly looking for a better product.


Our ambition is to build the next generation of financial enterprise software: products that become foundational to how modern financial organizations operate. It's a space where reliability, scale, flexibility, and trust matter, and where there's real room to rethink what enterprise software can be.


That means systems that handle large volumes of data, scale with our customers, and run across different hosting environments. Designing beyond a single deployment model is core to how we build.


You don't need to be an expert in everything, but you should be curious and comfortable working across the stack. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk.

### **How we work**


We believe software can and should be built with AI, and we invest real engineering time in making that work well - agent-friendly architecture, conventions agents can follow, and tooling that keeps quality high at speed.


This changes what we look for. Recognizing good code matters more than knowing any particular language. Judgment, taste, and knowing when something is wrong are the skills that carry over.

#### **Our stack**

* TypeScript across frontend and backend
* NestJS
* Next.js
* Postgres with Prisma
* AWS for hosting
* GitHub for code, reviews, and CI via GitHub Actions
* Docker
* Terraform for infrastructure as code

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Subscriptions
description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. This team oversees the entire user journey on Spotify and ensures we engage with people in innovative ways, every step of the way. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
   

  

 We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys.
* Collaborate with our squad and key internal partners to determine how to design scalable backend systems, data models and APIs that run on Google Cloud Platform.
* Be a technical leader, mentor and valued contributor in an autonomous, cross-functional agile squad, in close collaboration with other squads and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 5+ years of working experience as a Backend Engineer working with Java. Additional tools and technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery and Bigtable are a plus.
* You have strong computer science fundamentals and previous experience building complex backend services at scale.
* You have experience in designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components on providers such as GCP, AWS, etc.
* You have experience working directly with stakeholders to understand, document and develop APIs and systems to meet their requirements.
* You are comfortable working collaboratively on cross-functional teams and independently driving complex delivery initiatives.
* You have written distributed, high-volume services and know how to deploy and operate them in production.
* You have a growth mindset and are passionate about your work, striving towards the team’s goals and, ultimately, the Spotify Mission.
* Nice-to-haves: Experience modelling, building and operating integrations with external CMS solutions or working with ML teams for recommendations and data pipelines.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Senior Software Engineer – Automotive AI Inference Stack
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer for Automotive AI Inference to develop and optimize the software stack that enables machine learning inference on Infineon Automotive microcontrollers.
 



 In this role, you will work at the intersection of machine learning, compiler technologies, embedded software, runtime optimization, and automotive systems. You will be responsible for building the foundational software components that allow ML models to be deployed efficiently on automotive-grade MCUs while meeting stringent requirements for performance, memory utilization, reliability, and functional safety.
 



 You will collaborate closely with MCU architects, automotive application teams, and strategic customers to deliver production-ready AI software solutions for next-generation vehicles.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and implement high-performance inference runtimes for Infineon Automotive microcontrollers and integrate AI inference pipelines into embedded software stacks and real-time operating system environments.
* Optimize models and runtime performance for latency, memory usage, power efficiency, and reliability.
* Utilize MCU-specific acceleration capabilities and architecture-specific optimizations and implement highly efficient mathematical libraries for embedded inference.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams including firmware, hardware, and algorithm engineers to ensure successful system integration.
* Support maintainable deployment processes through version control, reproducibility, and traceability.
* Evaluate and apply appropriate tools and frameworks for model conversion, quantization, and on-device inference.
* Support strategic automotive customers during proof-of-concept and production phases and provide technical guidance on AI deployment best practices.



  
 



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in: Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related technical field
* Expert-level C/C++ development.
* Good understanding of model quantization, memory optimization and performance tuning on constrained hardware.
* Experience deploying AI/ML models to edge devices using frameworks or toolchains such as TensorFlow Lite Micro, ONNX, ExecuTorch, or similar
* Familiarity with sensor or signal processing workflows, including time-series data such as vibration, audio, current, or power signals.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across software, model, and hardware integration layers.
* Ability to support the full deployment lifecycle from prototype through production.
* Proactive self-starter who takes ownership, contributes to strategic discussions, adapts to evolving priorities, and helps shape the future of our products.
* Collaborative and independent engineer who maintains high programming standards while supporting colleagues and ensuring customer success.



  
 



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience in Automotive embedded applications, incl. experience with / exposure to ISO 26262 and AUTOSAR requirements.
* Experience with MCU-based AI acceleration or related edge inference platforms.
* Knowledge of model lifecycle management, firmware release processes, and production validation.
* Experience using Python-based ML tools for model preparation, evaluation, and conversion



  
 



**What we offer:** 



* The opportunity to further develop our development platform, responsible for bringing deep learning to the edge
* Being a part of an excellent international team with highly motivated individuals striving for a common goal
* A chance to be a part of solving real-world problems using ML
* Competitive salary, wellness allowance, possibility to attend online-courses
* A humble and an open-minded company culture
* Opportunities to grow with the company and advance your career
* Short decision paths, we love getting things done
* An office in central Stockholm and the flexibility of working from home

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Vill du vara med och förändra pensionsbranschen?**
*Är du en kreativ problemlösare med en passion för att strukturera och organisera information? Brinner du för att skapa affärsvärde utifrån data? Då är du den vi söker!*
**Om tjänsten** 
**🚀**
 Att effektivt använda data operationellt och för analys är centralt för att lyckas i SPPs kommande utveckling. I rollen som data engineer spelar du en avgörande roll i att effektivt skapa värde ur data genom att bygga vår nya dataplattform tillsammans med resten av teamet.
   

  

 Förutsättningarna finns för att du ska kunna göra stor skillnad. Vi är i en förändringsfas där vi bygger nya tekniska lösningar samt förändrar kulturen kring hur data produceras och konsumeras. Du kommer vara med att sätta denna grund. Satsningen inom datadomänen samt förståelse för utmaningen är väl förankrad i SPPs ledningsgrupp.
   

  

 Hos SPP Tech får du en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med fokus på innovation och utveckling. Du kommer att vara en del av ett engagerat team och ha stora möjligheter att påverka och utvecklas i din roll. Du kommer rapportera till Head of Data och vara en del av ett team på totalt tio personer.
   

  

**Vem är du?** 
**👋**
 För att lyckas i rollen tror vi du är nyfiken på att utforska nya tekniska lösningar och att utveckla nya arbetssätt tillsammans med andra. Du behöver kunna balansera utforskande av nya lösningar med att samtidigt skapa ordning och reda. Du har ett coachande förhållningssätt där du bidrar till andras utveckling och gärna erfarenhet av att ta en tech/development lead roll. Vi tror du har:
   

  

* Flera års erfarenhet av liknande roller, gärna att viss erfarenhet är inom bank- eller försäkringsbranschen.
* Erfarenhet av dimensionsmodellering. Vår tech stack bygger på Snowflake, DBT, Dagster, DLT och programmering i Python.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med CI/CD och DevOps samt mycket goda kunskaper i SQL.
* Erfarenhet av att designa och utveckla nya tekniska lösningar inom data samt ersätta gammal ETL-kod med ELT.
* Förmågan och drivet att agera på eget initiativ och få saker att hända.
* God samarbetsförmåga.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska.


**Varför välja SPP?** 
**💚**
 SPP är en del av den nordiska finanskoncernen Storebrand. Tillsammans skapar vi en framtid att glädjas åt genom att vägleda till ekonomiska beslut som gynnar individen, samhället och planeten långsiktigt på ett enkelt sätt. Vi sitter i helt nyrenoverade lokaler precis intill Stockholms centralstation och erbjuder en hybrid arbetsvardag, med majoriteten av tiden på kontoret. På SPP värdesätter vi de perspektiv och erfarenheter som en jämn könsfördelning och mångfald bidrar med, och välkomnar därför sökande oavsett kön, bakgrund eller livserfarenhet.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 Du är varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast 6 september. I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV, men i stället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig svara på några urvalsfrågor kopplat till tjänsten.
   

  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen får du gärna höra av dig till Kim Wedenberg, Head of Data, kim.wedenberg@spp.se eller Clairy Zhao, Rekryteringsansvarig, clairy.zhao@spp.se.
   

  

*Kontaktuppgifter till våra lokala fackförbund*
 Mattias Thunström, Finansförbundet, tel 070-864 41 11
   

  

 Anna Peltovuori, Akademikerföreningen, tel 070-648 17 55
   

  

*Med kandidatens samtycke görs en bakgrundskontroll under anställningsprocessens slutskede som innebär kontroll av personalia, ekonomiska förhållanden och juridiska frågor. Även CV och annan ansökningsdokumentation kan komma att verifieras.*

title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Marketing Analytics
description:
**THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL**
**You?** 
 A Senior Analytics Engineer with a platform mindset, ready to build high-impact data models and architect scalable marketing data infrastructure.
   

  

**Role?** 
 A Senior Analytics and Infrastructure Engineer for User Engagement and Marketing, responsible for setting the engineering standard for our team.
   

  

**Tech stack?** 
 SQL, Python, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and Fivetran.
   

  

**Location?** 
 Join us in our Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, and Copenhagen offices with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely.
   

  

**Company?** 
 Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen, where millions of people across the Nordics connect to find what they need, whether it’s a job, a home, a way to move, or a fresh start.
   

  

**Why us?** 
 This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by laying the engineering foundation for our User Engagement and Marketing teams. You’ll have the autonomy to shape our architecture while enjoying professional growth opportunities and the chance to experiment with AI-driven analytics.
   

  

 Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below!
   

  

**WHO ARE YOU?**
 We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and problem-solving styles. Whether you come from a traditional computer science background or have taken a non-traditional path to data engineering, we care most about your ability to solve complex problems and your desire to build.
   

  

* Senior-level experience: You have a proven track record as an Analytics Engineer, Data Infrastructure Engineer, or in a similar capacity, ideally within a high-growth tech or e-commerce environment.
* Technical mastery: You are proficient in SQL, Python, and cloud data warehousing (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery). You are comfortable with dbt, Airflow, and Fivetran to orchestrate seamless data flows.Also proficient with Funnel and Datastore tools
* Marketing data fluency: You understand the nuances of the marketing ecosystem, including attribution models (Appsflyer), funnel analysis, and customer lifecycle data.
* Strategic & Collaborative: You translate complex business goals—like LTV maximization or churn reduction—into robust engineering solutions. You are a natural collaborator who communicates effectively with non-technical stakeholders, Data Scientists, and Product teams.
* Pioneering Spirit: You are comfortable working in a "start-up" mode within a larger organization. You don’t just write code; you design systems and set technical direction for the future.
* Language skills: Fluency in English is required as we are an international team working across multiple Nordic markets, and documentation/collaboration happens in English.


**WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE?**
 This is a unique, high-impact role. As our first dedicated engineer for this team, you won't just be maintaining systems—you will be designing them.
   

  

**The Mission:** 
 Your goal is to establish the core data infrastructure that powers our User Engagement and Marketing efforts, enabling automation, reporting, and our transition into AI/LLM-powered analytics.
   

  

**A Typical Week**
* Designing Infrastructure: You will architect automated, scalable pipelines for data ingestion and pre-processing.
* Product Development: You will develop high-utility data products to support triggered communications and user lifecycle events.
* Innovation: You will work on "ARIA" (Analytical Reasoning & Insight Assistant), our internal LLM tool, moving from conceptualization to engineering the data schemas that make the tool "AI-ready."
* Stakeholder Collaboration: You will partner closely with Marketing Managers to understand their data needs, and with Data Scientists to ensure our data models are consistent and actionable.


**A FEW WORDS FROM YOUR MANAGER?**
 Hi, I am Tarun Tolia, Head of User Engagement & Marketing Analytics. Our User Engagement Team is a dedicated group of specialists focused on keeping our millions of users coming back. We are a collaborative bunch who value curiosity over hierarchy. I believe in giving my team the autonomy to solve hard problems, and I’m looking for someone who isn't afraid to challenge the status quo with data.”
   

  

 Want to get a feel for our culture and what drives us? Take a peek behind the scenes at our Career Page!
   

  

**GOT YOUR ATTENTION?**
 Let us hear from you! Turn yourself in by
 **30th August 2026.** 
 We will start reviewing applications as they come in rolling basis
   

  

**QUESTIONS?**
**Tarun Tolia** 
 , Head of User Engagement
 **,** 
 is happy to provide information about the daily work and answer any questions you may have about the role via email: tarun.t.tolia@vend.com. For the recruitment process, you can reach out to
 **Clayton Don Corda** 
 at clayton.don.corda@vend.com

title: Snowflake Data Architect
description:

title: Postdoctoral researcher in  bioinformatics and translational breast cancer
description:
******Do you want to contribute to top quality medical research?******




 The research group of Professor Johan Hartman at the Oncology-Pathology department performs clinical and translational studies for breast cancer, with a special focus on precision cancer medicine and diagnostics. The aim is to better predict individual patients' unique treatment response, as well as to understand the role of tumor heterogeneity and tumor-stromal interactions in breast cancer disease progression.
   

  





 We have well-established research lines that use a multitude of methods, including AI-assisted clinical and molecular pathology, genetic analysis, and population registry-based statistics, in a concerted effort to identify key factors contributing to current breast cancer treatment hurdles, as well as to identify novel biomarkers for further development into new diagnostic and therapeutic opportunities.
   

  





 The successful candidate will have access to our unique patient datasets and is expected to conduct top-level breast cancer studies in collaboration with our collaborators at KI, KTH, and the Science for Life Laboratory.
   

  





****Your mission****




 We are looking for a highly motivated postdoc with a strong bioinformatic data analysis background to join our multidisciplinary team of clinicians, bioinformaticians, computer scientists, and biologists. The postdoc candidate's main tasks will include analysis of genomic, transcriptomic, and DNA methylation data, including somatic mutation and copy-number alteration calling, gene expression, signature and pathway analyses, and multi-omics integration using machine-learning methods.
   

  





 The position also involves developing and maintaining computational pipelines for genomic and transcriptomic data analysis, including datasets generated from single-cell and spatial omics technologies. In addition, the candidate may contribute to the analysis of large-scale clinical and population-based registry data, applying biostatistical methods to investigate clinically relevant research questions.
   

  





 The ideal candidate will be passionate about data-driven biomedical research, enjoy working in a collaborative environment, and be eager to contribute to innovative projects at the intersection of cancer biology, genomics, and computational science.
   

  





****Your profile****




 To be eligible for employment as a postdoctoral researcher, a PhD or a foreign degree deemed to be equivalent to a Swedish PhD is required. This eligibility requirement must be fulfilled at the latest at the time of the employment decision. Completion of your doctoral degree within the last three years is considered an advantage. If there are special reasons, your degree may have been completed earlier.
   

  





**Essential requirements:** 



* A Ph.D. degree in bioinformatics, computational biology, molecular biology, computer science, or an equivalent quantitative area.
* Proficiency in a scripting language like R/Python, as well as the ability to work efficiently in a Linux command-line environment.
* Prior experience with sequencing data (DNA/RNA/methylation etc.) analysis supported by publications. Experience with spatial transcriptomic, single-cell sequencing, multi-omics data integration, and/or computational pathology tools is advantageous.
* Basic knowledge of molecular biology and/or cancer and interest in learning more.
* Excellent interpersonal communication skills (written and verbal English).
* Good data management and documentation skills.



**Desirable competencies:** 



* Experience in biostatistics is a big plus.
* Experience in prospective and/or retrospective analyses of clinical cohort data.
* Experience in oncology research.
* Experience in using relevant AI softwares.
* Experience in genomic databases and cancer data resources, such as TCGA, COSMIC, dbSNP, etc.



****What do we offer?****




 A creative and inspiring environment with wide-ranging expertise and interests. Karolinska Institutet is one of the world's leading medical universities. At Karolinska Institutet, we conduct successful medical research and hold the largest range of medical education in Sweden. At KI, you get to meet researchers working with a wide range of specialisms and methods, giving you ample opportunity to exchange knowledge and experience with the various scientific fields within medicine and health. It is the crossover collaborations, which have pushed KI to where it is today, at the forefront of global research. Several of the people you meet in healthcare are educated at KI. A close relationship with the health care providers is important for creating groundbreaking top quality education and research. Karolinska Institutet is also a state university, which entitles you to several benefits through our collective agreement.
   

  





  

  





 Location: The position is located within the Oncology-Pathology department, mainly at BioClinicum in Solna.
   

  





*Choose to work at KI – Ten reasons why*




  
   

  





****Application****




 An employment application must contain the following documents in English or Swedish:
 


* PhD certificate
* A complete resumé, including date of the thesis defence, title of the thesis, previous academic positions, academic title, current position, academic distinctions, and committee work
* A complete list of publications
* A summary of current work (no more than one page)



 KI applies individual and differentiated salary setting in accordance with our collective agreements RALS and RALS-T
   

  





 The application is to be submitted through the Varbi recruitment system. At the latest 22nd September.
   

  





 The position is for two years with possibility of extension.
   

  





****Want to make a difference? Join us and contribute to better health for all!****

title: Senior R&D Operations Specialist
description:
We're bold thinkers and kind teammates, growing fast but staying grounded. Our Nordic roots and global outlook shape a culture of friendliness, creativity, and collaboration, all powered by openness and shared wins. We care deeply about doing the right thing - and doing it together. We aim to improve the flow of goods, time, and energy - and we know we can't shape the future by clinging to the past. So, we keep evolving, together.
   

  

 RELEX Solutions delivers a unified supply chain planning platform for retailers and manufacturers, enabled by proven AI technology. We help companies optimize demand forecasting, replenishment, merchandising, pricing and promotions, supply chain operations, and production planning across the end-to-end value chain.
   

  

 With a global team of over 2,000 professionals, we work side-by-side with our customers to solve real problems with lasting impact. Companies trust RELEX to increase product availability, boost sales, deliver actionable insights, improve sustainability, and drive profitable growth. Join us and make an impact on the world and your career!
   

  

 In response to our ongoing AI transformation, we are looking for a Senior R&D Operations Specialist to be the person who owns, administers, and evolves the AI developer tools that our engineers depend on every day.
   

  

**What We Need You To Do And Be**
 Bring your ideas. Challenge ours. Grow with us.
   

  

* You will take ownership of the AI and developer tools our R&D organisation adopts — administering, configuring, and managing them at scale across 300–400 engineers
* You will monitor tool usage, costs, and anomalies, and put the guardrails in place that keep our AI tooling safe and cost-efficient
* You will research how our tools can be configured and evolved to give engineers as much freedom as possible within sensible boundaries
* You will stay current on the rapidly-changing AI tooling landscape and bring well-reasoned recommendations to the team
* You will work with vendors, internal stakeholders in R&D Operations and Business IT, and the wider engineering community to ensure we are delivering what the organisation needs


**What You'll Bring To The Table**
 Our five values are our playbook. We speak up when things don't make sense. We stop doing what doesn't add value. We stay curious, back each other up, and make space for both innovation and laughter.
   

  

* Hands-on experience owning or administering at least one AI or developer tool at organisational scale — e.g. ChatGPT Enterprise, GitHub Copilot, Claude / Anthropic, Cursor, or similar
* Technical depth: you understand how these tools actually work under the hood, not just as an end user
* A self-management mindset — you take ownership, drive things forward without being told what to do, and are comfortable being the person with the most domain knowledge on the team
* Ability and willingness to build structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment
* People skills to navigate stakeholders and develop the vendor management side over time
* Comfortable with using AI in your everyday work and developing the use of AI tools as a larger organisational strategy
* Fluent in written and spoken English
* As a bonus, we consider the experience of working with an international team, plus great communication and organisational skills


**What We Offer In Return**
 You'll be supported and given the space to thrive. We offer meaningful work, flexibility, and a culture that backs you to share your voice and be authentic.
   

  

* An international career and learning opportunities
* A rapidly growing and financially robust software company with exciting opportunities for career growth, also in the future
* Flexibility in how and where you work
* Room to thrive in a fast-growing global company with a good market position
* Practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life
* Annual leave
* Diverse, inclusive, and supportive work culture
* Work that meaningfully reduces waste and improves sustainability
* Ownership, autonomy and flat hierarchies
* Two paid volunteering days each year
* Real strategic ownership — you are the person who decides how our AI tools are administered, configured, and evolved. This is not a support function.
* You'll be working at the absolute forefront of where software development is going, in a company that has fully committed to the AI transformation


 If you feel this is the opportunity you don't want to miss, you can apply by sending your cover letter and resume through the application form as soon as possible.
   

  

 Please note that to be considered for this position, you must be based in Finland or Sweden and hold a valid work permit for your country of residence. We're excited to connect with applicants who meet these criteria and share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what's next for the product, the planet, and the people.
   

  

 If you have questions, rebekka.gotter@relexsolutions.com from our Talent Acquisition team is happy to answer them by email. Please note that we cannot process any applications through email.
   

  

**Apply today and be part of the future. Be RELEX!**
